## frontend/src/api/ai.ts

````tsx
import { apiClient } from './client';

/** Tones supported by the AI improve feature. */
export type AiTone = 'professional' | 'friendly' | 'persuasive' | 'concise';

export interface ImproveEmailRequest {
  subject: string;
  body: string;
  purpose?: string;
  audience?: string;
  tone?: AiTone | string;
  keyPoints?: string;
}

export interface ImprovedEmail {
  subject: string;
  body: string;
}

export interface AiStatus {
  available: boolean;
  message: string;
}

export const aiApi = {
  /** Whether AI assistance is configured/enabled on the backend. */
  getStatus: () =>
    apiClient.get<AiStatus>('/api/ai/status').then((r) => r.data),

  /**
   * Improve a draft (subject + body). The result is returned for human review;
   * nothing is sent automatically.
   */
  improveEmail: (payload: ImproveEmailRequest) =>
    apiClient.post<ImprovedEmail>('/api/ai/improve-email', payload).then((r) => r.data),
};
````

````tsx
  launch: (id: number) =>

  pause: (id: number) =>
    apiClient.post<Campaign>(`/api/campaigns/${id}/pause`).then(r => r.data),
````

## frontend/src/api/client.ts

````tsx
import axios from 'axios';

const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || '';

export const apiClient = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

// Attach JWT to every request
apiClient.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('accessToken');
  if (token) {
    config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }
  return config;
});

// An expired or revoked session answers 401: clear it and open the login page.
// Sign-in and sign-up answer 401 for a wrong password or a disabled account; those
// pages show the message themselves, so they are not redirected.
apiClient.interceptors.response.use(
  (res) => res,
  (err) => {
    const url: string = err.config?.url ?? '';
    if (err.response?.status === 401 && !url.includes('/api/auth/')) {
      localStorage.removeItem('accessToken');
      localStorage.removeItem('user');
      window.location.href = '/login';
    }
    return Promise.reject(err);
  }
);
````

## frontend/src/api/recipients.ts

````tsx
import { apiClient } from './client';
import type { PageResponse, Recipient } from '../types';

// ── Types mirroring the backend DTOs ────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * VALID     – new address (not a saved contact yet)
 * EXISTING  – belongs to a saved contact that can be emailed; that contact is reused
 * SKIPPED   – valid, but never emailed: unsubscribed, or a saved contact that bounced
 *             or is marked invalid (the reason says which)
 * DUPLICATE – repeats an address from an earlier row of the same file
 * INVALID   – missing/malformed address, no email column, or a deleted contact
 *
 * Earlier campaigns play no part: a saved contact can be in any number of campaigns.
 */
export type RowStatus = 'VALID' | 'EXISTING' | 'SKIPPED' | 'INVALID' | 'DUPLICATE';

export interface ExcelRowPreview {
  rowNumber: number;
  email: string | null;
  name: string | null;
  company: string | null;
  status: RowStatus;
  reason: string | null;
  /** All mapped values (email, name, firstName, lastName, company, role, …). */
  fields: Record<string, string>;
  /** Saved contact ID when status is EXISTING (or SKIPPED for a saved contact). */
  recipientId: number | null;
}

/** totalRows = validRows + invalidRows + duplicateRows + skippedRows; validRows = newRows + existingRows. */
export interface ExcelPreviewResponse {
  fileName: string;
  totalRows: number;
  /** Rows that can be emailed: new addresses plus saved contacts. */
  validRows: number;
  /** Valid rows that are new addresses. */
  newRows: number;
  /** Valid rows that are saved contacts. */
  existingRows: number;
  invalidRows: number;
  /** Repeats of an earlier row in the same file. */
  duplicateRows: number;
  /** Valid addresses that won't be emailed (unsubscribed, bounced, marked invalid). */
  skippedRows: number;
  /** All header names in file order. */
  columns: string[];
  /** header -> target field (e.g. "First Name" -> "firstName", "Team" -> "custom:Team"). */
  detectedColumns: Record<string, string>;
  unmappedColumns: string[];
  hasEmailColumn: boolean;
  rows: ExcelRowPreview[];
}

/** Column mapping override: header -> email | name | firstName | lastName | company | custom:<Key> | ignore */
export type ColumnMapping = Record<string, string>;

export interface BulkRecipientRow {
  email: string;
  name?: string | null;
  firstName?: string | null;
  lastName?: string | null;
  company?: string | null;
  /** Extra personalization fields: role, phone, location, interest, … */
  fields?: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface BulkRecipientRequest {
  rows: BulkRecipientRow[];
  /** Recorded as the new contacts' import source. */
  source?: 'UPLOAD' | 'MANUAL';
}

export interface BulkRecipientResponse {
  created: number;
  reused: number;
  skippedInvalid: number;
  skippedDeleted: number;
  recipientIds: number[];
}

export interface RecipientLookupResponse {
  /** Saved (non-deleted) contacts matching the requested IDs or emails, any status. */
  recipients: Recipient[];
  /** Requested emails that belong to deleted contacts and can't be used. */
  deletedEmails: string[];
  /** Requested emails on the unsubscribe list (contacts or not); never emailed. */
  unsubscribedEmails: string[];
}

/** Upload limits enforced by the backend (kept in sync for early client-side checks). */
export const UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
export const UPLOAD_MAX_ROWS = 10_000;

// ── API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const recipientsApi = {
  /** List existing (saved) recipients with optional search + pagination. */
  list: (params?: { search?: string; status?: string; page?: number; size?: number }) =>
    apiClient
      .get<PageResponse<Recipient>>('/api/recipients', { params })
      .then((r) => r.data),

  /** Read-only lookup of saved contacts by ID and/or email. Creates nothing. */
  lookup: (body: { ids?: number[]; emails?: string[] }) =>
    apiClient
      .post<RecipientLookupResponse>('/api/recipients/lookup', body)
      .then((r) => r.data),

  /**
   * Validate an uploaded Excel/CSV file WITHOUT saving anything.
   * `mapping` optionally overrides the automatic column detection.
   */
  previewUpload: (file: File, mapping?: ColumnMapping) => {
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('file', file);
    if (mapping && Object.keys(mapping).length > 0) {
      fd.append('mapping', JSON.stringify(mapping));
    }
    return apiClient
      .post<ExcelPreviewResponse>('/api/recipients/import/excel/preview', fd, {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
      })
      .then((r) => r.data);
  },

  /** Create new / reuse existing recipients, returning their IDs. */
  bulkCreate: (payload: BulkRecipientRequest) =>
    apiClient
      .post<BulkRecipientResponse>('/api/recipients/bulk', payload)
      .then((r) => r.data),

  /** Download the sample .xlsx import template (triggers a browser download). */
  downloadTemplate: async () => {
    const res = await apiClient.get('/api/recipients/template/excel', {
      responseType: 'blob',
    });
    const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(res.data as Blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = 'mailflow-recipients-template.xlsx';
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    a.remove();
    window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  },
};
````

## frontend/src/api/templates.ts

````tsx
import { apiClient } from './client';
import type { EmailTemplate, PageResponse } from '../types';

export interface TemplatePayload {
  name: string;
  description?: string | null;
  subject: string;
  htmlBody?: string | null;
  plainBody?: string | null;
}

/** Recipient values used to resolve placeholders in a personalised preview. */
export interface RenderRecipient {
  email?: string | null;
  name?: string | null;
  firstName?: string | null;
  lastName?: string | null;
  company?: string | null;
  course?: string | null;
  /** Custom fields exactly as stored on a contact (role, phone, Team, …). */
  fields?: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface RenderedEmail {
  subject: string;
  htmlBody: string;
  plainBody: string;
  /** Placeholders that resolve to an empty value for this recipient. */
  emptyVariables: string[];
}

export const templatesApi = {
  list: (params?: { search?: string; page?: number; size?: number }) =>
    apiClient.get<PageResponse<EmailTemplate>>('/api/templates', { params }).then((r) => r.data),

  getById: (id: number) =>
    apiClient.get<EmailTemplate>(`/api/templates/${id}`).then((r) => r.data),

  create: (payload: TemplatePayload) =>
    apiClient.post<EmailTemplate>('/api/templates', payload).then((r) => r.data),

  update: (id: number, payload: TemplatePayload) =>
    apiClient.put<EmailTemplate>(`/api/templates/${id}`, payload).then((r) => r.data),

  delete: (id: number) => apiClient.delete(`/api/templates/${id}`),

  /**
   * Renders the template for one recipient with the same personalisation model
   * as a real send. `subject` (the campaign subject) overrides the template subject.
   */
  render: (id: number, body: { subject?: string; recipient: RenderRecipient }) =>
    apiClient.post<RenderedEmail>(`/api/templates/${id}/render`, body).then((r) => r.data),

  /**
   * Renders content that hasn't been saved (a template being created or edited, or a
   * campaign's own body) for one sample recipient, with the same personalisation model
   * as a real send. A non-blank `customBody` is rendered exactly as a campaign sends it:
   * `plainBody` is the rendered text and `htmlBody` the HTML part made from it.
   * Nothing is saved. Limits: subject 1,000 characters, each body 500,000, customBody
   * 100,000.
   */
  renderContent: (body: {
    subject: string | null;
    htmlBody: string | null;
    plainBody: string | null;
    recipient: RenderRecipient;
    customBody?: string | null;
  }) => apiClient.post<RenderedEmail>('/api/templates/render', body).then((r) => r.data),
};
````

## frontend/src/App.tsx

````tsx
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuthStore } from './store/authStore';

// Pages
import LoginPage from './pages/LoginPage';
import SignUpPage from './pages/SignUpPage';
import TeamPage from './pages/TeamPage';
import DashboardPage from './pages/DashboardPage';
import CampaignsPage from './pages/CampaignsPage';
import CampaignDetailPage from './pages/CampaignDetailPage';
import RecipientsPage from './pages/RecipientsPage';
import TemplatesPage from './pages/TemplatesPage';
import AnalyticsPage from './pages/AnalyticsPage';
import Layout from './components/Layout';

function PrivateRoute({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const isAuthenticated = useAuthStore((s) => s.isAuthenticated);
  return isAuthenticated ? <>{children}</> : <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
}

export default function App() {
  const initFromStorage = useAuthStore((s) => s.initFromStorage);

  useEffect(() => {
    initFromStorage();
  }, [initFromStorage]);

  return (
    <BrowserRouter>
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
        <Route path="/signup" element={<SignUpPage />} />
        <Route
          path="/"
          element={
            <PrivateRoute>
              <Layout />
            </PrivateRoute>
          }
        >
          <Route index element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />} />
          <Route path="dashboard"    element={<DashboardPage />} />
          <Route path="campaigns"    element={<CampaignsPage />} />
          <Route path="campaigns/:id" element={<CampaignDetailPage />} />
          <Route path="recipients"   element={<RecipientsPage />} />
          <Route path="templates"    element={<TemplatesPage />} />
          <Route path="analytics"    element={<AnalyticsPage />} />
          <Route path="team"         element={<TeamPage />} />
        </Route>
        {/* Catch-all: redirect unknown paths to the dashboard (or login if unauthenticated) */}
        <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />} />
      </Routes>
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/components/AiImproveModal.tsx

````tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Sparkles, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { aiApi, type AiTone, type ImprovedEmail } from '../api/ai';
import { Modal, Button } from './ui';

interface AiImproveModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  /** Current draft subject + body to improve. */
  initialSubject: string;
  initialBody: string;
  /** Called when the user accepts the (possibly edited) improved draft. */
  onAccept: (result: ImprovedEmail) => void;
}

const TONES: { value: AiTone; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 'professional', label: 'Professional' },
  { value: 'friendly', label: 'Friendly' },
  { value: 'persuasive', label: 'Persuasive' },
  { value: 'concise', label: 'Concise' },
];

export function AiImproveModal({
  open, onClose, initialSubject, initialBody, onAccept,
}: AiImproveModalProps) {
  const [purpose, setPurpose] = useState('');
  const [audience, setAudience] = useState('');
  const [tone, setTone] = useState<AiTone>('professional');
  const [keyPoints, setKeyPoints] = useState('');

  // The improved draft (editable before accepting).
  const [result, setResult] = useState<ImprovedEmail | null>(null);
  const [editSubject, setEditSubject] = useState('');
  const [editBody, setEditBody] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setPurpose('');
      setAudience('');
      setTone('professional');
      setKeyPoints('');
      setResult(null);
      setEditSubject('');
      setEditBody('');
    }
  }, [open]);

  const improve = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      aiApi.improveEmail({
        subject: initialSubject,
        body: initialBody,
        purpose: purpose.trim() || undefined,
        audience: audience.trim() || undefined,
        tone,
        keyPoints: keyPoints.trim() || undefined,
      }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      setResult(r);
      setEditSubject(r.subject);
      setEditBody(r.body);
    },
    onError: (e: unknown) => {
      const msg =
        (e as { response?: { data?: { message?: string } } }).response?.data?.message ??
        'AI could not improve this draft. Please try again.';
      toast.error(msg);
    },
  });

  const canImprove = initialSubject.trim().length > 0 && initialBody.trim().length > 0;

  const handleAccept = () => {
    onAccept({ subject: editSubject, body: editBody });
    toast.success('AI draft applied — review before sending');
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="Improve with AI"
      description="AI polishes your draft for clarity and tone. You review and edit before anything is used — nothing is sent automatically."
      widthClass="max-w-2xl"
      footer={
        result ? (
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" type="button" onClick={() => setResult(null)}>
              Back
            </Button>
            <Button type="button" onClick={handleAccept}>
              Use this draft
            </Button>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" type="button" onClick={onClose} disabled={improve.isPending}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => improve.mutate()}
              loading={improve.isPending}
              disabled={!canImprove || improve.isPending}
            >
              <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
              {improve.isPending ? 'Improving…' : 'Improve'}
            </Button>
          </>
        )
      }
    >
      {!canImprove && (
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-amber-700">
          <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>Enter a subject and body first, then use AI to improve them.</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {!result ? (
        /* ── Input / context step ─────────────────────────────────────── */
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50 p-3">
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-400">Current subject</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-700">{initialSubject || <span className="italic text-slate-400">— empty —</span>}</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-400">Current body (preview)</p>
            <p className="line-clamp-3 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-slate-600">
              {initialBody || <span className="italic text-slate-400">— empty —</span>}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="label">Tone</label>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {TONES.map((t) => (
                <button
                  key={t.value}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTone(t.value)}
                  className={`rounded-lg border px-3 py-1.5 text-sm transition ${
                    tone === t.value
                      ? 'border-brand-400 bg-brand-50 text-brand-700'
                      : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  {t.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="ai-purpose" className="label">Campaign purpose <span className="text-slate-400">(optional)</span></label>
              <input id="ai-purpose" className="input" placeholder="e.g. invite to a webinar"
                     value={purpose} onChange={(e) => setPurpose(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="ai-audience" className="label">Target audience <span className="text-slate-400">(optional)</span></label>
              <input id="ai-audience" className="input" placeholder="e.g. final-year CS students"
                     value={audience} onChange={(e) => setAudience(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="ai-keypoints" className="label">Key points to keep <span className="text-slate-400">(optional)</span></label>
            <textarea id="ai-keypoints" className="input min-h-[60px] resize-y"
                      placeholder="e.g. event date, venue, registration link"
                      value={keyPoints} onChange={(e) => setKeyPoints(e.target.value)} />
          </div>

          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            AI preserves your meaning, facts, links and merge variables like {'{{Name}}'}. It won't invent offers or recipient details.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* ── Review step (editable) ───────────────────────────────────── */
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-emerald-700">
            <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>Review the improved draft. Edit anything, then click “Use this draft”.</span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="ai-out-subject" className="label">Improved subject</label>
            <input id="ai-out-subject" className="input"
                   value={editSubject} onChange={(e) => setEditSubject(e.target.value)} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="ai-out-body" className="label">Improved body</label>
            <textarea id="ai-out-body" className="input min-h-[200px] resize-y font-mono text-sm"
                      value={editBody} onChange={(e) => setEditBody(e.target.value)} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/components/CampaignContentSection.tsx

````tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import clsx from 'clsx';
import {
  AlertCircle, AlertTriangle, Eye, EyeOff, FileText, Info, LayoutTemplate, Loader2, PenLine, Sparkles,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { templatesApi, type RenderedEmail } from '../api/templates';
import type { EmailTemplate } from '../types';
import { Button } from './ui';
import {
  applyTemplateChange,
  BODY_MAX_LENGTH,
  customize,
  customizeFromTemplate,
  insertAtCursor,
  placeholderChips,
  placeholderToken,
  planTemplateChange,
  SAMPLE_RECIPIENT,
  sampleFor,
  SUBJECT_MAX_LENGTH,
  switchToTemplateContent,
  type ContentState,
  type TemplateChangePlan,
} from '../lib/campaignContent';
import type { CombinedRecipient } from '../lib/recipientSelection';
import { apiErrorMessage, apiErrorStatus } from '../lib/errors';

/** A stored template that isn't in the list: deleted, or still loading / failed to load. */
export interface StoredTemplateOption {
  id: number;
  name: string;
}

interface CampaignContentSectionProps {
  /** Templates to start from (the active list, plus the draft's own template once loaded). */
  templates: EmailTemplate[];
  templatesLoading: boolean;
  templatesError: string | null;
  /** The draft's template when it was deleted: shown as a disabled option. */
  deletedTemplate: StoredTemplateOption | null;
  /** The draft's template while it is loading or couldn't be loaded: selectable under its stored name. */
  unresolvedTemplate: StoredTemplateOption | null;
  unresolvedTemplateError: string | null;
  /** A saved draft's template can be replaced but not removed, so "No template" is hidden. */
  templateRequired: boolean;
  content: ContentState;
  onContentChange: (next: ContentState) => void;
  subject: string;
  onSubjectChange: (next: string) => void;
  subjectError: string | null;
  bodyError: string | null;
  /** Custom fields the selected recipients bring (offered as chips after the standard placeholders). */
  customKeys: string[];
  /** Recipients the preview can render for (the final list). */
  previewRecipients: CombinedRecipient[];
  onImproveWithAi: () => void;
}

interface PendingChange {
  templateId: number;
  plan: TemplateChangePlan;
  /** Also replace the subject the user typed with the template's subject. */
  replaceSubject: boolean;
}

/**
 * The "Email Content" section of the campaign form (on the Recipients step, below the
 * recipients). The content is campaign-wide: the same subject and body for every
 * recipient, personalised only through placeholders.
 *
 * - "Start from a template" is optional. Choosing one fills the subject (asking before
 *   replacing a subject the user typed) and uses the template's content unchanged.
 * - "Customize for this campaign" copies the template's text into the editor; from then
 *   on the campaign's own body is sent. "Use the template's content" goes back.
 * - The body is plain text. Chips insert placeholders at the cursor.
 * - "Preview" renders on the server exactly what is sent, for a chosen recipient or
 *   sample values.
 */
export function CampaignContentSection(props: CampaignContentSectionProps) {
  const {
    templates, templatesLoading, templatesError, deletedTemplate, unresolvedTemplate, unresolvedTemplateError,
    templateRequired, content, onContentChange, subject, onSubjectChange, subjectError, bodyError, customKeys,
    previewRecipients, onImproveWithAi,
  } = props;

  const [pending, setPending] = useState<PendingChange | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [previewOpen, setPreviewOpen] = useState(false);

  const subjectRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const bodyRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  // The field a chip goes into, and whether each field has had the cursor (else: append).
  const lastField = useRef<'subject' | 'body'>('body');
  const touched = useRef({ subject: false, body: false });
  const caret = useRef<{ field: 'subject' | 'body'; position: number } | null>(null);

  // After a chip was inserted: keep the focus in the field, with the cursor after the placeholder.
  useEffect(() => {
    const c = caret.current;
    if (!c) return;
    caret.current = null;
    const el = c.field === 'body' ? bodyRef.current : subjectRef.current;
    if (el) {
      el.focus();
      el.setSelectionRange(c.position, c.position);
    }
  });

  const template = content.templateId == null ? null : templates.find((t) => t.id === content.templateId) ?? null;
  const templateIsDeleted = !!deletedTemplate && content.templateId === deletedTemplate.id;
  const templateName = template?.name ?? (templateIsDeleted ? deletedTemplate?.name : unresolvedTemplate?.name) ?? 'the template';
  const templateWithoutBody = !!template && !template.htmlBody?.trim() && !template.plainBody?.trim();
  const usesTemplate = content.source === 'template' && content.templateId != null;
  const chips = placeholderChips(customKeys);

  const chooseTemplate = (value: string) => {
    setNotice(null);
    if (!value) {
      setPending(null);
      onContentChange(applyTemplateChange(content, null, true));
      return;
    }
    const id = Number(value);
    const next = templates.find((t) => t.id === id) ?? null;
    const plan = planTemplateChange({ subject, previous: template, next, state: content });
    if (plan.askBody || plan.askSubject) {
      setPending({ templateId: id, plan, replaceSubject: false });
      return;
    }
    setPending(null);
    onContentChange(applyTemplateChange(content, id, false));
    if (plan.fillSubject && next) onSubjectChange(next.subject);
  };

  const confirmPending = (keepOwnText: boolean) => {
    if (!pending) return;
    const next = templates.find((t) => t.id === pending.templateId) ?? null;
    onContentChange(applyTemplateChange(content, pending.templateId, keepOwnText));
    if (next && (pending.plan.fillSubject || (pending.plan.askSubject && pending.replaceSubject))) {
      onSubjectChange(next.subject);
    }
    setPending(null);
  };

  const startCustomizing = () => {
    if (!template) return;
    const result = customizeFromTemplate(template);
    onContentChange(customize(content, template));
    touched.current.body = false;
    setNotice(
      result.from === 'html'
        ? `"${template.name}" has only an HTML body, so its text was copied. The formatting (layout, images, link addresses) is lost: this campaign sends plain text.`
        : result.formattingLost
        ? `The plain-text version of "${template.name}" was copied. Its HTML design isn't used: this campaign sends plain text.`
        : `The text of "${template.name}" was copied. Changes here don't change the template.`,
    );
  };

  const backToTemplate = () => {
    if (content.body.trim() && !window.confirm(`Remove your text and send the content of "${templateName}" instead?`)) return;
    setNotice(null);
    onContentChange(switchToTemplateContent(content));
  };

  const insertChip = (key: string) => {
    const token = placeholderToken(key);
    const field = usesTemplate ? 'subject' : lastField.current;
    if (field === 'body') {
      const el = bodyRef.current;
      const r = insertAtCursor(content.body, token, touched.current.body ? el?.selectionStart : null,
        touched.current.body ? el?.selectionEnd : null);
      onContentChange({ ...content, source: 'own', body: r.value });
      caret.current = { field: 'body', position: r.cursor };
    } else {
      const el = subjectRef.current;
      const r = insertAtCursor(subject, token, touched.current.subject ? el?.selectionStart : null,
        touched.current.subject ? el?.selectionEnd : null);
      onSubjectChange(r.value);
      caret.current = { field: 'subject', position: r.cursor };
    }
  };

  const nextTemplate = pending ? templates.find((t) => t.id === pending.templateId) : null;

  return (
    <section className="space-y-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-4" aria-labelledby="email-content-title">
      <div>
        <h3 id="email-content-title" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
          <PenLine className="h-4 w-4 text-brand-500" /> Email Content
        </h3>
        <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500">
          One subject and one email for everyone in the list above, whichever way you added them. Placeholders such as
          {' '}{'{{FirstName}}'} are filled in for each recipient.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Template (optional) */}
      <div>
        <label htmlFor="c-template" className="label">Start from a template <span className="text-slate-400">(optional)</span></label>
        <select
          id="c-template"
          className="input"
          value={content.templateId != null ? String(content.templateId) : ''}
          onChange={(e) => chooseTemplate(e.target.value)}
          disabled={templatesLoading}
        >
          {!templateRequired && <option value="">No template: write the email below</option>}
          {deletedTemplate && (
            <option value={String(deletedTemplate.id)} disabled>{deletedTemplate.name} (deleted)</option>
          )}
          {unresolvedTemplate && <option value={String(unresolvedTemplate.id)}>{unresolvedTemplate.name}</option>}
          {templates.map((t) => (
            <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>{t.name}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        {templatesError && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-red-600">Could not load templates. {templatesError}</p>}
        {unresolvedTemplateError && (
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-red-600">Could not load this draft's template. {unresolvedTemplateError}</p>
        )}
        {templateRequired && (
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">
            A saved draft's template can be replaced but not removed. To send your own text instead, choose
            "Customize for this campaign".
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {pending && nextTemplate && (
        <div role="alert" className="space-y-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-sm text-amber-900">
          <p className="font-medium">Use the template "{nextTemplate.name}"?</p>
          {pending.plan.askBody && (
            <p className="text-xs">
              You have written your own email. Choosing this template replaces your text with the template's content,
              unless you keep your text.
            </p>
          )}
          {pending.plan.askSubject && (
            <label className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded border-amber-300"
                checked={pending.replaceSubject}
                onChange={(e) => setPending({ ...pending, replaceSubject: e.target.checked })}
              />
              <span>
                Also replace your subject “{subject.trim()}” with the template's subject “{nextTemplate.subject}”
              </span>
            </label>
          )}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {pending.plan.askBody ? (
              <>
                <Button type="button" size="sm" onClick={() => confirmPending(false)}>Replace my text</Button>
                <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => confirmPending(true)}>Keep my text</Button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <Button type="button" size="sm" onClick={() => confirmPending(false)}>Use this template</Button>
            )}
            <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setPending(null)}>Cancel</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Subject */}
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <label htmlFor="c-subject" className="label">Subject <span className="text-red-500">*</span></label>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onImproveWithAi}
            className="mb-1.5 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-brand-600 hover:text-brand-700 hover:underline"
          >
            <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Improve with AI
          </button>
        </div>
        <input
          id="c-subject"
          ref={subjectRef}
          className={clsx('input', subjectError && 'border-red-400 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500/10')}
          placeholder="Enter your email subject"
          value={subject}
          maxLength={SUBJECT_MAX_LENGTH}
          onChange={(e) => onSubjectChange(e.target.value)}
          onFocus={() => { lastField.current = 'subject'; touched.current.subject = true; }}
          aria-invalid={!!subjectError}
        />
        {subjectError && (
          <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-red-600"><AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />{subjectError}</p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Body */}
      {usesTemplate ? (
        <div className="space-y-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 p-3 text-sm">
          <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-slate-700">
            <LayoutTemplate className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-brand-500" />
            <span>
              This campaign sends the content of the template <b>{templateName}</b>
              {template && !templateWithoutBody && (
                <> ({[template.htmlBody?.trim() && 'HTML', template.plainBody?.trim() && 'plain text'].filter(Boolean).join(' and ')})</>
              )}
              . The template isn't changed. Use Preview to see it for a recipient.
            </span>
          </p>
          {templateWithoutBody && (
            <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-amber-700">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> This template has no body. Write the email instead, or choose another template.
            </p>
          )}
          {templateIsDeleted && (
            <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-amber-700">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> This template was deleted. Choose another template or write the email.
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={startCustomizing} disabled={!template}>
              <PenLine className="h-4 w-4" /> Customize for this campaign
            </Button>
            {(templateWithoutBody || templateIsDeleted) && (
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={() => onContentChange({ ...content, source: 'own', body: '' })}
              >
                Write the email instead
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <label htmlFor="c-body" className="label">Email <span className="text-slate-400">(plain text)</span></label>
            {content.templateId != null && template && (
              <button type="button" className="mb-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-brand-600 hover:underline" onClick={backToTemplate}>
                Use the template's content
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          <textarea
            id="c-body"
            ref={bodyRef}
            className={clsx(
              'input min-h-[200px] resize-y text-sm leading-relaxed',
              bodyError && 'border-red-400 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500/10',
            )}
            placeholder="Write your email here..."
            value={content.body}
            onChange={(e) => onContentChange({ ...content, source: 'own', body: e.target.value })}
            onFocus={() => { lastField.current = 'body'; touched.current.body = true; }}
            aria-invalid={!!bodyError}
            aria-describedby="c-body-help"
          />
          <div id="c-body-help" className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
            {bodyError ? (
              <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-red-600"><AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />{bodyError}</p>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-slate-400">
                Required before sending; you can save a draft without it. Sent as plain text (HTML tags are sent as
                text). Line breaks are kept.
                {content.templateId != null && !content.body.trim() && " Left empty, the template's content is sent."}
              </p>
            )}
            <span className={clsx('tabular-nums', content.body.length > BODY_MAX_LENGTH ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-slate-400')}>
              {content.body.length.toLocaleString()} / {BODY_MAX_LENGTH.toLocaleString()}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {notice && (
        <p className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
          <Info className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" /> {notice}
        </p>
      )}

      {/* Placeholder chips */}
      <div>
        <p className="mb-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
          Insert a placeholder at the cursor{usesTemplate ? ' of the subject' : ' (subject or email)'}:
        </p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
          {chips.map((key) => (
            <button
              key={key}
              type="button"
              // Keep the cursor in the field: the chip is inserted where it is.
              onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
              onClick={() => insertChip(key)}
              className="rounded bg-accent-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs text-accent-700 transition hover:bg-accent-100"
              title={`Insert ${placeholderToken(key)}`}
            >
              {placeholderToken(key)}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
          Placeholders are case-sensitive. A recipient without a value gets blank text. Custom fields come from the
          columns of an uploaded file.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div>
        <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => setPreviewOpen((v) => !v)} aria-expanded={previewOpen}>
          {previewOpen ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
          {previewOpen ? 'Hide preview' : 'Preview'}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {previewOpen && (
        <ContentPreview
          subject={subject}
          content={content}
          templateUnavailable={templateIsDeleted ? 'The template was deleted.' : null}
          recipients={previewRecipients}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/** Debounces a JSON-serialisable value (typing in the editor doesn't render on every key). */
function useDebouncedJson<T>(value: T, delayMs: number): T {
  const key = JSON.stringify(value);
  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState(key);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(key), delayMs);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [key, delayMs]);
  return JSON.parse(debounced) as T;
}

interface ContentPreviewProps {
  subject: string;
  content: ContentState;
  /** Why the template can't be rendered (for example deleted), or null. */
  templateUnavailable: string | null;
  recipients: CombinedRecipient[];
}

/**
 * What a recipient receives, rendered by the server with the same code as a real send:
 * the campaign's own body through POST /api/templates/render (plain text plus the HTML
 * part made from it), a template through POST /api/templates/{id}/render. Plain text is
 * shown in a <pre>, HTML only in a sandboxed iframe.
 */
export function ContentPreview({ subject, content, templateUnavailable, recipients }: ContentPreviewProps) {
  const [choice, setChoice] = useState('');
  const options = recipients.slice(0, 200);
  const entry = choice === 'sample' ? undefined : options.find((r) => r.email === choice) ?? options[0];
  const recipient = entry ? sampleFor(entry) : SAMPLE_RECIPIENT;

  const ownBody = content.source === 'own' && content.body.trim() ? content.body : null;
  const templateId = ownBody ? null : content.templateId;
  const request = useDebouncedJson({ subject: subject.trim(), ownBody, templateId, recipient }, 400);
  const blocked = !request.ownBody && (request.templateId == null || !!templateUnavailable);

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['campaign-content-preview', request],
    queryFn: () =>
      request.ownBody
        ? templatesApi.renderContent({
            subject: request.subject,
            htmlBody: null,
            plainBody: null,
            customBody: request.ownBody,
            recipient: request.recipient,
          })
        : templatesApi.render(request.templateId as number, { subject: request.subject, recipient: request.recipient }),
    enabled: !blocked,
    retry: false,
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
          <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" /> Preview
        </p>
        <select
          className="input w-auto max-w-xs py-1.5 text-xs"
          value={entry ? entry.email : 'sample'}
          onChange={(e) => setChoice(e.target.value)}
          aria-label="Recipient to preview"
        >
          {options.map((e) => (
            <option key={e.email} value={e.email}>{e.email}{e.name ? ` (${e.name})` : ''}</option>
          ))}
          <option value="sample">Sample values</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      {blocked ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
          {templateUnavailable
            ? `${templateUnavailable} Write the email or choose another template to preview it.`
            : 'Nothing to preview yet: write the email or choose a template.'}
        </p>
      ) : query.isLoading ? (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-500"><Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> Rendering preview…</p>
      ) : query.isError ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-red-600">
          {apiErrorStatus(query.error) === 404
            ? 'The template no longer exists. Choose another template or write the email.'
            : apiErrorMessage(query.error, 'Could not render the preview.')}
        </p>
      ) : query.data ? (
        <RenderedView
          email={query.data}
          to={recipient.email ?? null}
          own={!!request.ownBody}
          usingSample={!entry}
        />
      ) : null}
      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
        Rendered by the server with the same code as a real send. Nothing is saved and no email is sent.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

function RenderedView({ email, to, own, usingSample }: { email: RenderedEmail; to: string | null; own: boolean; usingSample: boolean }) {
  const hasHtml = email.htmlBody.trim().length > 0;
  const hasPlain = email.plainBody.trim().length > 0;
  // The campaign's own text is shown as typed (plain text) first; a template's HTML first.
  const [view, setView] = useState<'html' | 'plain'>(own ? 'plain' : 'html');
  const current = view === 'plain' ? (hasPlain ? 'plain' : 'html') : hasHtml ? 'html' : 'plain';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      {usingSample && <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Showing sample values.</p>}
      <p className="text-sm">
        <span className="text-slate-500">To:</span> <span className="text-slate-800">{to ?? '(no address)'}</span>
      </p>
      <p className="text-sm">
        <span className="text-slate-500">Subject:</span>{' '}
        <span className="font-medium text-slate-900">{email.subject || '(empty)'}</span>
      </p>
      {hasHtml && hasPlain && (
        <div className="flex gap-1 text-xs font-medium">
          {(['plain', 'html'] as const).map((v) => (
            <button
              key={v}
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={current === v}
              onClick={() => setView(v)}
              className={clsx('rounded-md px-2.5 py-1', current === v ? 'bg-brand-50 text-brand-700' : 'text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100')}
            >
              {v === 'html' ? 'HTML part' : 'Plain-text part'}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {!hasHtml && !hasPlain ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">(The body is empty.)</p>
      ) : current === 'html' ? (
        // sandbox="" blocks scripts, forms, popups and same-origin access in the rendered HTML.
        <iframe
          title="Rendered email (HTML part)"
          sandbox=""
          srcDoc={email.htmlBody}
          className="h-72 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white"
        />
      ) : (
        <pre className="max-h-72 overflow-auto whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-3 text-xs text-slate-700">
          {email.plainBody}
        </pre>
      )}
      {own && hasHtml && (
        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
          Your text is sent as plain text, with an HTML version made from it (values are escaped, line breaks kept).
        </p>
      )}
      {email.emptyVariables.length > 0 && (
        <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-xs text-amber-700">
          <Info className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>
            No value for this recipient:{' '}
            {email.emptyVariables.map((v) => <code key={v} className="mr-1">{`{{${v}}}`}</code>)}
            These appear as blank text.
          </span>
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { useState, FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useQuery, useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import {
  AlertCircle, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Loader2, UserPlus, AlertTriangle, Info, Send,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { campaignsApi } from '../api/campaigns';
import { recipientsApi, type BulkRecipientRow, type RecipientLookupResponse } from '../api/recipients';
import { templatesApi } from '../api/templates';
import type { Campaign, Recipient, TargetAddress } from '../types';
import { Modal, Button } from './ui';
import { CampaignRecipientSelector } from './CampaignRecipientSelector';
import { CampaignContentSection, ContentPreview } from './CampaignContentSection';
import { AiImproveModal } from './AiImproveModal';
import type { ImprovedEmail } from '../api/ai';
import {
  CAMPAIGN_ONLY_LIMIT,
  combineRecipients,
  EMPTY_SELECTION,
  extractPlaceholders,
  isValidEmail,
  normalizeEmail,
  removeAddress,
  skipReason,
  toTargetAddress,
  trimEmail,
  type CombinedRecipient,
  type RecipientSelection,
} from '../lib/recipientSelection';
import {
  bodyError as validateBody,
  contentReady,
  customBodyToSave,
  customFieldKeys,
  htmlToText,
  initialContent,
  subjectError as validateSubject,
  type ContentState,
} from '../lib/campaignContent';
import { manualRowStatuses, UNUSED_STATES } from '../lib/manualTable';
import { canSaveAndSend, draftLaunchChecks, type LaunchCheckKey } from '../lib/campaignChecks';
import { apiErrorMessage, apiErrorStatus, isForbidden } from '../lib/errors';
import { canManage, noPermissionMessage } from '../lib/roles';
import { useAuthStore } from '../store/authStore';

interface CampaignFormModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  /** Called after the campaign is created or updated (and again after it is launched). */
  onSaved: (campaign: Campaign) => void;
  /** When set, the modal edits this DRAFT campaign instead of creating a new one. */
  campaign?: Campaign | null;
}

interface FormState {
  name: string;
  subject: string;
  description: string;
  senderName: string;
  senderEmail: string;
  replyTo: string;
}

const EMPTY: FormState = {
  name: '',
  subject: '',
  description: '',
  senderName: '',
  senderEmail: '',
  replyTo: '',
};

type FieldErrors = Partial<Record<keyof FormState | 'body', string>>;

type Step = 'details' | 'recipients' | 'review';
const STEPS: { key: Step; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'details', label: 'Details' },
  { key: 'recipients', label: 'Recipients & content' },
  { key: 'review', label: 'Review & send' },
];

type EditLoad =
  | { status: 'loading' }
  | { status: 'error'; message: string }
  | { status: 'ready'; missing: number };

type ReviewState =
  | { status: 'idle' }
  | { status: 'loading' }
  | { status: 'error'; message: string }
  | { status: 'ready'; contacts: Map<string, Recipient>; deleted: Set<string>; unsubscribed: Set<string> };

/** The draft was saved, but launching it failed: the saved draft and the launch error. */
class LaunchError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly saved: Campaign, readonly launchError: unknown) {
    super('launch failed');
  }
}

function toBulkRow(e: CombinedRecipient): BulkRecipientRow {
  return {
    email: e.email,
    name: e.name ?? null,
    firstName: e.firstName ?? null,
    lastName: e.lastName ?? null,
    company: e.company ?? null,
    fields: e.fields ?? {},
  };
}

function plural(n: number, one: string, many = `${one}s`) {
  return `${n.toLocaleString()} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;
}

/** The bulk endpoint accepts at most this many rows per request. */
const BULK_CHUNK = 10_000;

/** Creates (or reuses) contacts for the rows, in chunks, and returns their IDs. */
async function bulkCreateAll(rows: BulkRecipientRow[], source: 'UPLOAD' | 'MANUAL'): Promise<number[]> {
  const ids: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i += BULK_CHUNK) {
    const res = await recipientsApi.bulkCreate({ rows: rows.slice(i, i + BULK_CHUNK), source });
    ids.push(...res.recipientIds);
  }
  return ids;
}

export function CampaignFormModal({ open, onClose, onSaved, campaign }: CampaignFormModalProps) {
  const isEdit = !!campaign;
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const mayManage = useAuthStore((s) => canManage(s.roles));
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>('details');
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(EMPTY);
  const [content, setContent] = useState<ContentState>(() => initialContent(null, null));
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<FieldErrors>({});
  const [selection, setSelection] = useState<RecipientSelection>(EMPTY_SELECTION);
  const [editLoad, setEditLoad] = useState<EditLoad>({ status: 'ready', missing: 0 });
  const [review, setReview] = useState<ReviewState>({ status: 'idle' });
  const [reviewAttempt, setReviewAttempt] = useState(0);
  // Opt-in, unchecked by default: new addresses are campaign-only unless the user
  // explicitly chooses to save them as contacts.
  const [saveAsContacts, setSaveAsContacts] = useState(false);
  const [aiOpen, setAiOpen] = useState(false);
  // "Save and send now": the confirmation view, and the server's reason when launching failed.
  const [confirmSend, setConfirmSend] = useState(false);
  const [sendError, setSendError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // The campaign this form saves to once it exists. A new campaign gets an ID at its first
  // save; a retry after a failed launch (or "Save draft" afterwards) updates that same
  // campaign instead of creating a second one.
  const [savedId, setSavedId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const initializedFor = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const loadToken = useRef(0);

  const loadDraftRecipients = (c: Campaign) => {
    const ids = c.recipientIds ?? [];
    const token = ++loadToken.current;
    // A campaign from a list response carries neither its campaign-only addresses (only
    // their count) nor its own body: load the full campaign so saving the draft never
    // drops any of them.
    const needFull = c.targetAddresses === undefined;
    if (ids.length === 0 && !needFull) {
      setSelection({ ...EMPTY_SELECTION, draft: c.targetAddresses ?? [] });
      setEditLoad({ status: 'ready', missing: 0 });
      return;
    }
    setEditLoad({ status: 'loading' });
    Promise.all([
      ids.length > 0
        ? recipientsApi.lookup({ ids })
        : Promise.resolve<RecipientLookupResponse>({ recipients: [], deletedEmails: [], unsubscribedEmails: [] }),
      needFull ? campaignsApi.getById(c.id) : Promise.resolve<Campaign | null>(null),
    ])
      .then(([res, full]) => {
        if (token !== loadToken.current) return;
        let draft: TargetAddress[] = c.targetAddresses ?? [];
        if (full) {
          if (!full.targetAddresses) throw new Error('The campaign-only addresses were not returned.');
          draft = full.targetAddresses;
          setContent(initialContent(full.customBody, full.templateId ?? null));
        }
        setSelection({
          saved: Object.fromEntries(res.recipients.map((r) => [r.id, r])) as Record<number, Recipient>,
          upload: null,
          manual: [],
          draft,
        });
        setEditLoad({ status: 'ready', missing: ids.length - res.recipients.length });
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (token !== loadToken.current) return;
        setEditLoad({ status: 'error', message: apiErrorMessage(e, "Couldn't load this draft.") });
      });
  };

  // Initialise once per opening (not on every refetch of the campaign prop).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      initializedFor.current = null;
      loadToken.current++;
      return;
    }
    const key = campaign ? `edit-${campaign.id}` : 'create';
    if (initializedFor.current === key) return;
    initializedFor.current = key;

    setStep('details');
    setErrors({});
    setReview({ status: 'idle' });
    setSaveAsContacts(false);
    setAiOpen(false);
    setConfirmSend(false);
    setSendError(null);
    setSavedId(campaign ? campaign.id : null);
    setSelection(EMPTY_SELECTION);
    if (campaign) {
      setForm({
        name: campaign.name ?? '',
        subject: campaign.subject ?? '',
        description: campaign.description ?? '',
        senderName: campaign.senderName ?? '',
        senderEmail: campaign.senderEmail ?? '',
        replyTo: campaign.replyTo ?? '',
      });
      setContent(initialContent(campaign.customBody, campaign.templateId ?? null));
      loadDraftRecipients(campaign);
    } else {
      setForm(EMPTY);
      setContent(initialContent(null, null));
      setEditLoad({ status: 'ready', missing: 0 });
    }
    // loadDraftRecipients only uses setters and refs.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [open, campaign]);

  // ── Templates ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const templatesQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['templates', 'campaign-form'],
    queryFn: () => templatesApi.list({ size: 200 }),
    enabled: open,
  });
  const templates = useMemo(() => templatesQuery.data?.content ?? [], [templatesQuery.data]);

  // The draft's current template may be missing from the active list (deleted).
  const editTemplateId = isEdit ? campaign?.templateId : undefined;
  const editTemplateListed = !!editTemplateId && templates.some((t) => t.id === editTemplateId);
  const editTemplateQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['template', editTemplateId],
    queryFn: () => templatesApi.getById(editTemplateId as number),
    enabled: open && templatesQuery.isSuccess && !!editTemplateId && !editTemplateListed,
    retry: false,
  });
  // Only a 404 means deleted; another error (network, 500) says nothing about the template.
  const templateDeleted =
    !!editTemplateId && !editTemplateListed && editTemplateQuery.isError &&
    apiErrorStatus(editTemplateQuery.error) === 404;
  // The draft's template while it is loading or couldn't be loaded: keep it selectable
  // under its stored name so the select shows what the draft really uses.
  const editTemplateUnresolved =
    !!editTemplateId && !editTemplateListed && !editTemplateQuery.data && !templateDeleted;
  const allTemplates = useMemo(
    () =>
      editTemplateQuery.data && !templates.some((t) => t.id === editTemplateQuery.data.id)
        ? [...templates, editTemplateQuery.data]
        : templates,
    [templates, editTemplateQuery.data],
  );

  const selectedTemplate = allTemplates.find((t) => t.id === content.templateId);
  const chosenTemplateDeleted = templateDeleted && content.templateId === editTemplateId;
  const templateWithoutBody =
    !!selectedTemplate && !selectedTemplate.htmlBody?.trim() && !selectedTemplate.plainBody?.trim();
  const templateIdToSend =
    content.templateId != null && !chosenTemplateDeleted ? content.templateId : null;
  // A template that isn't loaded (yet) counts as no content until it is.
  const hasContent = contentReady(content, chosenTemplateDeleted ? { deleted: true } : selectedTemplate ?? null);
  const ownBody = content.source === 'own' && content.body.trim() !== '';
  const chosenTemplateLoading = editTemplateUnresolved && content.templateId === editTemplateId;

  // Placeholders the email uses (for the upload's column coverage).
  const contentPlaceholders = useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.from(
        new Set([
          ...extractPlaceholders(form.subject),
          ...(content.source === 'own'
            ? extractPlaceholders(content.body)
            : [...extractPlaceholders(selectedTemplate?.htmlBody), ...extractPlaceholders(selectedTemplate?.plainBody)]),
        ]),
      ),
    [form.subject, content, selectedTemplate],
  );

  const set = <K extends keyof FormState>(key: K, value: FormState[K]) => {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: value }));
    if (errors[key]) setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, [key]: undefined }));
  };

  const changeContent = (next: ContentState) => {
    setContent(next);
    if (errors.body) setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, body: undefined }));
  };

  // Body context for AI: the campaign's own text, or the selected template's text.
  const aiBody =
    content.source === 'own'
      ? content.body
      : selectedTemplate?.plainBody?.trim()
      ? selectedTemplate.plainBody
      : htmlToText(selectedTemplate?.htmlBody ?? '');

  const handleAiAccept = (result: ImprovedEmail) => {
    set('subject', result.subject);
    // The improved body becomes the campaign's own text (plain text; the template isn't changed).
    if (result.body.trim()) changeContent({ ...content, source: 'own', body: result.body });
  };

  // ── Recipients: combined list + authoritative check on the Review step ───────
  const combined = useMemo(() => combineRecipients(selection), [selection]);
  // Addresses without a known saved-contact record (file rows, typed addresses and
  // campaign-only addresses stored with the draft): one of them may be a contact by now.
  const lookupEmails = useMemo(
    () => combined.list.filter((e) => !e.contact).map((e) => e.email),
    [combined],
  );
  const lookupKey = lookupEmails.join(',');
  // Table rows that won't be used (no or invalid email, repeated, deleted contact).
  const unusedTableRows = useMemo(
    () => manualRowStatuses(selection.manual).filter((s) => UNUSED_STATES.has(s.state)).length,
    [selection.manual],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || step !== 'review') return;
    if (lookupEmails.length === 0) {
      setReview({ status: 'ready', contacts: new Map(), deleted: new Set(), unsubscribed: new Set() });
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    setReview({ status: 'loading' });
    recipientsApi
      .lookup({ emails: lookupEmails })
      .then((res) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setReview({
          status: 'ready',
          contacts: new Map(res.recipients.map((r) => [normalizeEmail(r.email), r])),
          deleted: new Set(res.deletedEmails.map(normalizeEmail)),
          unsubscribed: new Set((res.unsubscribedEmails ?? []).map(normalizeEmail)),
        });
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!cancelled) setReview({ status: 'error', message: apiErrorMessage(e, 'Could not check the recipients.') });
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
    // lookupKey captures the content of lookupEmails.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [open, step, lookupKey, reviewAttempt]);

  const resolved = useMemo(() => {
    if (review.status !== 'ready') return null;
    const final: CombinedRecipient[] = [];
    const blocked: string[] = [];
    // Not saved contacts and on the unsubscribe list: never emailed, so not included.
    const unsubscribed: string[] = [];
    for (const e of combined.list) {
      const contact = e.contact ?? review.contacts.get(e.email);
      if (contact) {
        final.push({
          ...e,
          contact,
          recipientId: contact.id,
          status: contact.status,
          name: contact.name ?? undefined,
          firstName: contact.firstName ?? undefined,
          lastName: contact.lastName ?? undefined,
          company: contact.company ?? undefined,
        });
      } else if (review.deleted.has(e.email)) {
        blocked.push(e.email);
      } else if (review.unsubscribed.has(e.email)) {
        unsubscribed.push(e.email);
      } else {
        final.push({ ...e, contact: undefined, recipientId: undefined, status: undefined });
      }
    }
    // Addresses that are not saved contacts: campaign-only unless the user opts in
    // to saving them as contacts.
    const newAddresses = final.filter((e) => !e.contact);
    // Saved contacts that are skipped when sending, with the reason (never "duplicate":
    // a contact can be in any number of campaigns).
    const skipped: { email: string; reason: string }[] = [];
    for (const e of final) {
      const reason = e.contact ? skipReason(e.contact.status, review.unsubscribed.has(e.email)) : null;
      if (reason) skipped.push({ email: e.email, reason });
    }
    return {
      final,
      blocked,
      unsubscribed,
      newAddresses,
      newFromFile: newAddresses.filter((e) => e.origin === 'upload').length,
      newTyped: newAddresses.filter((e) => e.origin === 'manual').length,
      newStored: newAddresses.filter((e) => e.origin === 'draft').length,
      skipped,
      sendable: final.length - skipped.length,
    };
  }, [combined, review]);

  // The opt-in applies to a specific set of new addresses; changing the set resets it.
  const newAddressesKey = resolved?.newAddresses.map((e) => e.email).join(',') ?? '';
  useEffect(() => setSaveAsContacts(false), [newAddressesKey]);

  const groupCount = campaign?.recipientGroupIds?.length ?? 0;

  // ── Save (and launch) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /** Creates the campaign, or updates it once it exists (this form's draft or the edited one). */
  const persist = async (): Promise<Campaign> => {
    if (!resolved) throw new Error('Recipients have not been checked yet');
    const contactIds = resolved.final.filter((e) => e.contact).map((e) => e.contact!.id);

    // By default new addresses are campaign-only: stored with this campaign as
    // targetAddresses, never as contacts. Only an explicit opt-in creates contacts
    // (existing contacts are reused), which are then targeted by ID instead.
    let targetAddresses: TargetAddress[] = resolved.newAddresses.map(toTargetAddress);
    const createdIds: number[] = [];
    if (saveAsContacts && resolved.newAddresses.length > 0) {
      const fileRows = resolved.newAddresses.filter((e) => e.origin === 'upload').map(toBulkRow);
      const otherRows = resolved.newAddresses.filter((e) => e.origin !== 'upload').map(toBulkRow);
      createdIds.push(...(await bulkCreateAll(fileRows, 'UPLOAD')));
      createdIds.push(...(await bulkCreateAll(otherRows, 'MANUAL')));
      targetAddresses = [];
    }

    const recipientIds = Array.from(new Set([...contactIds, ...createdIds]));

    // Always the full payload. PUT replaces every scalar field (an omitted one is
    // cleared), so fields this form doesn't edit are passed through from the draft.
    const payload = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      subject: form.subject.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim() || null,
      // null keeps the draft's current template (for example a deleted one).
      templateId: templateIdToSend,
      // The campaign's own body; "" clears a stored one, so the template's body is sent.
      customBody: customBodyToSave(content),
      senderName: form.senderName.trim() || null,
      // Same trim as the validation (isValidEmail), so an address pasted with an
      // invisible character is sent without it.
      senderEmail: trimEmail(form.senderEmail) || null,
      replyTo: trimEmail(form.replyTo) || null,
      // Not editable here: keep any schedule set through the API.
      scheduledAt: campaign?.scheduledAt ?? null,
      recipientIds,
      // Always the full list: an empty list removes the stored campaign-only addresses.
      targetAddresses,
      // Not editable here: pass the groups set through the API back unchanged (null keeps them).
      recipientGroupIds: campaign?.recipientGroupIds ?? null,
    };
    const saved = savedId != null ? await campaignsApi.update(savedId, payload) : await campaignsApi.create(payload);
    setSavedId(saved.id);
    return saved;
  };

  const savedToast = (saved: Campaign, updated: boolean) => {
    const campaignOnly = saved.targetAddressCount ?? saved.targetAddresses?.length ?? 0;
    const n = (saved.recipientIds?.length ?? 0) + campaignOnly;
    toast.success(
      `${updated ? 'Draft updated' : 'Draft saved'} with ${plural(n, 'recipient')}` +
        (campaignOnly > 0 ? ` (${campaignOnly.toLocaleString()} campaign-only)` : ''),
      { id: 'campaign-save' },
    );
  };

  // Set synchronously when a save or a send starts: two clicks in the same moment (before
  // the buttons re-render as disabled) must never create two campaigns.
  const inFlight = useRef(false);
  const once = <T,>(run: () => Promise<T>) => async (): Promise<T> => {
    if (inFlight.current) throw new Error('A save is already in progress.');
    inFlight.current = true;
    try {
      return await run();
    } finally {
      inFlight.current = false;
    }
  };

  const saveMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: once<{ saved: Campaign; updated: boolean }>(async () => ({
      saved: await persist(),
      updated: savedId != null,
    })),
    onSuccess: ({ saved, updated }) => {
      savedToast(saved, updated);
      onSaved(saved);
      onClose();
    },
    onError: (e: unknown) => {
      toast.error(apiErrorMessage(e, 'Could not save the campaign'), { id: 'campaign-save' });
    },
  });

  const sendMutation = useMutation({
    // Create or update the draft first, then launch it. When the launch fails, the saved
    // draft stays and savedId points at it, so "Send now" again launches the same campaign.
    mutationFn: once<Campaign>(async () => {
      const saved = await persist();
      onSaved(saved);
      try {
        return await campaignsApi.launch(saved.id);
      } catch (e) {
        throw new LaunchError(saved, e);
      }
    }),
    onSuccess: (launched) => {
      setSendError(null);
      // "Sent" means handed to the mail server; delivery to inboxes isn't tracked.
      toast.success('Campaign launched: the emails are being sent.', { id: `campaign-send-${launched.id}` });
      onSaved(launched);
      onClose();
      navigate(`/campaigns/${launched.id}`);
    },
    onError: (e: unknown) => {
      if (e instanceof LaunchError) {
        const reason = isForbidden(e.launchError)
          ? noPermissionMessage('launch campaigns')
          : apiErrorMessage(e.launchError, 'The campaign could not be launched.');
        setSendError(`${reason} The campaign was saved as a draft; sending it again launches the same campaign.`);
        toast.error(reason, { id: `campaign-send-${e.saved.id}` });
      } else {
        const reason = apiErrorMessage(e, 'Could not save the campaign, so nothing was sent.');
        setSendError(reason);
        toast.error(reason, { id: 'campaign-send' });
      }
    },
  });

  const saving = saveMutation.isPending;
  const sending = sendMutation.isPending;
  const busy = saving || sending;
  const safeClose = () => {
    if (!busy) onClose();
  };

  // ── Navigation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const validateDetails = (): boolean => {
    const next: FieldErrors = {};
    if (!form.name.trim()) next.name = 'Campaign name is required';
    else if (form.name.trim().length > 255) next.name = 'Use at most 255 characters';
    if (form.senderEmail.trim() && !isValidEmail(form.senderEmail)) next.senderEmail = 'Enter a valid email';
    if (form.replyTo.trim() && !isValidEmail(form.replyTo)) next.replyTo = 'Enter a valid email';
    setErrors(next);
    return Object.keys(next).length === 0;
  };

  const subjectProblem = validateSubject(form.subject);
  const bodyProblem = content.source === 'own' ? validateBody(content.body) : null;

  const validateContent = (): boolean => {
    setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, subject: subjectProblem ?? undefined, body: bodyProblem ?? undefined }));
    return !subjectProblem && !bodyProblem;
  };

  const goToRecipients = (e?: FormEvent) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    if (validateDetails()) setStep('recipients');
  };

  const goToReview = () => {
    if (validateContent()) {
      setConfirmSend(false);
      setSendError(null);
      setStep('review');
    } else {
      toast.error('Check the Email Content section: the subject or the email needs a fix.', { id: 'campaign-content' });
    }
  };

  const campaignOnlyOverLimit =
    !!resolved && !saveAsContacts && resolved.newAddresses.length > CAMPAIGN_ONLY_LIMIT;

  const saveBlocked =
    busy ||
    editLoad.status !== 'ready' ||
    !resolved ||
    campaignOnlyOverLimit ||
    !!subjectProblem ||
    !!bodyProblem;

  const launchInput = {
    hasContent,
    subjectOk: !subjectProblem,
    senderEmailOk: isValidEmail(form.senderEmail),
    sendableRecipients: resolved?.sendable ?? 0,
    groupCount,
  };
  const checkResults = draftLaunchChecks(launchInput);
  const readyToLaunch = checkResults.every((c) => c.ok);
  const sendAllowed = !saveBlocked && canSaveAndSend({ ...launchInput, canManage: mayManage });

  const contentHint = chosenTemplateDeleted && !ownBody
    ? 'The assigned template was deleted. Write the email or choose another template in Email Content (Recipients step).'
    : chosenTemplateLoading && !ownBody
    ? editTemplateQuery.isError
      ? "This draft's template couldn't be loaded. Go back to the Recipients step to retry, or write the email."
      : "This draft's template is still loading."
    : templateWithoutBody && !ownBody
    ? 'The selected template has no body. Write the email or choose another template in Email Content (Recipients step).'
    : 'Write the email or choose a template in Email Content (Recipients step).';
  const CHECK_TEXT: Record<LaunchCheckKey, { label: string; hint: string }> = {
    content: { label: 'Email content', hint: contentHint },
    subject: { label: 'Subject line', hint: 'Add a subject in Email Content (Recipients step).' },
    sender: { label: 'Sender email', hint: 'Add a sender email on the Details step.' },
    recipients: { label: 'At least one recipient who can be emailed', hint: 'Add recipients on the Recipients step.' },
  };

  const stepIndex = STEPS.findIndex((s) => s.key === step);
  const senderText = [form.senderName.trim(), form.senderEmail.trim() && `<${trimEmail(form.senderEmail)}>`]
    .filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'Not set';
  const contentSummary = ownBody
    ? 'Written for this campaign'
    : selectedTemplate
    ? `Template: ${selectedTemplate.name}`
    : chosenTemplateDeleted
    ? 'Deleted template'
    : 'None yet';

  const footer =
    step === 'details' ? (
      <>
        <Button variant="secondary" type="button" onClick={safeClose}>Cancel</Button>
        <Button type="submit" form="campaign-form">
          Next: Recipients <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
        </Button>
      </>
    ) : step === 'recipients' ? (
      <>
        <Button variant="secondary" type="button" onClick={() => setStep('details')}>
          <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> Back
        </Button>
        <Button type="button" onClick={goToReview} disabled={editLoad.status !== 'ready'}>
          Next: Review &amp; send <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
        </Button>
      </>
    ) : confirmSend ? (
      <>
        <Button variant="secondary" type="button" onClick={() => setConfirmSend(false)} disabled={sending}>
          <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> Back
        </Button>
        <Button type="button" loading={sending} disabled={!sendAllowed && !sending} onClick={() => sendMutation.mutate()}>
          {!sending && <Send className="h-4 w-4" />}
          {sending ? 'Sending…' : 'Send now'}
        </Button>
      </>
    ) : (
      <>
        <Button variant="secondary" type="button" onClick={() => setStep('recipients')} disabled={busy}>
          <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> Back
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" type="button" loading={saving} disabled={saveBlocked} onClick={() => saveMutation.mutate()}>
          {saving ? 'Saving…' : savedId != null ? 'Save changes' : 'Save draft'}
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          disabled={!sendAllowed}
          onClick={() => {
            setSendError(null);
            setConfirmSend(true);
          }}
          title={
            !mayManage
              ? 'Only admins and campaign managers can send campaigns.'
              : !readyToLaunch
              ? 'Complete the checklist above first.'
              : undefined
          }
        >
          <Send className="h-4 w-4" /> Save and send now
        </Button>
      </>
    );

  return (
    <>
      <Modal
        open={open}
        // While the AI dialog is open on top, Escape belongs to it, not to this form.
        onClose={aiOpen ? () => undefined : safeClose}
        widthClass="max-w-4xl"
        title={confirmSend ? 'Send this campaign now?' : isEdit ? `Edit draft: ${campaign?.name ?? ''}` : 'New Campaign'}
        description={
          confirmSend
            ? 'Check who gets it and what they get. Sending starts as soon as you confirm.'
            : step === 'details'
            ? 'Step 1 of 3: campaign name, sender and reply-to.'
            : step === 'recipients'
            ? 'Step 2 of 3: choose who gets the email, then write it in Email Content below.'
            : 'Step 3 of 3: review, then save as a draft or send now.'
        }
        footer={footer}
      >
        {/* Step indicator */}
        {!confirmSend && (
          <ol className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium">
            {STEPS.map((s, i) => (
              <li key={s.key} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {i > 0 && <span className="h-px w-6 bg-slate-200" />}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={i >= stepIndex || busy}
                  onClick={() => setStep(s.key)}
                  className={
                    step === s.key
                      ? 'text-brand-600'
                      : i < stepIndex
                      ? 'text-slate-500 hover:text-brand-600 hover:underline'
                      : 'cursor-default text-slate-400'
                  }
                >
                  {i + 1}. {s.label}
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
        )}

        {step === 'details' && (
          <form id="campaign-form" onSubmit={goToRecipients} noValidate className="space-y-4">
            {/* Name */}
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="c-name" className="label">Campaign name <span className="text-red-500">*</span></label>
              <input
                id="c-name"
                className={`input ${errors.name ? 'border-red-400 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500/10' : ''}`}
                placeholder="e.g. October Product Launch"
                value={form.name}
                maxLength={255}
                onChange={(e) => set('name', e.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={!!errors.name}
              />
              {errors.name && <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-red-600"><AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />{errors.name}</p>}
            </div>

            {/* Description */}
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="c-desc" className="label">Description</label>
              <textarea
                id="c-desc"
                className="input min-h-[72px] resize-y"
                placeholder="Internal note describing this campaign (optional, not sent)"
                value={form.description}
                onChange={(e) => set('description', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Sender row */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="c-sender-name" className="label">Sender name</label>
                <input
                  id="c-sender-name"
                  className="input"
                  placeholder="MailFlow Team"
                  value={form.senderName}
                  maxLength={255}
                  onChange={(e) => set('senderName', e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="c-sender-email" className="label">Sender email</label>
                <input
                  id="c-sender-email"
                  type="email"
                  className={`input ${errors.senderEmail ? 'border-red-400 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500/10' : ''}`}
                  placeholder="noreply@yourdomain.com"
                  value={form.senderEmail}
                  maxLength={255}
                  onChange={(e) => set('senderEmail', e.target.value)}
                  aria-invalid={!!errors.senderEmail}
                />
                {errors.senderEmail ? (
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-red-600">{errors.senderEmail}</p>
                ) : (
                  !form.senderEmail.trim() && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">Required before sending.</p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Reply-to */}
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="c-replyto" className="label">Reply-to</label>
              <input
                id="c-replyto"
                type="email"
                className={`input ${errors.replyTo ? 'border-red-400 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500/10' : ''}`}
                placeholder="support@yourdomain.com (optional)"
                value={form.replyTo}
                maxLength={255}
                onChange={(e) => set('replyTo', e.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={!!errors.replyTo}
              />
              {errors.replyTo && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-red-600">{errors.replyTo}</p>}
            </div>

            <p className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
              <Info className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              The subject and the email itself are on the next step, below the recipients.
            </p>
          </form>
        )}

        {step === 'recipients' && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
````
