````tsx
            {editLoad.status === 'loading' && (
              <p className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> Loading this draft's recipients and content…
              </p>
            )}
            {editLoad.status === 'error' && (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
                  {editLoad.message} Saving is disabled so the existing selection and content aren't replaced.
                </span>
                {campaign && (
                  <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => loadDraftRecipients(campaign)}>Retry</Button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
            {editLoad.status === 'ready' && editLoad.missing > 0 && (
              <p className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-amber-800">
                <Info className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                {plural(editLoad.missing, 'previously selected recipient')} no longer {editLoad.missing === 1 ? 'exists' : 'exist'} (deleted) and will be removed from this draft when you save.
              </p>
            )}
            {groupCount > 0 && (
              <p className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                <Info className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                This draft also targets {plural(groupCount, 'recipient group')} set up through the API. {groupCount === 1 ? 'It is' : 'They are'} kept unchanged; group members are added when the campaign launches.
              </p>
            )}
            {editLoad.status === 'ready' && selection.draft.length > 0 && (
              <p className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                <Info className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                {plural(selection.draft.length, 'campaign-only address', 'campaign-only addresses')} saved with this draft {selection.draft.length === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} in the final list below, marked "Saved with draft". Remove any you no longer want.
              </p>
            )}
            {editLoad.status === 'ready' && (
              <>
                <CampaignRecipientSelector
                  value={selection}
                  onChange={setSelection}
                  templatePlaceholders={contentPlaceholders}
                />
                <CampaignContentSection
                  templates={allTemplates}
                  templatesLoading={templatesQuery.isLoading}
                  templatesError={templatesQuery.isError ? apiErrorMessage(templatesQuery.error, '') : null}
                  deletedTemplate={
                    templateDeleted && editTemplateId
                      ? { id: editTemplateId, name: campaign?.templateName ?? 'Previous template' }
                      : null
                  }
                  unresolvedTemplate={
                    editTemplateUnresolved && editTemplateId
                      ? { id: editTemplateId, name: campaign?.templateName ?? 'Current template' }
                      : null
                  }
                  unresolvedTemplateError={
                    editTemplateQuery.isError && !templateDeleted ? apiErrorMessage(editTemplateQuery.error, '') : null
                  }
                  templateRequired={isEdit && !!editTemplateId && !templateDeleted}
                  content={content}
                  onContentChange={changeContent}
                  subject={form.subject}
                  onSubjectChange={(s) => set('subject', s)}
                  subjectError={errors.subject ?? null}
                  bodyError={errors.body ?? bodyProblem}
                  customKeys={customFieldKeys(selection)}
                  previewRecipients={combined.list}
                  onImproveWithAi={() => setAiOpen(true)}
                />
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {step === 'review' && confirmSend && resolved && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-amber-900">
              <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-amber-500" />
              <p>
                This saves the campaign and <b>sends it now</b> to{' '}
                <b>{plural(resolved.sendable, 'recipient')}</b>
                {groupCount > 0 ? ` plus the members of ${plural(groupCount, 'recipient group')}` : ''}. It can't be
                undone: once sending starts, emails that went out can't be called back.
              </p>
            </div>
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 text-sm sm:grid-cols-2">
              <SummaryItem label="Recipients to be emailed" value={resolved.sendable.toLocaleString()} />
              <SummaryItem label="Subject" value={form.subject.trim()} />
              <SummaryItem label="From (sender)" value={senderText} />
              <SummaryItem label="Content" value={contentSummary} />
            </dl>
            {(resolved.skipped.length > 0 || resolved.unsubscribed.length > 0 || resolved.blocked.length > 0) && (
              <div className="space-y-1 text-xs text-amber-700">
                {resolved.skipped.length > 0 && (
                  <p>
                    Skipped ({resolved.skipped.length}):{' '}
                    {resolved.skipped.slice(0, 5).map((s) => `${s.email} (${s.reason.toLowerCase()})`).join(', ')}
                    {resolved.skipped.length > 5 ? '…' : ''}
                  </p>
                )}
                {resolved.unsubscribed.length > 0 && (
                  <p>Not included, unsubscribed ({resolved.unsubscribed.length}): {resolved.unsubscribed.slice(0, 5).join(', ')}{resolved.unsubscribed.length > 5 ? '…' : ''}</p>
                )}
                {resolved.blocked.length > 0 && (
                  <p>Not included, deleted contacts ({resolved.blocked.length}): {resolved.blocked.slice(0, 5).join(', ')}{resolved.blocked.length > 5 ? '…' : ''}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              Only these recipients get the email: the ones you selected, uploaded or added in the table. "Sent" means
              the mail server accepted the email; delivery to each inbox isn't tracked.
            </p>
            {sendError && (
              <p role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
                {sendError}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {step === 'review' && !confirmSend && (
          <div className="space-y-5">
            {/* Summary */}
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-sm sm:grid-cols-3">
              <SummaryItem label="Campaign" value={form.name} />
              <SummaryItem label="Content" value={contentSummary} />
              <SummaryItem label="Subject" value={form.subject} />
              <SummaryItem label="Sender" value={senderText} />
              <SummaryItem label="Reply-to" value={form.replyTo || 'Not set'} />
              <SummaryItem
                label="Recipients"
                value={resolved ? resolved.final.length.toLocaleString() + (groupCount ? ` + ${plural(groupCount, 'group')}` : '') : '…'}
              />
            </dl>

            {review.status === 'loading' && (
              <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-500"><Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> Checking recipients…</p>
            )}
            {review.status === 'error' && (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
                <span>{review.message}</span>
                <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => setReviewAttempt((n) => n + 1)}>
                  Retry
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}

            {resolved && (
              <>
                {/* Launch readiness */}
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-4">
                  <p className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                    {readyToLaunch ? 'Ready to send' : 'You can save this draft now. Before sending:'}
                  </p>
                  <ul className="space-y-1.5 text-sm">
                    {checkResults.map((c) => (
                      <li key={c.key} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                        {c.ok ? (
                          <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-500" />
                        ) : (
                          <XCircle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-500" />
                        )}
                        <span className={c.ok ? 'text-slate-700' : 'text-slate-600'}>
                          {CHECK_TEXT[c.key].label}
                          {!c.ok && <span className="text-xs text-slate-400"> · {CHECK_TEXT[c.key].hint}</span>}
                        </span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-400">
                    "Save draft" never sends email. "Save and send now" saves and starts sending after you confirm
                    {mayManage ? '' : ' (only admins and campaign managers can send)'}.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Recipient breakdown */}
                <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                  <p className="text-slate-700">
                    <b>{resolved.final.length.toLocaleString()}</b> recipient{resolved.final.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}:{' '}
                    {plural(resolved.final.length - resolved.newAddresses.length, 'saved contact')},{' '}
                    {saveAsContacts
                      ? plural(resolved.newAddresses.length, 'new contact')
                      : plural(resolved.newAddresses.length, 'campaign-only address', 'campaign-only addresses')}.
                  </p>
                  {resolved.skipped.length > 0 && (
                    <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-amber-700">
                      <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                      <span>
                        {plural(resolved.skipped.length, 'selected contact')} won't be emailed and will be skipped when sending:{' '}
                        {resolved.skipped.slice(0, 3).map((s) => `${s.email} (${s.reason.toLowerCase()})`).join(', ')}
                        {resolved.skipped.length > 3 ? '…' : ''}.
                      </span>
                    </p>
                  )}
                  {resolved.blocked.length > 0 && (
                    <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-amber-700">
                      <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                      {plural(resolved.blocked.length, 'address', 'addresses')} belong{resolved.blocked.length === 1 ? 's' : ''} to deleted contacts and won't be included: {resolved.blocked.slice(0, 3).join(', ')}{resolved.blocked.length > 3 ? '…' : ''}
                    </p>
                  )}
                  {resolved.unsubscribed.length > 0 && (
                    <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-amber-700">
                      <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                      {plural(resolved.unsubscribed.length, 'address', 'addresses')} {resolved.unsubscribed.length === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} unsubscribed and won't be included: {resolved.unsubscribed.slice(0, 3).join(', ')}{resolved.unsubscribed.length > 3 ? '…' : ''}
                    </p>
                  )}
                  {unusedTableRows > 0 && (
                    <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-amber-700">
                      <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                      {plural(unusedTableRows, 'row')} of the "Add emails manually" table {unusedTableRows === 1 ? "isn't" : "aren't"} used
                      (no email, invalid email, repeated or a deleted contact). Each row shows why.
                    </p>
                  )}
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Addresses on the unsubscribe list are also skipped at send time.</p>
                </div>

                {/* New addresses: campaign-only by default, saving them as contacts is an opt-in */}
                {resolved.newAddresses.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-brand-200 bg-brand-50/60 p-4 text-sm">
                    <p className="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-brand-900">
                      <Info className="h-4 w-4" />
                      {saveAsContacts
                        ? `${plural(resolved.newAddresses.length, 'new address', 'new addresses')} will be saved as contacts`
                        : `${plural(resolved.newAddresses.length, 'new address', 'new addresses')} will be used for this campaign only`}
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-brand-800">
                      {[
                        resolved.newFromFile > 0 && `${plural(resolved.newFromFile, 'address', 'addresses')} from the uploaded file`,
                        resolved.newTyped > 0 && plural(resolved.newTyped, 'address added manually', 'addresses added manually'),
                        resolved.newStored > 0 && `${plural(resolved.newStored, 'address', 'addresses')} saved with this draft`,
                      ]
                        .filter(Boolean)
                        .join(', ')}
                      {' '}{resolved.newAddresses.length === 1 ? "isn't a saved contact" : "aren't saved contacts"}.
                    </p>
                    {!saveAsContacts && (
                      <ul className="mt-2 list-disc space-y-0.5 pl-5 text-xs text-brand-800">
                        <li>They're stored with this campaign, for sending and for its delivery history.</li>
                        <li>They're not added to your Recipients list, and other campaigns can't reuse them.</li>
                        <li>
                          If you delete the campaign, this address list is deleted with it. If it was already sent,
                          its delivery history is kept, including the address and details each email was sent with.
                        </li>
                        <li>If someone unsubscribes, the unsubscribe is kept for all campaigns.</li>
                      </ul>
                    )}
                    <p className="mt-2 max-h-16 overflow-y-auto text-xs text-brand-900">
                      {resolved.newAddresses.slice(0, 20).map((e) => e.email).join(', ')}
                      {resolved.newAddresses.length > 20 ? ` and ${(resolved.newAddresses.length - 20).toLocaleString()} more` : ''}
                    </p>
                    <label className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-brand-900">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded border-brand-300"
                        checked={saveAsContacts}
                        onChange={(e) => setSaveAsContacts(e.target.checked)}
                      />
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <UserPlus className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                        {resolved.newAddresses.length === 1
                          ? 'Also save this new address as a contact'
                          : `Also save these ${plural(resolved.newAddresses.length, 'new address', 'new addresses')} as contacts`}
                      </span>
                    </label>
                    {saveAsContacts && (
                      <p className="mt-1 pl-6 text-xs text-brand-800">
                        They're added to your Recipients list when you save the draft and stay after this campaign
                        (you can delete them on the Recipients page). Other campaigns can then select them.
                      </p>
                    )}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="mt-2 text-xs font-medium text-brand-700 underline hover:text-brand-900"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setSelection((sel) => resolved.newAddresses.reduce((acc, e) => removeAddress(acc, e.email), sel))
                      }
                    >
                      Remove the new addresses from this campaign
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Personalised preview, rendered by the server */}
                <ContentPreview
                  subject={form.subject}
                  content={content}
                  templateUnavailable={chosenTemplateDeleted ? 'The template was deleted.' : null}
                  recipients={resolved.final}
                />

                {campaignOnlyOverLimit && (
                  <p className="text-right text-xs text-red-600">
                    A campaign can use at most {CAMPAIGN_ONLY_LIMIT.toLocaleString()} campaign-only addresses. Remove some, or save them as contacts.
                  </p>
                )}
                {(subjectProblem || bodyProblem) && (
                  <p className="text-right text-xs text-red-600">
                    Fix the Email Content on the Recipients step before saving: {subjectProblem ?? bodyProblem}.
                  </p>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>

      <AiImproveModal
        open={aiOpen}
        onClose={() => setAiOpen(false)}
        initialSubject={form.subject}
        initialBody={aiBody}
        onAccept={handleAiAccept}
      />
    </>
  );
}

function SummaryItem({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2">
      <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="truncate font-medium text-slate-800" title={value}>{value || '—'}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/components/CampaignRecipientSelector.tsx

````tsx
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState, type Dispatch, type SetStateAction } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Users, FileSpreadsheet, Keyboard, X, Search, Layers, Table2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { recipientsApi } from '../api/recipients';
import {
  combineRecipients,
  keptUploadRows,
  otherSourcesOfTableRows,
  removeAddress,
  skipReason,
  SOURCE_LABEL,
  usableManualRows,
  type CombinedRecipient,
  type ManualEntry,
  type RecipientSelection,
  type UploadSelection,
} from '../lib/recipientSelection';
import { isBlankRow } from '../lib/manualTable';
import { SavedRecipientPicker } from './SavedRecipientPicker';
import { RecipientExcelUpload } from './RecipientExcelUpload';
import { ManualRecipientEntry } from './ManualRecipientEntry';

interface CampaignRecipientSelectorProps {
  value: RecipientSelection;
  /** Accepts an updater: the manual-entry table updates rows when saved-contact checks answer. */
  onChange: Dispatch<SetStateAction<RecipientSelection>>;
  /** Placeholders used by the email content (for upload column coverage). */
  templatePlaceholders?: string[];
}

type Tab = 'saved' | 'upload' | 'manual';

const LIST_PAGE = 50;

/**
 * Recipient selection with three sources that can be combined:
 * saved contacts, an uploaded Excel/CSV file, and the "Add emails manually" table (plus,
 * when a draft is edited, the campaign-only addresses stored with it).
 * The final list below the tabs is de-duplicated by email address.
 */
export function CampaignRecipientSelector({ value, onChange, templatePlaceholders }: CampaignRecipientSelectorProps) {
  const [chosenTab, setChosenTab] = useState<Tab | null>(null);
  // "Fill in a table" on the upload panel shows the manual-entry table below it.
  const [tableInUpload, setTableInUpload] = useState(false);

  // Default tab: manual entry when the table already has rows or there are no saved
  // contacts to pick from; saved contacts otherwise.
  const activeContacts = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['recipients', 'active-count'],
    queryFn: () => recipientsApi.list({ status: 'ACTIVE', size: 1 }),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
  const tableHasRows = value.manual.some((r) => !isBlankRow(r));
  const defaultTab: Tab =
    tableHasRows || (activeContacts.data && activeContacts.data.totalElements === 0) ? 'manual' : 'saved';
  const tab = chosenTab ?? defaultTab;

  const setManual = useCallback(
    (update: (rows: ManualEntry[]) => ManualEntry[]) => onChange((sel) => ({ ...sel, manual: update(sel.manual) })),
    [onChange],
  );
  const setSaved = useCallback(
    (saved: RecipientSelection['saved']) => onChange((sel) => ({ ...sel, saved })),
    [onChange],
  );
  const setUpload = useCallback(
    (upload: UploadSelection | null) => onChange((sel) => ({ ...sel, upload })),
    [onChange],
  );

  const { list, mergedDuplicates } = useMemo(() => combineRecipients(value), [value]);
  const otherSources = useMemo(() => otherSourcesOfTableRows(value), [value]);
  const counts = {
    saved: Object.keys(value.saved).length,
    upload: keptUploadRows(value.upload).length,
    manual: usableManualRows(value.manual).length,
  };

  const tabs: { key: Tab; label: string; icon: React.ElementType; count: number }[] = [
    { key: 'saved', label: 'Saved contacts', icon: Users, count: counts.saved },
    { key: 'upload', label: 'Upload file', icon: FileSpreadsheet, count: counts.upload },
    { key: 'manual', label: 'Add emails manually', icon: Keyboard, count: counts.manual },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <div role="tablist" aria-label="Recipient sources" className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 p-1">
        {tabs.map(({ key, label, icon: Icon, count }) => (
          <button
            key={key}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={tab === key}
            onClick={() => setChosenTab(key)}
            className={`flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition ${
              tab === key ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'
            }`}
          >
            <Icon className="h-4 w-4" /> {label}
            {count > 0 && (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-brand-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-700">
                {count.toLocaleString()}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Panels stay mounted so in-progress input (search text, table rows, pasted text) survives tab switches. */}
      <div className={tab === 'saved' ? '' : 'hidden'}>
        <SavedRecipientPicker selected={value.saved} onChange={setSaved} />
      </div>
      <div className={tab === 'upload' ? 'space-y-4' : 'hidden'}>
        <RecipientExcelUpload
          value={value.upload}
          onChange={setUpload}
          templatePlaceholders={templatePlaceholders}
          onFillTable={() => setTableInUpload(true)}
        />
        {tableInUpload && (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <h4 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                <Table2 className="h-4 w-4 text-brand-500" /> Fill in a table
              </h4>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700"
                onClick={() => setTableInUpload(false)}
              >
                Hide table
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              The same columns as the template: Email, Name and Company. These rows are the same as on the
              "Add emails manually" tab.
            </p>
            <ManualRecipientEntry rows={value.manual} onChange={setManual} otherSources={otherSources} />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className={tab === 'manual' ? '' : 'hidden'}>
        <ManualRecipientEntry rows={value.manual} onChange={setManual} otherSources={otherSources} />
      </div>

      <CombinedRecipientList
        list={list}
        mergedDuplicates={mergedDuplicates}
        onRemove={(email) => onChange((sel) => removeAddress(sel, email))}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function CombinedRecipientList({
  list,
  mergedDuplicates,
  onRemove,
}: {
  list: CombinedRecipient[];
  mergedDuplicates: number;
  onRemove: (email: string) => void;
}) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(LIST_PAGE);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return list;
    return list.filter(
      (r) =>
        r.email.includes(q) ||
        (r.name ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        [r.firstName, r.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (r.company ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q),
    );
  }, [list, query]);

  const saved = list.filter((r) => r.recipientId != null).length;
  // Addresses that aren't saved contacts are used for this campaign only, unless
  // the user chooses on the Review step to save them as contacts.
  const campaignOnly = list.length - saved;
  const inactive = list.filter((r) => skipReason(r.status) !== null).length;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Layers className="h-4 w-4 text-brand-500" />
          <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
            Final recipient list: {list.length.toLocaleString()}
          </h4>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 text-xs">
          <span className="badge bg-brand-50 text-brand-700">{saved.toLocaleString()} saved contacts</span>
          <span
            className="badge bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"
            title="Not saved as contacts: used for this campaign only unless you save them as contacts on the Review step"
          >
            {campaignOnly.toLocaleString()} campaign-only
          </span>
          {inactive > 0 && <span className="badge bg-amber-50 text-amber-700">{inactive} will be skipped</span>}
        </div>
      </div>

      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-sm text-slate-400">
          No recipients yet. Select saved contacts, upload a file or add emails manually. You can also save the draft now and add recipients later.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="space-y-2 px-4 pt-3">
            {mergedDuplicates > 0 && (
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                {mergedDuplicates.toLocaleString()} address{mergedDuplicates === 1 ? '' : 'es'} came from more than one source and {mergedDuplicates === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} listed once. Each address is emailed at most once.
              </p>
            )}
            {list.length > 10 && (
              <div className="relative max-w-xs">
                <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
                <input
                  className="input py-1.5 pl-8 text-xs"
                  placeholder="Find in list…"
                  value={query}
                  onChange={(e) => { setQuery(e.target.value); setVisible(LIST_PAGE); }}
                  aria-label="Find in final recipient list"
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-2">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {filtered.slice(0, visible).map((r) => (
                  <tr key={r.email}>
                    <td className="py-2 pr-3">
                      <p className="font-medium text-slate-700">{r.email}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                        {[r.name || [r.firstName, r.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' '), r.company].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || '—'}
                      </p>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2 pr-3">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                        {r.sources.map((s) => (
                          <span key={s} className="rounded bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] text-slate-600">{SOURCE_LABEL[s]}</span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2 pr-3 text-xs">
                      {r.recipientId != null ? (
                        skipReason(r.status)
                          ? <span className="text-amber-700" title="Skipped when sending">{skipReason(r.status)}: won't be emailed</span>
                          : <span className="text-brand-700">Saved contact</span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-emerald-700" title="Not saved as a contact">Campaign-only</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2 text-right">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onRemove(r.email)}
                        className="text-slate-300 transition hover:text-red-500"
                        aria-label={`Remove ${r.email} from this campaign`}
                        title="Remove from this campaign"
                      >
                        <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            {filtered.length > visible && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg bg-slate-50 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-brand-600 hover:bg-slate-100"
                onClick={() => setVisible((v) => v + LIST_PAGE * 2)}
              >
                Show more ({(filtered.length - visible).toLocaleString()} remaining)
              </button>
            )}
            {filtered.length === 0 && (
              <p className="py-4 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">No recipients match “{query}”.</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/components/DeleteCampaignModal.tsx

````tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { AlertTriangle, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { campaignsApi } from '../api/campaigns';
import type { Campaign } from '../types';
import { Button, Modal } from './ui';
import { campaignOnlyCount } from '../lib/campaignChecks';
import { apiErrorMessage, apiErrorStatus, isForbidden } from '../lib/errors';
import { noPermissionMessage } from '../lib/roles';

/**
 * Queries whose data a deleted campaign changes: the campaign lists (CampaignsPage's
 * ['campaigns', search] and DashboardPage's ['campaigns', 'dashboard-recent']), campaign
 * detail and analytics, and the totals and charts of DashboardPage and AnalyticsPage.
 */
const AFFECTED_QUERY_KEYS = [
  ['campaigns'],
  ['campaign'],
  ['campaign-analytics'],
  ['dashboard-summary'],
  ['daily-volume'],
  ['daily-volume-30'],
];

function deleteErrorMessage(e: unknown): string {
  if (isForbidden(e)) return noPermissionMessage('delete campaigns');
  if (apiErrorStatus(e) === 404) return 'This campaign no longer exists. It may have been deleted already.';
  // A 409 carries the server's reason, for example that the campaign is still sending.
  return apiErrorMessage(e, 'Could not delete the campaign. Please try again.');
}

interface DeleteCampaignModalProps {
  /** The campaign to delete; the dialog is open while this is set. */
  campaign: Campaign | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  /** Called once the server has deleted the campaign (for example to leave its page). */
  onDeleted?: (campaign: Campaign) => void;
}

/**
 * Confirms and performs a campaign delete (a soft delete on the server). While the
 * request runs the dialog can't be closed. On failure the campaign stays on screen and
 * the server's reason is shown in the dialog and in a toast.
 */
export function DeleteCampaignModal({ campaign, onClose, onDeleted }: DeleteCampaignModalProps) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const refresh = () => AFFECTED_QUERY_KEYS.forEach((queryKey) => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey }));

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (c: Campaign) => campaignsApi.delete(c.id),
    onSuccess: (_res, c) => {
      // Same toast id for success and failure: repeated attempts replace each other.
      toast.success(`Campaign "${c.name}" deleted.`, { id: `campaign-delete-${c.id}` });
      setError(null);
      onDeleted?.(c);
      onClose();
      // Its own queries would now answer 404: drop them instead of refetching.
      qc.removeQueries({ queryKey: ['campaign', c.id] });
      qc.removeQueries({ queryKey: ['campaign-analytics', c.id] });
      refresh();
    },
    onError: (e, c) => {
      const message = deleteErrorMessage(e);
      setError(message);
      toast.error(message, { id: `campaign-delete-${c.id}` });
      // Already gone: refresh so it disappears. Any other failure keeps it on screen.
      if (apiErrorStatus(e) === 404) refresh();
    },
  });

  const pending = mutation.isPending;
  const close = () => {
    if (pending) return; // no closing while the delete is running
    setError(null);
    mutation.reset();
    onClose();
  };

  const onlyCount = campaign ? campaignOnlyCount(campaign) : 0;

  return (
    <Modal
      open={!!campaign}
      onClose={close}
      title="Delete this campaign?"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={close} disabled={pending}>
            Keep campaign
          </Button>
          <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => campaign && mutation.mutate(campaign)} loading={pending}>
            {!pending && <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />}
            {pending ? 'Deleting…' : 'Delete campaign'}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      {campaign && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3">
            <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-red-500" />
            <p className="text-sm text-red-800">
              <b>{campaign.name}</b> will be deleted. This can't be undone in MailFlow.
            </p>
          </div>
          <ul className="list-disc space-y-1.5 pl-5 text-sm text-slate-600">
            <li>
              It's hidden from the campaign list, search, the dashboard and the statistics, and it can no longer be
              opened, edited or sent.
            </li>
            <li>
              Its delivery history is kept: any emails it already sent, their results and unsubscribe requests stay
              recorded.
            </li>
            <li>Contacts, groups and templates are not changed.</li>
            {onlyCount > 0 && (
              <li>
                Its list of {onlyCount.toLocaleString()} campaign-only address{onlyCount === 1 ? '' : 'es'} is deleted.
              </li>
            )}
          </ul>
          {error && (
            <p role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx

````tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Outlet, NavLink, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  LayoutDashboard, Send, Users, FileText, BarChart3, LogOut, Menu, X, UserCog,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuthStore } from '../store/authStore';
import clsx from 'clsx';

const NAV_ITEMS = [
  { path: '/dashboard',  label: 'Dashboard',  icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { path: '/campaigns',  label: 'Campaigns',  icon: Send },
  { path: '/recipients', label: 'Recipients', icon: Users },
  { path: '/templates',  label: 'Templates',  icon: FileText },
  { path: '/analytics',  label: 'Analytics',  icon: BarChart3 },
];

const PAGE_TITLES: Record<string, string> = {
  '/dashboard': 'Dashboard',
  '/campaigns': 'Campaigns',
  '/recipients': 'Recipients',
  '/templates': 'Templates',
  '/analytics': 'Analytics',
  '/team': 'Team',
};

/** Shown to company admins only; the server also restricts /api/team to ADMIN. */
const ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS = [
  { path: '/team', label: 'Team', icon: UserCog },
];

function initials(first?: string, last?: string): string {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ''}${last?.[0] ?? ''}`.toUpperCase() || 'U';
}

// Role precedence (highest privilege first). The backend may return the user's
// roles in any order, so we display the highest-privilege role the user holds
// rather than whichever role happens to be first in the array.
const ROLE_PRECEDENCE = ['ADMIN', 'CAMPAIGN_MANAGER', 'VIEWER'];

function primaryRole(roles?: string[]): string {
  if (!roles || roles.length === 0) return 'User';
  for (const role of ROLE_PRECEDENCE) {
    if (roles.includes(role)) return role;
  }
  return roles[0];
}

function SidebarContent({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate?: () => void }) {
  const { user, roles, logout } = useAuthStore();
  const navItems = roles.includes('ADMIN') ? [...NAV_ITEMS, ...ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS] : NAV_ITEMS;

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col">
      {/* Brand */}
      <div className="flex h-16 items-center gap-3 border-b border-slate-200 px-6">
        <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-600 to-accent-600 shadow-sm">
          <Send className="h-5 w-5 text-white" />
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <span className="block text-lg font-bold leading-tight tracking-tight text-slate-900">MailFlow</span>
          {user?.organizationName && (
            <span className="block truncate text-xs text-slate-500" title={user.organizationName}>{user.organizationName}</span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Nav */}
      <nav className="flex-1 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto px-3 py-4">
        <p className="px-3 pb-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
          Menu
        </p>
        {navItems.map(({ path, label, icon: Icon }) => (
          <NavLink
            key={path}
            to={path}
            onClick={onNavigate}
            className={({ isActive }) =>
              clsx('nav-link', isActive ? 'nav-link-active' : 'nav-link-idle')
            }
          >
            <Icon className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
            {label}
          </NavLink>
        ))}
      </nav>

      {/* User */}
      {user && (
        <div className="border-t border-slate-200 p-3">
          <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2.5">
            <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-500 to-accent-500 text-xs font-semibold text-white">
              {initials(user.firstName, user.lastName)}
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                {user.firstName} {user.lastName}
              </p>
              <p className="truncate text-xs text-slate-500">{user.email}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={logout} className="nav-link nav-link-idle w-full">
            <LogOut className="h-5 w-5" />
            Sign out
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Layout() {
  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);
  const location = useLocation();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();

  const title =
    PAGE_TITLES[location.pathname] ??
    (location.pathname.startsWith('/campaigns/') ? 'Campaign Detail' : 'MailFlow');

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen overflow-hidden bg-slate-50">
      {/* ── Desktop sidebar ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <aside className="hidden w-64 shrink-0 border-r border-slate-200 bg-white lg:block">
        <SidebarContent />
      </aside>

      {/* ── Mobile sidebar (drawer) ─────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {mobileOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40 lg:hidden">
          <div
            className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-sm"
            onClick={() => setMobileOpen(false)}
            aria-hidden
          />
          <div className="absolute left-0 top-0 h-full w-64 animate-scale-in border-r border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-elevated">
            <SidebarContent onNavigate={() => setMobileOpen(false)} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Main column ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
        {/* Topbar */}
        <header className="flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 bg-white/80 px-4 backdrop-blur sm:px-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              className="btn-icon text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 lg:hidden"
              onClick={() => setMobileOpen(true)}
              aria-label="Open menu"
            >
              <Menu className="h-5 w-5" />
            </button>
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 lg:text-base">{title}</h2>
          </div>

          {user && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="hidden text-right sm:block">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">
                  {user.firstName} {user.lastName}
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  {primaryRole(user.roles)}{user.organizationName ? ` · ${user.organizationName}` : ''}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-500 to-accent-500 text-xs font-semibold text-white">
                {initials(user.firstName, user.lastName)}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </header>

        {/* Mobile menu close button overlay helper */}
        {mobileOpen && (
          <button
            className="fixed right-4 top-4 z-50 btn-icon bg-white text-slate-600 shadow-card lg:hidden"
            onClick={() => setMobileOpen(false)}
            aria-label="Close menu"
          >
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        )}

        {/* Routed content */}
        <main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
          <Outlet />
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/components/ManualRecipientEntry.tsx

````tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ClipboardEvent, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import clsx from 'clsx';
import {
  AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, ClipboardList, Copy, Info, Loader2, MailX, Plus, RotateCcw, UserCheck, UserPlus, X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { recipientsApi } from '../api/recipients';
import {
  isValidEmail,
  MANUAL_LIMIT,
  normalizeEmail,
  parseAddressList,
  SOURCE_LABEL,
  type ManualCheck,
  type ManualEntry,
  type RecipientSource,
} from '../lib/recipientSelection';
import {
  appendPosition,
  blankRows,
  INITIAL_ROWS,
  manualRowStatuses,
  manualTableSummary,
  newRow,
  normalizeRow,
  parsePastedRows,
  placeRows,
  TABLE_COLUMNS,
  type ManualRowStatus,
  type PastedRow,
} from '../lib/manualTable';
import { apiErrorMessage } from '../lib/errors';
import { Button } from './ui';

type Column = 'email' | 'name' | 'company';
const COLUMN_KEYS: Column[] = ['email', 'name', 'company'];

interface ManualRecipientEntryProps {
  rows: ManualEntry[];
  /** Updates the rows from their latest value (saved-contact checks answer later). */
  onChange: (update: (rows: ManualEntry[]) => ManualEntry[]) => void;
  /** Other sources that also supply an address of the table; it is still emailed once. */
  otherSources?: Map<string, RecipientSource[]>;
}

interface PasteReport {
  added: number;
  invalid: string[];
  alreadyInTable: number;
  repeats: number;
  overLimit: number;
}

function statusBadge(s: ManualRowStatus, checking: boolean) {
  switch (s.state) {
    case 'saved':
      return <span className="badge bg-brand-50 text-brand-700"><UserCheck className="h-3 w-3" /> {s.label}</span>;
    case 'new':
      return <span className="badge bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"><UserPlus className="h-3 w-3" /> {s.label}</span>;
    case 'skipped':
      return <span className="badge bg-amber-50 text-amber-700"><MailX className="h-3 w-3" /> {s.label}</span>;
    case 'repeated':
      return <span className="badge bg-amber-50 text-amber-700"><Copy className="h-3 w-3" /> {s.label}</span>;
    case 'invalid':
    case 'missing':
    case 'deleted':
      return <span className="badge bg-red-50 text-red-700"><AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" /> {s.label}</span>;
    case 'checking':
      return (
        <span className="badge bg-slate-100 text-slate-500">
          {checking ? <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" /> : null} {checking ? 'Checking…' : 'Not checked yet'}
        </span>
      );
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/**
 * The "Add emails manually" table: Email (required), Name and Company, one recipient
 * per row. Each email is normalised and validated when its cell loses focus (the same
 * rules as the paste box and the backend) and looked up among the saved contacts
 * (read-only): saved contacts are reused with their status respected, other addresses are
 * campaign-only unless the user saves them as contacts on the Review step. Empty, invalid
 * and repeated rows show why on the row and stay out of the final list.
 *
 * Tab moves to the next cell; Enter moves to the next row (adding one at the end). Rows
 * copied from Excel or Google Sheets can be pasted into any cell; "Paste a list" takes
 * addresses separated by commas, semicolons, spaces or new lines.
 */
export function ManualRecipientEntry({ rows, onChange, otherSources }: ManualRecipientEntryProps) {
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set());
  const [checkError, setCheckError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showPaste, setShowPaste] = useState(false);
  const [pasteText, setPasteText] = useState('');
  const [report, setReport] = useState<PasteReport | null>(null);

  // The latest rows, for event handlers that run after an await.
  const latest = useRef(rows);
  latest.current = rows;
  const cells = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLInputElement>());
  const focusTarget = useRef<{ index: number; column: Column } | null>(null);

  // The table always has rows to type into: it starts with INITIAL_ROWS empty rows.
  const empty = rows.length === 0;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (empty) onChange((prev) => (prev.length > 0 ? prev : blankRows(INITIAL_ROWS)));
  }, [empty, onChange]);

  // Move the focus once the row it goes to has been rendered.
  useEffect(() => {
    const target = focusTarget.current;
    if (!target) return;
    const row = rows[target.index];
    if (!row) return;
    focusTarget.current = null;
    cells.current.get(`${row.id}:${target.column}`)?.focus();
  }, [rows]);

  const statuses = useMemo(() => manualRowStatuses(rows), [rows]);
  const summary = useMemo(() => manualTableSummary(statuses), [statuses]);

  /** Looks up addresses among the saved contacts (read-only) and stores the result on every row that has them. */
  const check = async (addresses: string[]) => {
    const emails = Array.from(new Set(addresses.map(normalizeEmail).filter((e) => isValidEmail(e))));
    if (emails.length === 0) return;
    setPending((p) => new Set([...p, ...emails]));
    try {
      const res = await recipientsApi.lookup({ emails });
      const contacts = new Map(res.recipients.map((r) => [normalizeEmail(r.email), r]));
      const deleted = new Set(res.deletedEmails.map(normalizeEmail));
      const unsubscribed = new Set((res.unsubscribedEmails ?? []).map(normalizeEmail));
      const results = new Map<string, ManualCheck>(
        emails.map((e) => [e, {
          email: e,
          contact: contacts.get(e),
          deleted: deleted.has(e),
          unsubscribed: unsubscribed.has(e),
        }]),
      );
      onChange((prev) =>
        prev.map((r) => {
          const result = results.get(normalizeEmail(r.email));
          return result ? { ...r, check: result } : r;
        }),
      );
      setCheckError(null);
    } catch (e) {
      setCheckError(
        apiErrorMessage(e, "Couldn't check whether these addresses are saved contacts.") +
          ' The Review step checks them again before anything is saved.',
      );
    } finally {
      setPending((p) => {
        const next = new Set(p);
        emails.forEach((e) => next.delete(e));
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  const setCell = (id: string, column: Column, value: string) =>
    onChange((prev) => prev.map((r) => (r.id === id ? { ...r, [column]: value } : r)));

  const onEmailBlur = (id: string) => {
    const row = latest.current.find((r) => r.id === id);
    if (!row) return;
    const normalized = normalizeRow(row);
    if (normalized !== row) onChange((prev) => prev.map((r) => (r.id === id ? normalizeRow(r) : r)));
    const email = normalizeEmail(normalized.email);
    const upToDate = normalized.check && normalized.check.email === email;
    if (isValidEmail(email) && !upToDate) void check([email]);
  };

  const insertRows = (pasted: PastedRow[], at: number): PasteReport => {
    // Pasted cells get the same normalisation as a typed cell that loses focus.
    const incoming = pasted.map((p) => {
      const r = normalizeRow({ id: '', email: p.email, name: p.name, company: p.company });
      return { email: r.email, name: r.name, company: r.company };
    });
    const inTable = new Set(latest.current.map((r) => normalizeEmail(r.email)).filter(Boolean));
    const fresh = incoming.filter((r) => !inTable.has(normalizeEmail(r.email)) || !r.email.trim());
    const preview = placeRows(latest.current, at, fresh);
    onChange((prev) => placeRows(prev, at, fresh).rows);
    void check(fresh.map((r) => r.email));
    return {
      added: preview.placed.length,
      invalid: [],
      alreadyInTable: incoming.length - fresh.length,
      repeats: 0,
      overLimit: preview.overLimit,
    };
  };

  const onCellPaste = (e: ClipboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>, index: number) => {
    const text = e.clipboardData.getData('text/plain');
    const pasted = parsePastedRows(text);
    if (pasted) {
      e.preventDefault();
      // Rows from a spreadsheet: one table row each, starting at this row.
      setReport(insertRows(pasted, index));
      return;
    }
    const list = parseAddressList(text);
    if (list.entries.length > 1) {
      // Several addresses in one line (commas, semicolons, spaces): one row each.
      e.preventDefault();
      const r = insertRows(list.entries.map((x) => ({ email: x.email, name: x.name ?? '', company: '' })), index);
      setReport({ ...r, invalid: list.invalid, repeats: list.duplicates });
    }
  };

  const addRow = () => {
    if (rows.length >= MANUAL_LIMIT) return;
    focusTarget.current = { index: rows.length, column: 'email' };
    onChange((prev) => (prev.length >= MANUAL_LIMIT ? prev : [...prev, newRow()]));
  };

  const onCellKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>, index: number) => {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter' || e.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;
    // Enter: next row, email column (a new row at the end), like finishing a row in a spreadsheet.
    e.preventDefault();
    if (index + 1 < rows.length) {
      cells.current.get(`${rows[index + 1].id}:email`)?.focus();
    } else {
      addRow();
    }
  };

  const removeRow = (id: string) =>
    onChange((prev) => {
      const next = prev.filter((r) => r.id !== id);
      return next.length > 0 ? next : blankRows(1);
    });

  const clearTable = () => {
    if (!window.confirm('Remove every row from this table?')) return;
    onChange(() => blankRows(INITIAL_ROWS));
    setReport(null);
  };

  const addPastedList = () => {
    const parsed = parseAddressList(pasteText);
    const r = insertRows(
      parsed.entries.map((x) => ({ email: x.email, name: x.name ?? '', company: '' })),
      appendPosition(latest.current),
    );
    setReport({ ...r, invalid: parsed.invalid, repeats: parsed.duplicates });
    // Keep only the entries that need fixing in the box.
    setPasteText(parsed.invalid.join('\n'));
  };

  const retryChecks = () => void check(latest.current.map((r) => r.email));

  const placeholders: Record<Column, string> = { email: 'name@company.com', name: 'Optional', company: 'Optional' };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
        <table className="w-full min-w-[40rem] text-left text-sm">
          <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">
            <tr>
              <th className="w-10 px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium">#</th>
              {TABLE_COLUMNS.map((c) => (
                <th key={c} className="px-2 py-2 font-medium">
                  {c}
                  {c === 'Email' && <span className="text-red-500"> *</span>}
                </th>
              ))}
              <th className="px-2 py-2 font-medium">Status</th>
              <th className="w-10 px-2 py-2"><span className="sr-only">Remove</span></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
            {rows.map((r, index) => {
              const s = statuses[index];
              const email = normalizeEmail(r.email);
              const also = otherSources?.get(email);
              const emailError = s.state === 'invalid' || s.state === 'missing';
              return (
                <tr key={r.id} className={clsx(s.state === 'repeated' && 'bg-amber-50/40')}>
                  <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right text-xs tabular-nums text-slate-400">{index + 1}</td>
                  {COLUMN_KEYS.map((column, ci) => (
                    <td key={column} className="px-2 py-1.5">
                      <input
                        ref={(el) => {
                          const key = `${r.id}:${column}`;
                          if (el) cells.current.set(key, el);
                          else cells.current.delete(key);
                        }}
                        type="text"
                        inputMode={column === 'email' ? 'email' : undefined}
                        autoComplete="off"
                        spellCheck={false}
                        className={clsx(
                          'input py-1.5 text-xs',
                          column === 'email' && emailError && 'border-red-400 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500/10',
                        )}
                        value={r[column]}
                        maxLength={column === 'email' ? 320 : 255}
                        placeholder={index === 0 || column === 'email' ? placeholders[column] : undefined}
                        aria-label={`${TABLE_COLUMNS[ci]}, row ${index + 1}`}
                        aria-invalid={column === 'email' && emailError ? true : undefined}
                        onChange={(e) => setCell(r.id, column, e.target.value)}
                        onBlur={column === 'email' ? () => onEmailBlur(r.id) : undefined}
                        onKeyDown={(e) => onCellKeyDown(e, index)}
                        onPaste={(e) => onCellPaste(e, index)}
                      />
                      {column !== 'email' && s.contact && (
                        <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-slate-400" title="Saved contacts keep their saved details">
                          Saved: {(column === 'name'
                            ? s.contact.name || [s.contact.firstName, s.contact.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
                            : s.contact.company) || '—'}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  ))}
                  <td className="px-2 py-1.5" title={s.detail}>
                    {statusBadge(s, pending.has(email))}
                    {s.detail && s.state !== 'new' && s.state !== 'saved' && (
                      <p className="mt-0.5 max-w-[14rem] text-[11px] leading-snug text-slate-400">{s.detail}</p>
                    )}
                    {also && s.state !== 'repeated' && (
                      <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-amber-700" title="It is emailed once">
                        Repeated: also in {also.map((x) => SOURCE_LABEL[x].toLowerCase()).join(', ')}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => removeRow(r.id)}
                      className="text-slate-300 transition hover:text-red-500"
                      aria-label={`Remove row ${index + 1}`}
                      title="Remove this row"
                    >
                      <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={addRow} disabled={rows.length >= MANUAL_LIMIT}>
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> Add row
            </Button>
            <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setShowPaste((v) => !v)} aria-expanded={showPaste}>
              <ClipboardList className="h-4 w-4" /> Paste a list
            </Button>
            {rows.some((r) => r.email.trim() || r.name.trim() || r.company.trim()) && (
              <button type="button" className="font-medium text-red-600 hover:underline" onClick={clearTable}>
                Clear table
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          <span>
            <b className="text-slate-700">{summary.ready.toLocaleString()}</b> ready ({summary.saved} saved, {summary.fresh} new)
            {summary.skipped > 0 && ` · ${summary.skipped} will be skipped`}
            {summary.unused > 0 && ` · ${summary.unused} not used`}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {checkError && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-amber-800">
          <span className="flex items-start gap-2"><AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" /> {checkError}</span>
          <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={retryChecks}>
            <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Check again
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {showPaste && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3">
          <label htmlFor="manual-paste" className="label">Paste a list of addresses</label>
          <textarea
            id="manual-paste"
            className="input min-h-[80px] resize-y font-mono text-xs"
            placeholder={'ada@example.com, alan@example.com; grace@example.com\nAda Lovelace <ada@example.com>'}
            value={pasteText}
            onChange={(e) => setPasteText(e.target.value)}
          />
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Separate addresses with commas, semicolons, spaces or new lines. Each becomes a row in the table.
            </p>
            <Button type="button" size="sm" onClick={addPastedList} disabled={!pasteText.trim()}>
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> Add to table
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {report && (
        <div className="space-y-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" /> Added {report.added} row{report.added === 1 ? '' : 's'}.
          </p>
          {report.invalid.length > 0 && (
            <p className="text-red-600">
              Not valid email addresses ({report.invalid.length}), not added: {report.invalid.slice(0, 5).join(', ')}
              {report.invalid.length > 5 ? '…' : ''}
            </p>
          )}
          {report.repeats > 0 && <p>{report.repeats} repeated address{report.repeats === 1 ? ' was' : 'es were'} added once.</p>}
          {report.alreadyInTable > 0 && <p>{report.alreadyInTable} already in the table.</p>}
          {report.overLimit > 0 && (
            <p className="text-amber-700">{report.overLimit} not added: the table holds at most {MANUAL_LIMIT.toLocaleString()} rows. Upload a file for larger lists.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <p className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
        <Info className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-slate-400" />
        <span>
          Only these rows (and any other source you select) receive the email. Addresses that already belong to saved
          contacts reuse those contacts, and unsubscribed contacts are skipped. Other addresses are used for this
          campaign only: they're stored with the campaign and aren't added to your Recipients list. On the Review step
          you can choose to also save them as contacts. Tip: rows copied from Excel or Google Sheets (Email, Name,
          Company) can be pasted into any cell.
        </span>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/components/RecipientExcelUpload.tsx

````tsx
import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import {
  UploadCloud, FileSpreadsheet, Download, X, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, Copy, Loader2,
  UserCheck, RotateCcw, Columns3, Info, MailX, Table2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  recipientsApi,
  UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES,
  UPLOAD_MAX_ROWS,
  type ColumnMapping,
  type ExcelPreviewResponse,
  type ExcelRowPreview,
} from '../api/recipients';
import {
  KNOWN_CUSTOM_FIELDS,
  keptUploadRows,
  placeholdersForTarget,
  suggestCustomKey,
  targetLabel,
  type UploadSelection,
} from '../lib/recipientSelection';
import { apiErrorMessage } from '../lib/errors';
import { Button } from './ui';

interface RecipientExcelUploadProps {
  /** Current upload (file + preview + mapping + removed rows), owned by the parent. */
  value: UploadSelection | null;
  onChange: (next: UploadSelection | null) => void;
  /** Placeholders used by the email content, to show which ones the file fills. */
  templatePlaceholders?: string[];
  /** "Fill in a table": shows the manual-entry table (the template's columns) instead of a file. */
  onFillTable?: () => void;
}

const ACCEPT = '.xlsx,.xls,.csv';
const PAGE = 25;
const MAX_VISIBLE = 500;
const STANDARD_TARGETS = ['email', 'name', 'firstName', 'lastName', 'company'];

type RowFilter = 'all' | 'used' | 'problems' | 'removed';

function statusPill(row: ExcelRowPreview, removed: boolean) {
  if (removed) {
    return <span className="badge bg-slate-100 text-slate-500"><X className="h-3 w-3" /> Removed</span>;
  }
  switch (row.status) {
    case 'VALID':
      return <span className="badge bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"><CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" /> New address</span>;
    case 'EXISTING':
      return <span className="badge bg-brand-50 text-brand-700"><UserCheck className="h-3 w-3" /> Saved contact</span>;
    case 'SKIPPED':
      // The reason (e.g. "Unsubscribed: …") is shown under the pill.
      return <span className="badge bg-slate-100 text-slate-600"><MailX className="h-3 w-3" /> Won't be emailed</span>;
    case 'DUPLICATE':
      return <span className="badge bg-amber-50 text-amber-700"><Copy className="h-3 w-3" /> Duplicate</span>;
    default:
      return <span className="badge bg-red-50 text-red-700"><AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" /> Invalid</span>;
  }
}

export function RecipientExcelUpload({ value, onChange, templatePlaceholders = [], onFillTable }: RecipientExcelUploadProps) {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const [pendingName, setPendingName] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<RowFilter>('all');
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(PAGE);
  const [showColumns, setShowColumns] = useState(false);

  const previewMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (args: { file: File; mapping: ColumnMapping }) =>
      recipientsApi.previewUpload(args.file, args.mapping),
    onSuccess: (preview, args) => {
      setError(null);
      // Row numbers are stable for the same file, so removals survive a mapping change.
      const sameFile = !!value && value.file === args.file;
      onChange({
        file: args.file,
        preview,
        mapping: args.mapping,
        removedRows: sameFile && value ? value.removedRows : [],
      });
      if (!sameFile) {
        setFilter('all');
        setVisible(PAGE);
        // Open the column panel straight away when the email column wasn't found.
        setShowColumns(!preview.hasEmailColumn);
      }
      // validRows counts every address that can be emailed: new ones and saved contacts.
      const usable = preview.validRows;
      if (!preview.hasEmailColumn) {
        toast.error('No email column was found. Choose which column holds the email addresses.', { id: 'upload-preview' });
      } else if (usable === 0) {
        toast('No usable addresses in this file.', { id: 'upload-preview', icon: '⚠️' });
      } else {
        toast.success(
          `${usable.toLocaleString()} valid address${usable === 1 ? '' : 'es'} ready from ${preview.fileName} ` +
            `(${preview.newRows.toLocaleString()} new, ${preview.existingRows.toLocaleString()} saved)`,
          { id: 'upload-preview' },
        );
      }
    },
    onError: (e: unknown) => {
      const msg = apiErrorMessage(e, 'Could not read that file. Make sure it is a valid .xlsx, .xls or .csv file.');
      setError(msg);
      toast.error(msg, { id: 'upload-preview' });
    },
  });

  const handleFile = useCallback(
    (file: File) => {
      const name = file.name.toLowerCase();
      if (!['.xlsx', '.xls', '.csv'].some((ext) => name.endsWith(ext))) {
        setError('Unsupported file type. Use .xlsx, .xls or .csv.');
        return;
      }
      if (file.size === 0) {
        setError('This file is empty.');
        return;
      }
      if (file.size > UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES) {
        setError('This file is larger than 5 MB. Upload a smaller file.');
        return;
      }
      setError(null);
      setPendingName(file.name);
      previewMutation.mutate({ file, mapping: {} });
    },
    [previewMutation],
  );

  const onDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragging(false);
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0];
    if (file) handleFile(file);
  };

  const changeMapping = (header: string, target: string) => {
    if (!value) return;
    const mapping: ColumnMapping = { ...value.mapping, [header]: target };
    // One column per field: release the field from any other explicitly mapped column.
    if (target !== 'ignore') {
      for (const [h, t] of Object.entries(mapping)) {
        if (h !== header && t === target) mapping[h] = 'ignore';
      }
    }
    previewMutation.mutate({ file: value.file, mapping });
  };

  const setRemoved = (rowNumbers: number[], removed: boolean) => {
    if (!value) return;
    const set = new Set(value.removedRows);
    rowNumbers.forEach((n) => (removed ? set.add(n) : set.delete(n)));
    onChange({ ...value, removedRows: Array.from(set) });
  };

  const reset = () => {
    onChange(null);
    setError(null);
    if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = '';
  };

  const preview: ExcelPreviewResponse | undefined = value?.preview;
  const removedSet = useMemo(() => new Set(value?.removedRows ?? []), [value?.removedRows]);
  const kept = useMemo(() => keptUploadRows(value), [value]);
  const keptNew = kept.filter((r) => r.status === 'VALID').length;
  const keptExisting = kept.length - keptNew;

  const filteredRows = useMemo(() => {
    if (!preview) return [];
    return preview.rows.filter((r) => {
      const isRemoved = removedSet.has(r.rowNumber);
      const usable = r.status === 'VALID' || r.status === 'EXISTING';
      switch (filter) {
        case 'used': return usable && !isRemoved;
        case 'problems': return !usable;
        case 'removed': return isRemoved;
        default: return true;
      }
    });
  }, [preview, removedSet, filter]);

  // Placeholder coverage for the selected template.
  const provided = useMemo(() => {
    const out = new Set<string>();
    Object.values(preview?.detectedColumns ?? {}).forEach((t) =>
      placeholdersForTarget(t).forEach((p) => out.add(p)),
    );
    return out;
  }, [preview]);
  const notFilled = templatePlaceholders.filter((p) => !provided.has(p));

  const firstRowValue = (header: string) => {
    // Raw values aren't returned per column, so show the mapped value of the first row when known.
    const target = preview?.detectedColumns[header];
    if (!target || !preview?.rows.length) return '';
    const key = target.startsWith('custom:') ? target.slice(7) : target;
    return preview.rows[0].fields?.[key] ?? '';
  };

  // ── Dropzone ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!value) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div
          onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setDragging(true); }}
          onDragLeave={() => setDragging(false)}
          onDrop={onDrop}
          className={`relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed px-6 py-10 text-center transition ${
            dragging ? 'border-brand-400 bg-brand-50/60' : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 hover:border-slate-300'
          }`}
        >
          {previewMutation.isPending ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="mb-3 h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-brand-500" />
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">Reading {pendingName}…</p>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="mb-3 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-brand-50 text-brand-600">
                <UploadCloud className="h-6 w-6" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Drag &amp; drop an Excel or CSV file here</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">
                .xlsx, .xls or .csv, up to 5 MB and {UPLOAD_MAX_ROWS.toLocaleString()} rows. The first row must contain
                column names. The template has the columns Email, Name and Company; other columns can be mapped too.
              </p>
              <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <Button type="button" size="sm" onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}>
                  <FileSpreadsheet className="h-4 w-4" /> Browse files
                </Button>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  variant="ghost"
                  onClick={() =>
                    recipientsApi.downloadTemplate().catch(() =>
                      toast.error('Could not download the template', { id: 'template-download' }),
                    )
                  }
                >
                  <Download className="h-4 w-4" /> Download template
                </Button>
                {onFillTable && (
                  <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onFillTable}>
                    <Table2 className="h-4 w-4" /> Fill in a table
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            type="file"
            accept={ACCEPT}
            className="hidden"
            onChange={(e) => {
              const file = e.target.files?.[0];
              if (file) handleFile(file);
              e.target.value = '';
            }}
          />
        </div>
        {error && (
          <p className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-700">
            <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" /> {error}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── Preview ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const p = value.preview;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
          <FileSpreadsheet className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-brand-500" />
          <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">{p.fileName}</span>
          {previewMutation.isPending && <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-brand-500" />}
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={reset}
          disabled={previewMutation.isPending}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Remove file
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <p className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-700">
          <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" /> {error}
        </p>
      )}

      {/* Counts for the whole file. Valid = can be emailed: new addresses plus saved contacts. */}
      <div className={`grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 ${p.skippedRows > 0 ? 'sm:grid-cols-5' : 'sm:grid-cols-4'}`}>
        <SummaryChip label="Total rows" value={p.totalRows} tone="text-slate-700 bg-slate-50" />
        <SummaryChip
          label="Valid"
          value={p.validRows}
          detail={`${p.newRows.toLocaleString()} new · ${p.existingRows.toLocaleString()} saved contact${p.existingRows === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}
          tone="text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50"
        />
        <SummaryChip label="Invalid" value={p.invalidRows} detail="reason on each row" tone="text-red-700 bg-red-50" />
        <SummaryChip label="Duplicate" value={p.duplicateRows} detail="repeats within this file" tone="text-amber-700 bg-amber-50" />
        {p.skippedRows > 0 && (
          <SummaryChip label="Won't be emailed" value={p.skippedRows} detail="unsubscribed or bounced" tone="text-slate-700 bg-slate-100" />
        )}
      </div>

      {!p.hasEmailColumn && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-700">
          <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>No email column was detected. In <b>Columns</b> below, set the column that holds the addresses to <b>Email</b>.</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Column mapping */}
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShowColumns((s) => !s)}
          className="flex w-full items-center justify-between px-4 py-2.5 text-left text-sm font-medium text-slate-700"
        >
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Columns3 className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" /> Columns ({p.columns.length}) and placeholders
          </span>
          <span className="text-xs text-brand-600">{showColumns ? 'Hide' : 'Review mapping'}</span>
        </button>
        {showColumns && (
          <div className="border-t border-slate-100">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
              <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Column in file</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Used as</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Fills placeholders</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {p.columns.map((header) => {
                  const current = p.detectedColumns[header] ?? 'ignore';
                  const suggested = `custom:${suggestCustomKey(header)}`;
                  const options = [
                    ...STANDARD_TARGETS,
                    ...KNOWN_CUSTOM_FIELDS.map((k) => `custom:${k}`),
                    ...(KNOWN_CUSTOM_FIELDS.includes(suggested.slice(7).toLowerCase()) ? [] : [suggested]),
                    'ignore',
                  ];
                  if (!options.includes(current)) options.splice(options.length - 1, 0, current);
                  const sample = firstRowValue(header);
                  return (
                    <tr key={header}>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2">
                        <p className="font-medium text-slate-700">{header}</p>
                        {sample && <p className="max-w-[14rem] truncate text-xs text-slate-400">e.g. {sample}</p>}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2">
                        <select
                          className="input py-1.5 text-xs"
                          value={current}
                          disabled={previewMutation.isPending}
                          onChange={(e) => changeMapping(header, e.target.value)}
                          aria-label={`Field for column ${header}`}
                        >
                          {options.map((o) => (
                            <option key={o} value={o}>
                              {o === suggested && !KNOWN_CUSTOM_FIELDS.includes(o.slice(7))
                                ? `Custom field {{${o.slice(7)}}}`
                                : targetLabel(o)}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2">
````
