````tsx
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                          {placeholdersForTarget(current).map((ph) => (
                            <code key={ph} className="rounded bg-accent-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-accent-700">{`{{${ph}}}`}</code>
                          ))}
                          {current === 'ignore' && <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Not used</span>}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            {templatePlaceholders.length > 0 && (
              <div className="border-t border-slate-100 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs">
                {notFilled.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-emerald-700">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> This file fills every placeholder in the email.
                  </p>
                ) : (
                  <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-amber-700">
                    <Info className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                    <span>
                      Not filled by this file:{' '}
                      {notFilled.map((ph) => <code key={ph} className="mr-1">{`{{${ph}}}`}</code>)}
                      These render as blank text for new addresses from this file. Saved contacts use their stored details.
                    </span>
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Row filter */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs">
        {([
          ['all', `All rows (${p.totalRows})`],
          ['used', `Used (${kept.length})`],
          ['problems', `Not usable (${p.invalidRows + p.duplicateRows + p.skippedRows})`],
          ['removed', `Removed by you (${value.removedRows.length})`],
        ] as [RowFilter, string][]).map(([key, label]) => (
          <button
            key={key}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setFilter(key); setVisible(PAGE); }}
            className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 font-medium transition ${
              filter === key ? 'bg-brand-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
        {value.removedRows.length > 0 && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setRemoved(value.removedRows, false)}
            className="ml-auto inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-brand-600 hover:underline"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Restore all removed
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
          <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">
            <tr>
              <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Row</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Email</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Name</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Company</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Status</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2" />
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
            {filteredRows.slice(0, Math.min(visible, MAX_VISIBLE)).map((r) => {
              const isRemoved = removedSet.has(r.rowNumber);
              const usable = r.status === 'VALID' || r.status === 'EXISTING';
              return (
                <tr key={r.rowNumber} className={isRemoved ? 'bg-slate-50/80 text-slate-400' : 'hover:bg-slate-50/60'}>
                  <td className="px-3 py-2 tabular-nums text-slate-400">{r.rowNumber}</td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-2 font-medium text-slate-700">{r.email || '—'}</td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">{r.name || '—'}</td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">{r.company || '—'}</td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-2">
                    {statusPill(r, isRemoved)}
                    {r.reason && !isRemoved && <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-400">{r.reason}</p>}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right">
                    {usable && !isRemoved && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setRemoved([r.rowNumber], true)}
                        className="text-slate-300 transition hover:text-red-500"
                        aria-label={`Remove row ${r.rowNumber}`}
                        title="Remove from this campaign"
                      >
                        <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {isRemoved && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setRemoved([r.rowNumber], false)}
                        className="text-xs font-medium text-brand-600 hover:underline"
                      >
                        Restore
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
            {filteredRows.length === 0 && (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={6} className="px-3 py-6 text-center text-sm text-slate-400">No rows to show.</td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
        {filteredRows.length > Math.min(visible, MAX_VISIBLE) && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
            Showing {Math.min(visible, MAX_VISIBLE).toLocaleString()} of {filteredRows.length.toLocaleString()} rows
            {visible < MAX_VISIBLE && (
              <button type="button" className="font-medium text-brand-600 hover:underline" onClick={() => setVisible((v) => v + PAGE * 4)}>
                Show more
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
        <p>
          <b className="text-slate-700">{kept.length.toLocaleString()}</b> address{kept.length === 1 ? '' : 'es'} from this file will be used:{' '}
          {keptNew.toLocaleString()} new, {keptExisting.toLocaleString()} saved contact{keptExisting === 1 ? '' : 's'}.
          Saved contacts can be used in any number of campaigns. Invalid and duplicate rows are never emailed.
        </p>
        {p.skippedRows > 0 && (
          <p>
            {p.skippedRows.toLocaleString()} row{p.skippedRows === 1 ? '' : 's'} won't be emailed because the address is
            unsubscribed or the saved contact bounced or is marked invalid. Each row shows the reason.
          </p>
        )}
        {keptNew > 0 && (
          <p>
            New addresses are used for this campaign only: they're stored with the campaign and aren't added to your
            Recipients list. On the Review step you can choose to also save them as contacts.
          </p>
        )}
        {p.invalidRows > 0 && (
          <p>To include a corrected address, fix it in the file and upload it again, or add it on the <b>Add emails manually</b> tab.</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SummaryChip({ label, value, detail, tone }: { label: string; value: number; detail?: string; tone: string }) {
  return (
    <div className={`rounded-lg px-3 py-2 ${tone}`}>
      <p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{value.toLocaleString()}</p>
      <p className="text-xs font-medium opacity-80">{label}</p>
      {detail && <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] opacity-70">{detail}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/components/SavedRecipientPicker.tsx

````tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Search, Loader2, Users, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { recipientsApi } from '../api/recipients';
import type { Recipient } from '../types';
import { apiErrorMessage } from '../lib/errors';
import { Button } from './ui';

interface SavedRecipientPickerProps {
  /** Selected saved contacts by ID (owned by the parent). */
  selected: Record<number, Recipient>;
  onChange: (next: Record<number, Recipient>) => void;
}

const PAGE_SIZE = 20;
/** "Select all matching" loads at most this many contacts. */
const SELECT_ALL_LIMIT = 10_000;

/**
 * Lists saved contacts with search (name, email or company), pagination and
 * multi-selection. Only ACTIVE contacts are listed because unsubscribed or
 * bounced contacts are never emailed.
 */
export function SavedRecipientPicker({ selected, onChange }: SavedRecipientPickerProps) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [selectingAll, setSelectingAll] = useState(false);
  const headerBox = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebounced(search.trim());
      setPage(0);
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [search]);

  const { data, isLoading, isFetching, isError, error, refetch } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['recipients', 'picker', debounced, page],
    queryFn: () =>
      recipientsApi.list({ search: debounced || undefined, status: 'ACTIVE', page, size: PAGE_SIZE }),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
  });

  const rows = useMemo(() => data?.content ?? [], [data]);
  const selectedCount = Object.keys(selected).length;
  const pageSelected = rows.filter((r) => selected[r.id]).length;
  const allOnPage = rows.length > 0 && pageSelected === rows.length;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (headerBox.current) headerBox.current.indeterminate = pageSelected > 0 && !allOnPage;
  }, [pageSelected, allOnPage]);

  const toggle = (r: Recipient) => {
    const next = { ...selected };
    if (next[r.id]) delete next[r.id];
    else next[r.id] = r;
    onChange(next);
  };

  const togglePage = () => {
    const next = { ...selected };
    if (allOnPage) rows.forEach((r) => delete next[r.id]);
    else rows.forEach((r) => (next[r.id] = r));
    onChange(next);
  };

  const selectAllMatching = async () => {
    const total = data?.totalElements ?? 0;
    if (total > SELECT_ALL_LIMIT) {
      toast.error(`Narrow the search first: "Select all" is limited to ${SELECT_ALL_LIMIT.toLocaleString()} contacts.`, { id: 'picker-select-all' });
      return;
    }
    setSelectingAll(true);
    try {
      const next = { ...selected };
      const size = 1000;
      for (let p = 0; p * size < total; p++) {
        const res = await recipientsApi.list({ search: debounced || undefined, status: 'ACTIVE', page: p, size });
        res.content.forEach((r) => (next[r.id] = r));
        if (res.last) break;
      }
      onChange(next);
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(apiErrorMessage(e, 'Could not load all matching contacts'), { id: 'picker-select-all' });
    } finally {
      setSelectingAll(false);
    }
  };

  const total = data?.totalElements ?? 0;
  const matchingSelected = rows.length > 0 && total > rows.length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <div className="relative min-w-[14rem] flex-1">
          <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
          <input
            className="input pl-10"
            placeholder="Search by name, email or company…"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            aria-label="Search saved contacts"
          />
          {isFetching && !isLoading && (
            <Loader2 className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 animate-spin text-slate-400" />
          )}
        </div>
        <span className="text-sm text-slate-500">
          <b className="text-slate-800">{selectedCount.toLocaleString()}</b> selected
        </span>
        {selectedCount > 0 && (
          <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => onChange({})}>
            Clear selection
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      {isError ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" /> {apiErrorMessage(error, 'Could not load contacts.')}
          </span>
          <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => refetch()}>Retry</Button>
        </div>
      ) : isLoading ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-10 text-sm text-slate-500">
          <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> Loading contacts…
        </div>
      ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-200 py-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
          <Users className="h-6 w-6 text-slate-300" />
          {debounced ? 'No active contacts match your search.' : 'You have no active saved contacts yet.'}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
            <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">
              <tr>
                <th className="w-10 px-3 py-2">
                  <input
                    ref={headerBox}
                    type="checkbox"
                    className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-slate-300"
                    checked={allOnPage}
                    onChange={togglePage}
                    aria-label="Select all contacts on this page"
                  />
                </th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Email</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Name</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Company</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <tr
                  key={r.id}
                  className={`cursor-pointer ${selected[r.id] ? 'bg-brand-50/50' : 'hover:bg-slate-50/60'}`}
                  onClick={() => toggle(r)}
                >
                  <td className="px-3 py-2" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-slate-300"
                      checked={!!selected[r.id]}
                      onChange={() => toggle(r)}
                      aria-label={`Select ${r.email}`}
                    />
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-2 font-medium text-slate-700">{r.email}</td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">{r.name || [r.firstName, r.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || '—'}</td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">{r.company || '—'}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
            <span>
              {total.toLocaleString()} active contact{total === 1 ? '' : 's'}
              {debounced ? ' match' : ''} · page {page + 1} of {Math.max(1, data?.totalPages ?? 1)}
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {matchingSelected && (
                <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={selectAllMatching} loading={selectingAll}>
                  Select all {total.toLocaleString()}
                </Button>
              )}
              <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={data?.first ?? true} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)}>
                Previous
              </Button>
              <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={data?.last ?? true} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}>
                Next
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
        Only active contacts are listed. Unsubscribed or bounced contacts are never emailed.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/components/TemplateEditorModal.tsx

````tsx
import { FormEvent, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { AlertCircle, ShieldAlert } from 'lucide-react';
import clsx from 'clsx';
import { templatesApi, type TemplatePayload } from '../api/templates';
import type { EmailTemplate } from '../types';
import { Button, Modal } from './ui';
import { TemplatePreviewPanel } from './TemplatePreviewPanel';
import { apiErrorMessage, apiErrorStatus, apiFieldErrors, isForbidden } from '../lib/errors';
import { noPermissionMessage } from '../lib/roles';
import { extractPlaceholders } from '../lib/recipientSelection';
import { TEMPLATE_LIMITS, type SampleData } from '../lib/templateSample';

interface TemplateEditorModalProps {
  /** The template to edit, or null to create a new one. */
  template: EmailTemplate | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved: (template: EmailTemplate) => void;
  /** Called when the template being edited no longer exists (the save returned 404). */
  onMissing?: () => void;
  sample: SampleData;
  onSampleChange: (sample: SampleData) => void;
}

interface FormState {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  subject: string;
  htmlBody: string;
  plainBody: string;
}

type FieldKey = keyof FormState;
/** Field errors, plus "body" when neither body is filled in. */
type FormErrors = Partial<Record<FieldKey | 'body', string>>;

const FIELD_KEYS: FieldKey[] = ['name', 'description', 'subject', 'htmlBody', 'plainBody'];

function formFrom(t: EmailTemplate | null): FormState {
  return {
    name: t?.name ?? '',
    description: t?.description ?? '',
    subject: t?.subject ?? '',
    htmlBody: t?.htmlBody ?? '',
    plainBody: t?.plainBody ?? '',
  };
}

function validate(f: FormState): FormErrors {
  const errors: FormErrors = {};
  if (!f.name.trim()) errors.name = 'A template name is required';
  else if (f.name.trim().length > TEMPLATE_LIMITS.name) errors.name = `Use at most ${TEMPLATE_LIMITS.name} characters`;
  if (!f.subject.trim()) errors.subject = 'A subject is required';
  else if (f.subject.trim().length > TEMPLATE_LIMITS.subject) {
    errors.subject = `Use at most ${TEMPLATE_LIMITS.subject} characters`;
  }
  if (!f.htmlBody.trim() && !f.plainBody.trim()) errors.body = 'Add an HTML body, a plain-text body, or both.';
  return errors;
}

/**
 * What is sent to POST/PUT /api/templates. Variables are never sent: the backend
 * extracts them from the subject and bodies. Bodies are sent as typed, because
 * whitespace can matter; an empty body is sent as null.
 */
function toPayload(f: FormState): TemplatePayload {
  return {
    name: f.name.trim(),
    description: f.description.trim() || null,
    subject: f.subject.trim(),
    htmlBody: f.htmlBody.trim() ? f.htmlBody : null,
    plainBody: f.plainBody.trim() ? f.plainBody : null,
  };
}

export function TemplateEditorModal({ template, onClose, onSaved, onMissing, sample, onSampleChange }: TemplateEditorModalProps) {
  const isEdit = !!template;
  const [initial] = useState<FormState>(() => formFrom(template));
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(initial);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<FormErrors>({});
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [forbidden, setForbidden] = useState(false);
  // The template was deleted while it was being edited: saving again would fail the same way.
  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'edit' | 'preview'>('edit');

  const payload = toPayload(form);
  const placeholders = useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.from(
        new Set([
          ...extractPlaceholders(form.subject),
          ...extractPlaceholders(form.htmlBody),
          ...extractPlaceholders(form.plainBody),
        ]),
      ),
    [form.subject, form.htmlBody, form.plainBody],
  );

  const set = (key: FieldKey, value: string) => {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: value }));
    setErrors((e) => {
      if (!e[key] && !(e.body && (key === 'htmlBody' || key === 'plainBody'))) return e;
      const next = { ...e, [key]: undefined };
      if (key === 'htmlBody' || key === 'plainBody') next.body = undefined;
      return next;
    });
  };

  const saveMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (p: TemplatePayload) =>
      template ? templatesApi.update(template.id, p) : templatesApi.create(p),
    onSuccess: (saved) => {
      toast.success(isEdit ? `Template "${saved.name}" updated` : `Template "${saved.name}" created`, {
        id: 'template-save',
      });
      onSaved(saved);
      onClose();
    },
    onError: (e: unknown) => {
      if (isForbidden(e)) {
        setForbidden(true);
        toast.error(noPermissionMessage('save templates'), { id: 'template-save' });
        return;
      }
      if (isEdit && apiErrorStatus(e) === 404) {
        const message =
          'This template no longer exists. It may have been deleted. Your changes are still here, so you can copy them.';
        setMissing(true);
        setServerError(message);
        toast.error(message, { id: 'template-save' });
        onMissing?.();
        return;
      }
      // Bean Validation errors (ApiError.fieldErrors) are shown next to their fields.
      const fieldErrors = apiFieldErrors(e);
      if (fieldErrors.length > 0) {
        const next: FormErrors = {};
        const other: string[] = [];
        for (const fe of fieldErrors) {
          if ((FIELD_KEYS as string[]).includes(fe.field)) next[fe.field as FieldKey] = fe.message;
          else other.push(`${fe.field}: ${fe.message}`);
        }
        setErrors(next);
        setServerError(other.length > 0 ? other.join('; ') : null);
        setTab('edit');
        toast.error('The template was not saved. Check the highlighted fields.', { id: 'template-save' });
        return;
      }
      const message = apiErrorMessage(e, 'Could not save the template.');
      setServerError(message);
      toast.error(message, { id: 'template-save' });
    },
  });
  const saving = saveMutation.isPending;

  const submit = (e?: FormEvent) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    if (saving || forbidden || missing) return;
    const next = validate(form);
    setErrors(next);
    setServerError(null);
    if (Object.keys(next).length > 0) {
      setTab('edit');
      return;
    }
    saveMutation.mutate(payload);
  };

  const requestClose = () => {
    if (saving) return;
    const dirty = FIELD_KEYS.some((k) => form[k] !== initial[k]);
    if (dirty && !window.confirm('Discard your unsaved changes to this template?')) return;
    onClose();
  };

  const tooLong = [payload.htmlBody, payload.plainBody].some(
    (b) => (b?.length ?? 0) > TEMPLATE_LIMITS.previewBody,
  );
  const blockedReason = !payload.htmlBody && !payload.plainBody
    ? 'Add an HTML or plain-text body on the Edit tab to preview it.'
    : tooLong
    ? `The preview renders bodies of up to ${TEMPLATE_LIMITS.previewBody.toLocaleString()} characters. This body is longer; you can still save it.`
    : null;

  const inputClass = (key: FieldKey | 'body') =>
    clsx('input', errors[key] && 'border-red-400 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500/10');

  return (
    <Modal
      open
      onClose={requestClose}
      widthClass="max-w-4xl"
      title={isEdit ? `Edit template: ${template?.name ?? ''}` : 'New template'}
      description="Use placeholders such as {{FirstName}} or {{Company}}; they are filled for each recipient when a campaign is sent."
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" type="button" onClick={requestClose} disabled={saving}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" form="template-form" loading={saving} disabled={forbidden || missing}>
            {saving ? 'Saving…' : isEdit ? 'Save changes' : 'Create template'}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="mb-4 flex gap-1 border-b border-slate-200 text-sm font-medium" role="tablist">
        {(['edit', 'preview'] as const).map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={tab === t}
            onClick={() => setTab(t)}
            className={clsx(
              '-mb-px border-b-2 px-3 py-2',
              tab === t ? 'border-brand-600 text-brand-700' : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700',
            )}
          >
            {t === 'edit' ? 'Edit' : 'Preview with sample data'}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {forbidden && (
        <p role="alert" className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
          <ShieldAlert className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
          {noPermissionMessage('save templates')} Your changes are still here, so you can copy them.
        </p>
      )}
      {serverError && !forbidden && (
        <p role="alert" className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
          <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
          {serverError}
        </p>
      )}

      {/* The form stays mounted on the Preview tab so the footer's submit button always works. */}
      <form id="template-form" onSubmit={submit} noValidate className={clsx('space-y-4', tab !== 'edit' && 'hidden')}>
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="t-name" className="label">Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span></label>
          <input
            id="t-name"
            className={inputClass('name')}
            placeholder="e.g. Workshop invitation"
            value={form.name}
            maxLength={TEMPLATE_LIMITS.name}
            onChange={(e) => set('name', e.target.value)}
            aria-invalid={!!errors.name}
          />
          {errors.name && <FieldError message={errors.name} />}
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="t-description" className="label">Description</label>
          <input
            id="t-description"
            className={inputClass('description')}
            placeholder="What this template is for (optional)"
            value={form.description}
            onChange={(e) => set('description', e.target.value)}
            aria-invalid={!!errors.description}
          />
          {errors.description && <FieldError message={errors.description} />}
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="t-subject" className="label">Subject <span className="text-red-500">*</span></label>
          <input
            id="t-subject"
            className={inputClass('subject')}
            placeholder="e.g. Hello {{FirstName}}, you're invited"
            value={form.subject}
            maxLength={TEMPLATE_LIMITS.subject}
            onChange={(e) => set('subject', e.target.value)}
            aria-invalid={!!errors.subject}
          />
          {errors.subject ? (
            <FieldError message={errors.subject} />
          ) : (
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">A campaign that uses this template starts with this subject and can change it.</p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="t-html" className="label">HTML body</label>
          <textarea
            id="t-html"
            className={clsx(inputClass('htmlBody'), 'min-h-[180px] resize-y font-mono text-xs', errors.body && 'border-red-400')}
            placeholder="<p>Hi {{FirstName}},</p>"
            value={form.htmlBody}
            onChange={(e) => set('htmlBody', e.target.value)}
            aria-invalid={!!errors.htmlBody || !!errors.body}
            spellCheck={false}
          />
          {errors.htmlBody && <FieldError message={errors.htmlBody} />}
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="t-plain" className="label">Plain-text body</label>
          <textarea
            id="t-plain"
            className={clsx(inputClass('plainBody'), 'min-h-[120px] resize-y text-sm', errors.body && 'border-red-400')}
            placeholder="Hi {{FirstName}}, …"
            value={form.plainBody}
            onChange={(e) => set('plainBody', e.target.value)}
            aria-invalid={!!errors.plainBody || !!errors.body}
          />
          {errors.plainBody && <FieldError message={errors.plainBody} />}
          {errors.body ? (
            <FieldError message={errors.body} />
          ) : (
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">
              At least one body is required. Email clients that don't show HTML display the plain-text body.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {placeholders.length > 0 && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 text-xs">
            <span className="text-slate-500">Placeholders found:</span>
            {placeholders.map((p) => (
              <code key={p} className="rounded bg-accent-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-accent-700">{`{{${p}}}`}</code>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </form>

      {tab === 'preview' && (
        <TemplatePreviewPanel
          sample={sample}
          onSampleChange={onSampleChange}
          render={(recipient) =>
            templatesApi.renderContent({
              subject: payload.subject,
              htmlBody: payload.htmlBody ?? null,
              plainBody: payload.plainBody ?? null,
              recipient,
            })
          }
          contentKey={JSON.stringify([payload.subject, payload.htmlBody, payload.plainBody])}
          placeholders={placeholders}
          blockedReason={blockedReason}
        />
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}

function FieldError({ message }: { message: string }) {
  return (
    <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-red-600">
      <AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
      {message}
    </p>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/components/TemplatePreviewPanel.tsx

````tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { AlertTriangle, Info, Loader2, Plus, RefreshCw, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import clsx from 'clsx';
import type { RenderRecipient, RenderedEmail } from '../api/templates';
import { Button } from './ui';
import { apiErrorMessage, isForbidden } from '../lib/errors';
import { noPermissionMessage } from '../lib/roles';
import {
  TEMPLATE_LIMITS,
  newSampleField,
  sampleFieldErrors,
  toRenderRecipient,
  type SampleData,
  type SampleField,
} from '../lib/templateSample';

interface TemplatePreviewPanelProps {
  sample: SampleData;
  onSampleChange: (sample: SampleData) => void;
  /** Renders the content on the server for one sample recipient. */
  render: (recipient: RenderRecipient) => Promise<RenderedEmail>;
  /** Identifies the content being previewed. When it changes, the preview shown is out of date. */
  contentKey: string;
  /** Placeholders the content uses, listed so the user knows which values to fill in. */
  placeholders: string[];
  /** Set when the content can't be previewed, for example because it has no body. */
  blockedReason?: string | null;
}

type TextKey = Exclude<keyof SampleData, 'fields'>;

const TEXT_INPUTS: { key: TextKey; label: string; fills: string }[] = [
  { key: 'firstName', label: 'First name', fills: '{{firstName}} {{FirstName}}' },
  { key: 'lastName', label: 'Last name', fills: '{{lastName}} {{LastName}}' },
  { key: 'name', label: 'Full name', fills: '{{name}} {{Name}}' },
  { key: 'email', label: 'Email', fills: '{{email}} {{Email}}' },
  { key: 'company', label: 'Company', fills: '{{company}} {{Company}}' },
];

function renderErrorMessage(e: unknown): string {
  if (isForbidden(e)) return noPermissionMessage('preview templates with sample data');
  return apiErrorMessage(e, 'Could not render the preview.');
}

/**
 * Sample-data editor plus a server-rendered preview. Placeholders are only ever
 * filled by the server (the same model as a real send), never in the browser.
 */
export function TemplatePreviewPanel({
  sample,
  onSampleChange,
  render,
  contentKey,
  placeholders,
  blockedReason,
}: TemplatePreviewPanelProps) {
  const fieldErrors = sampleFieldErrors(sample.fields);
  const sampleValid = Object.keys(fieldErrors).length === 0;
  const recipient = toRenderRecipient(sample);
  const inputKey = `${contentKey}\n${JSON.stringify(recipient)}`;
  const canRender = !blockedReason && sampleValid;

  // The last successful preview, with the inputs it was rendered from.
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<{ key: string; email: RenderedEmail; to: string | null } | null>(null);

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (vars: { key: string; recipient: RenderRecipient }) => render(vars.recipient),
    onSuccess: (email, vars) => setShown({ key: vars.key, email, to: vars.recipient.email ?? null }),
  });

  const run = () => {
    if (canRender && !mutation.isPending) mutation.mutate({ key: inputKey, recipient });
  };

  // Render once when the panel opens; after that the user renders again on demand.
  const autoRendered = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoRendered.current) return;
    autoRendered.current = true;
    run();
  });

  const stale = !!shown && shown.key !== inputKey;

  const setText = (key: TextKey, value: string) => onSampleChange({ ...sample, [key]: value });
  const setField = (id: number, patch: Partial<SampleField>) =>
    onSampleChange({ ...sample, fields: sample.fields.map((f) => (f.id === id ? { ...f, ...patch } : f)) });
  const addField = () => onSampleChange({ ...sample, fields: [...sample.fields, newSampleField()] });
  const removeField = (id: number) => onSampleChange({ ...sample, fields: sample.fields.filter((f) => f.id !== id) });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <p className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
        <Info className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
        The server fills the placeholders with these sample values, the same way it does for a real send.
        Nothing is saved and no email is sent.
      </p>

      <fieldset className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-4">
        <legend className="px-1 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">Sample recipient</legend>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          {TEXT_INPUTS.map((f) => (
            <div key={f.key}>
              <label htmlFor={`sample-${f.key}`} className="label">{f.label}</label>
              <input
                id={`sample-${f.key}`}
                className="input"
                value={sample[f.key]}
                maxLength={TEMPLATE_LIMITS.sampleText}
                onChange={(e) => setText(f.key, e.target.value)}
              />
              <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-400">{f.fills}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Custom fields</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Values for other placeholders, such as {'{{Team}}'}, {'{{role}}'} or {'{{course}}'}. Enter the name without braces.
          </p>
          {sample.fields.map((f) => (
            <div key={f.id} className="mt-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  className={clsx('input w-40 font-mono text-xs', fieldErrors[f.id] && 'border-red-400')}
                  placeholder="Team"
                  aria-label="Placeholder name"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors[f.id]}
                  value={f.key}
                  maxLength={TEMPLATE_LIMITS.sampleKey}
                  onChange={(e) => setField(f.id, { key: e.target.value })}
                />
                <input
                  className="input flex-1"
                  placeholder="Platform"
                  aria-label={f.key.trim() ? `Value for ${f.key.trim()}` : 'Value'}
                  value={f.value}
                  maxLength={TEMPLATE_LIMITS.sampleValue}
                  onChange={(e) => setField(f.id, { value: e.target.value })}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn-icon text-slate-400 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-600"
                  aria-label={f.key.trim() ? `Remove ${f.key.trim()}` : 'Remove field'}
                  title="Remove"
                  onClick={() => removeField(f.id)}
                >
                  <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                </button>
              </div>
              {fieldErrors[f.id] && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-red-600">{fieldErrors[f.id]}</p>}
            </div>
          ))}
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            className="mt-2"
            onClick={addField}
            disabled={sample.fields.length >= TEMPLATE_LIMITS.sampleFields}
          >
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> Add field
          </Button>
        </div>
      </fieldset>

      {placeholders.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 text-xs">
          <span className="text-slate-500">Placeholders used:</span>
          {placeholders.map((p) => (
            <code key={p} className="rounded bg-accent-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-accent-700">{`{{${p}}}`}</code>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">Preview</p>
          <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={run} loading={mutation.isPending} disabled={!canRender}>
            {!mutation.isPending && <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />}
            {shown ? 'Render again' : 'Render preview'}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {blockedReason && <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">{blockedReason}</p>}
        {!blockedReason && !sampleValid && (
          <p className="text-xs text-red-600">Fix the custom fields above to render the preview.</p>
        )}
        {mutation.isError && (
          <p role="alert" className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
            <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
            {renderErrorMessage(mutation.error)}
          </p>
        )}
        {mutation.isPending && !shown && (
          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-500">
            <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> Rendering…
          </p>
        )}
        {stale && !mutation.isPending && (
          <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-amber-700">
            <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
            The content or the sample values changed after this preview. Render it again to see the changes.
          </p>
        )}
        {shown && <RenderedEmailView email={shown.email} to={shown.to} />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function RenderedEmailView({ email, to }: { email: RenderedEmail; to: string | null }) {
  const hasHtml = email.htmlBody.trim().length > 0;
  const hasPlain = email.plainBody.trim().length > 0;
  const [view, setView] = useState<'html' | 'plain'>('html');
  const current = view === 'plain' ? (hasPlain ? 'plain' : 'html') : hasHtml ? 'html' : 'plain';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-4">
      <p className="text-sm">
        <span className="text-slate-500">To:</span>{' '}
        <span className="text-slate-800">{to ?? '(no email address in the sample)'}</span>
      </p>
      <p className="text-sm">
        <span className="text-slate-500">Subject:</span>{' '}
        <span className="font-medium text-slate-900">{email.subject || '(empty)'}</span>
      </p>

      {hasHtml && hasPlain && (
        <div className="flex gap-1 text-xs font-medium">
          {(['html', 'plain'] as const).map((v) => (
            <button
              key={v}
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={current === v}
              onClick={() => setView(v)}
              className={clsx(
                'rounded-md px-2.5 py-1',
                current === v ? 'bg-brand-50 text-brand-700' : 'text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100',
              )}
            >
              {v === 'html' ? 'HTML' : 'Plain text'}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {!hasHtml && !hasPlain ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">(The body is empty.)</p>
      ) : current === 'html' ? (
        // sandbox="" blocks scripts, forms, popups and same-origin access in the rendered HTML.
        <iframe
          title="Rendered HTML body"
          sandbox=""
          srcDoc={email.htmlBody}
          className="h-80 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white"
        />
      ) : (
        <pre className="max-h-80 overflow-auto whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-3 text-xs text-slate-700">
          {email.plainBody}
        </pre>
      )}

      {email.emptyVariables.length > 0 && (
        <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-xs text-amber-700">
          <Info className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>
            No value in the sample for{' '}
            {email.emptyVariables.map((v) => (
              <code key={v} className="mr-1">{`{{${v}}}`}</code>
            ))}
            These render as blank text, as they would for a recipient without these values.
          </span>
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/components/ui/Button.tsx

````tsx
import { ButtonHTMLAttributes, forwardRef } from 'react';
import clsx from 'clsx';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

type Variant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'danger';
type Size = 'md' | 'sm';

interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: Variant;
  size?: Size;
  loading?: boolean;
}

const VARIANT_CLASS: Record<Variant, string> = {
  primary: 'btn-primary',
  secondary: 'btn-secondary',
  ghost: 'btn-ghost',
  danger: 'btn-danger',
};

/**
 * Shared button. Wraps the design-system button classes and adds a
 * loading spinner + disabled handling. Keeps all native button props.
 */
export const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
  ({ variant = 'primary', size = 'md', loading = false, disabled, className, children, ...props }, ref) => (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      className={clsx(VARIANT_CLASS[variant], size === 'sm' && 'btn-sm', className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {loading && <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
      {children}
    </button>
  )
);

Button.displayName = 'Button';
````

````tsx
import { HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import clsx from 'clsx';

interface CardProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Apply default padding (p-6). Set false for tables/custom layouts. */
  padded?: boolean;
  /** Add hover elevation. */
  hoverable?: boolean;
}

export function Card({ padded = true, hoverable = false, className, children, ...props }: CardProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={clsx('card', padded && 'card-pad', hoverable && 'card-hoverable', className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/components/ui/Modal.tsx

````tsx
import { ReactNode, useEffect } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';

interface ModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  /** Footer actions (buttons). Rendered in a sticky footer. */
  footer?: ReactNode;
  /** Max width class, defaults to a comfortable form width. */
  widthClass?: string;
}

export function Modal({
  open,
  onClose,
  title,
  description,
  children,
  footer,
  widthClass = 'max-w-lg',
}: ModalProps) {
  // Close on Escape + lock body scroll while open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    const prevOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = prevOverflow;
    };
  }, [open, onClose]);

  if (!open) return null;

  return createPortal(
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      {/* Backdrop */}
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in"
        onClick={onClose}
        aria-hidden
      />

      {/* Dialog */}
      <div
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="modal-title"
        className={`relative z-10 w-full ${widthClass} animate-scale-in overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-elevated`}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-4">
          <div>
            <h2 id="modal-title" className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">{title}</h2>
            {description && <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm text-slate-500">{description}</p>}
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="btn-icon -mr-2 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-600"
            aria-label="Close dialog"
          >
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Body */}
        <div className="max-h-[65vh] overflow-y-auto px-6 py-5">{children}</div>

        {/* Footer */}
        {footer && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 px-6 py-4">
            {footer}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/components/ui/StatusBadge.tsx

````tsx
import clsx from 'clsx';
import type { CampaignStatus, RecipientStatus } from '../../types';

type AnyStatus = CampaignStatus | RecipientStatus | string;

interface StatusConfig {
  label: string;
  dot: string;
  chip: string;
}

/**
 * Maps every known campaign & recipient status to a consistent colour chip
 * with a leading status dot. Falls back to neutral for unknown values.
 */
const STATUS_MAP: Record<string, StatusConfig> = {
  // Campaign statuses
  DRAFT:     { label: 'Draft',     dot: 'bg-slate-400',   chip: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700' },
  SCHEDULED: { label: 'Scheduled', dot: 'bg-amber-500',   chip: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700' },
  QUEUED:    { label: 'Queued',    dot: 'bg-blue-500',    chip: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700' },
  RUNNING:   { label: 'Sending',   dot: 'bg-sky-500',     chip: 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700' },
  PAUSED:    { label: 'Paused',    dot: 'bg-yellow-500',  chip: 'bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700' },
  COMPLETED: { label: 'Completed', dot: 'bg-emerald-500', chip: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700' },
  FAILED:    { label: 'Failed',    dot: 'bg-red-500',     chip: 'bg-red-50 text-red-700' },
  CANCELLED: { label: 'Cancelled', dot: 'bg-slate-400',   chip: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-500' },
  // Recipient statuses
  ACTIVE:       { label: 'Active',       dot: 'bg-emerald-500', chip: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700' },
  UNSUBSCRIBED: { label: 'Unsubscribed', dot: 'bg-amber-500',   chip: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700' },
  BOUNCED:      { label: 'Bounced',      dot: 'bg-orange-500',  chip: 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700' },
  INVALID:      { label: 'Invalid',      dot: 'bg-red-500',     chip: 'bg-red-50 text-red-700' },
};

export function StatusBadge({ status, className }: { status: AnyStatus; className?: string }) {
  const cfg = STATUS_MAP[status] ?? {
    label: String(status),
    dot: 'bg-slate-400',
    chip: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700',
  };
  return (
    <span className={clsx('badge', cfg.chip, className)}>
      <span className={clsx('h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full', cfg.dot)} />
      {cfg.label}
    </span>
  );
}
````

````css
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');

  }

           disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-slate-50 disabled:text-slate-400;

@layer utilities {
````

## frontend/src/lib/campaignChecks.test.ts

````tsx
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { Campaign } from '../types';
import {
  campaignHasContent,
  canSaveAndSend,
  CONTENT_BLOCKER,
  deleteBlockers,
  DELETE_WHILE_SENDING,
  draftLaunchChecks,
  joinBlockers,
  launchBlockers,
  selectedRecipientCount,
} from './campaignChecks';

function campaign(overrides: Partial<Campaign> = {}): Campaign {
  return {
    id: 1,
    name: 'Welcome',
    subject: 'Hello {{FirstName}}',
    senderEmail: 'sender@test.local',
    status: 'DRAFT',
    createdAt: '2026-10-25T00:00:00Z',
    updatedAt: '2026-10-25T00:00:00Z',
    totalRecipients: 0,
    sentCount: 0,
    failedCount: 0,
    skippedCount: 0,
    bouncedCount: 0,
    retryCount: 0,
    successRate: 0,
    recipientIds: [10],
    targetAddressCount: 0,
    hasContent: true,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe('launchBlockers: the content rule', () => {
  it('lets a campaign with content, a subject, a sender and recipients launch', () => {
    expect(launchBlockers(campaign())).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('blocks a campaign without email content, whatever its template', () => {
    expect(launchBlockers(campaign({ hasContent: false }))).toEqual([CONTENT_BLOCKER]);
    // A template is not enough when the server says it has no body (or was deleted).
    expect(launchBlockers(campaign({ hasContent: false, templateId: 3, templateName: 'Empty' }))).toEqual([
      CONTENT_BLOCKER,
    ]);
    expect(CONTENT_BLOCKER).toBe('add the email content (choose a template or write the email)');
  });

  it('needs no template when the campaign has its own body', () => {
    expect(launchBlockers(campaign({ templateId: undefined, hasContent: true, customBody: 'Hi {{FirstName}}' }))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('trusts the server; without hasContent it falls back to the own body or a template ID', () => {
    expect(campaignHasContent({ hasContent: false, customBody: 'text', templateId: 3 })).toBe(false);
    expect(campaignHasContent({ hasContent: true })).toBe(true);
    expect(campaignHasContent({ customBody: 'Hello' })).toBe(true);
    expect(campaignHasContent({ customBody: '   ' })).toBe(false);
    expect(campaignHasContent({ templateId: 3 })).toBe(true);
    expect(campaignHasContent({})).toBe(false);
  });

  it('lists every missing piece, content first', () => {
    const c = campaign({ hasContent: false, subject: ' ', senderEmail: '', recipientIds: [], targetAddressCount: 0 });
    expect(launchBlockers(c)).toEqual([CONTENT_BLOCKER, 'add a subject', 'add a sender email', 'select recipients']);
    expect(joinBlockers(launchBlockers(c))).toBe(
      'add the email content (choose a template or write the email), add a subject, add a sender email and select recipients',
    );
  });

  it('counts campaign-only addresses and groups as recipients', () => {
    expect(launchBlockers(campaign({ recipientIds: [], targetAddressCount: 2 }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(launchBlockers(campaign({ recipientIds: [], recipientGroupIds: [4] }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(selectedRecipientCount(campaign({ recipientIds: [1, 2], targetAddressCount: 3 }))).toBe(5);
  });
});

describe('draftLaunchChecks and canSaveAndSend (the form before saving)', () => {
  const ready = { hasContent: true, subjectOk: true, senderEmailOk: true, sendableRecipients: 2, groupCount: 0 };

  it('passes when every check passes', () => {
    expect(draftLaunchChecks(ready).every((c) => c.ok)).toBe(true);
    expect(draftLaunchChecks(ready).map((c) => c.key)).toEqual(['content', 'subject', 'sender', 'recipients']);
  });

  it('fails the content check without content', () => {
    const checks = draftLaunchChecks({ ...ready, hasContent: false });
    expect(checks.find((c) => c.key === 'content')?.ok).toBe(false);
    expect(checks.filter((c) => !c.ok)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('needs a recipient who can be emailed, or a group', () => {
    expect(draftLaunchChecks({ ...ready, sendableRecipients: 0 }).find((c) => c.key === 'recipients')?.ok).toBe(false);
    expect(draftLaunchChecks({ ...ready, sendableRecipients: 0, groupCount: 1 }).find((c) => c.key === 'recipients')?.ok).toBe(true);
  });

  it('offers "Save and send now" only to managers when everything is ready', () => {
    expect(canSaveAndSend({ ...ready, canManage: true })).toBe(true);
    expect(canSaveAndSend({ ...ready, canManage: false })).toBe(false);
    expect(canSaveAndSend({ ...ready, hasContent: false, canManage: true })).toBe(false);
    expect(canSaveAndSend({ ...ready, subjectOk: false, canManage: true })).toBe(false);
    expect(canSaveAndSend({ ...ready, senderEmailOk: false, canManage: true })).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('deleteBlockers', () => {
  it('refuses QUEUED and RUNNING campaigns only', () => {
    expect(deleteBlockers({ status: 'QUEUED' })).toEqual([DELETE_WHILE_SENDING]);
    expect(deleteBlockers({ status: 'RUNNING' })).toEqual([DELETE_WHILE_SENDING]);
    for (const status of ['DRAFT', 'SCHEDULED', 'PAUSED', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED'] as const) {
      expect(deleteBlockers({ status })).toEqual([]);
    }
  });
});
````

## frontend/src/lib/campaignChecks.ts

````tsx
import type { Campaign } from '../types';
import { hasEmailContent } from './campaignContent';

/** Number of campaign-only addresses (emailed without being saved as contacts). */
export function campaignOnlyCount(c: Campaign): number {
  return c.targetAddressCount ?? c.targetAddresses?.length ?? 0;
}

/**
 * Number of recipients selected for a campaign: saved contacts plus campaign-only
 * addresses (group members are resolved at launch).
 */
export function selectedRecipientCount(c: Campaign): number {
  return (c.recipientIds?.length ?? 0) + campaignOnlyCount(c);
}

export function hasRecipientTargets(c: Campaign): boolean {
  return selectedRecipientCount(c) > 0 || (c.recipientGroupIds?.length ?? 0) > 0;
}

/**
 * Whether a saved campaign has email content: its own body, or a non-deleted template
 * with a body. The server computes it for every campaign (`hasContent`); without that
 * field, the campaign's own body or a template ID is the best the client knows.
 */
export function campaignHasContent(c: Pick<Campaign, 'hasContent' | 'customBody' | 'templateId'>): boolean {
  if (typeof c.hasContent === 'boolean') return c.hasContent;
  return hasEmailContent(c.customBody, null) || !!c.templateId;
}

/** The launch blocker for a campaign without email content. */
export const CONTENT_BLOCKER = 'add the email content (choose a template or write the email)';

/**
 * What still blocks launching a draft, mirroring the backend's launch validation:
 * email content (the campaign's own body, or a template with a body), a subject, a
 * sender email and at least one recipient are required.
 * An empty list means the campaign can be launched.
 */
export function launchBlockers(c: Campaign): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  if (!campaignHasContent(c)) out.push(CONTENT_BLOCKER);
  if (!c.subject?.trim()) out.push('add a subject');
  if (!c.senderEmail?.trim()) out.push('add a sender email');
  if (!hasRecipientTargets(c)) out.push('select recipients');
  return out;
}

/** What the campaign form knows before saving, for its launch checklist. */
export interface DraftLaunchInput {
  /** Email content (see contentReady in campaignContent). */
  hasContent: boolean;
  /** A subject that can be saved (no subjectError). */
  subjectOk: boolean;
  /** A valid sender email. */
  senderEmailOk: boolean;
  /** Recipients who can be emailed, after skipping unsubscribed and inactive contacts. */
  sendableRecipients: number;
  /** Recipient groups set through the API (their members are added at launch). */
  groupCount: number;
}

export type LaunchCheckKey = 'content' | 'subject' | 'sender' | 'recipients';

/** The form's launch checklist: the same four rules as launchBlockers and the server. */
export function draftLaunchChecks(d: DraftLaunchInput): { key: LaunchCheckKey; ok: boolean }[] {
  return [
    { key: 'content', ok: d.hasContent },
    { key: 'subject', ok: d.subjectOk },
    { key: 'sender', ok: d.senderEmailOk },
    { key: 'recipients', ok: d.sendableRecipients > 0 || d.groupCount > 0 },
  ];
}

/** "Save and send now" is offered only when every launch check passes and the user may send. */
export function canSaveAndSend(d: DraftLaunchInput & { canManage: boolean }): boolean {
  return d.canManage && draftLaunchChecks(d).every((c) => c.ok);
}

/** The server's answer (409) to deleting a QUEUED or RUNNING campaign. */
export const DELETE_WHILE_SENDING = 'This campaign is sending. Cancel it, wait until sending stops, then delete it.';

/**
 * Why a campaign can't be deleted yet, mirroring the server's rule as far as the
 * client can know it: QUEUED and RUNNING campaigns are sending. An empty list means
 * the delete can be offered. The server also refuses (409, with the reason) while a
 * send job of the campaign is still running or some of its emails are still in the
 * send queue; the campaign data on the client doesn't show that.
 */
export function deleteBlockers(c: Pick<Campaign, 'status'>): string[] {
  return c.status === 'QUEUED' || c.status === 'RUNNING' ? [DELETE_WHILE_SENDING] : [];
}

/** "choose an email template and select recipients" */
export function joinBlockers(items: string[]): string {
  if (items.length <= 1) return items.join('');
  return `${items.slice(0, -1).join(', ')} and ${items[items.length - 1]}`;
}
````

````tsx
import {

  type ContentState,
} from './campaignContent';
import { EMPTY_SELECTION, type CombinedRecipient, type RecipientSelection } from './recipientSelection';

const NEWSLETTER = { subject: 'October news', htmlBody: '<p>Hi {{FirstName}}</p>', plainBody: 'Hi {{FirstName}}' };
const HTML_ONLY = {
  subject: 'Launch',
  htmlBody: '<h1>Hello {{Name}}</h1>\n<p>We&rsquo;re <b>live</b> &amp; ready.<br>See you</p><ul><li>One</li><li>Two</li></ul>',
  plainBody: null,
};

describe('insertAtCursor (placeholder chips)', () => {
  it('inserts at the cursor and puts the cursor after the placeholder', () => {
    expect(insertAtCursor('Hello , welcome', '{{FirstName}}', 6, 6)).toEqual({
      value: 'Hello {{FirstName}}, welcome',
      cursor: 6 + '{{FirstName}}'.length,
    });
  });

  it('replaces the selected text', () => {
    expect(insertAtCursor('Dear customer,', '{{Name}}', 5, 13)).toEqual({ value: 'Dear {{Name}},', cursor: 13 });
  });

  it('appends when the field has no cursor position', () => {
    expect(insertAtCursor('Thanks', ' {{Company}}', null)).toEqual({ value: 'Thanks {{Company}}', cursor: 18 });
    expect(insertAtCursor('', '{{Email}}', undefined)).toEqual({ value: '{{Email}}', cursor: 9 });
  });

  it('copes with positions outside the text', () => {
    expect(insertAtCursor('abc', 'X', 10, 12).value).toBe('abcX');
    expect(insertAtCursor('abc', 'X', 1, 0)).toEqual({ value: 'aXbc', cursor: 2 });
    expect(insertAtCursor('abc', 'X', -1).value).toBe('abcX');
  });

  it('writes placeholders as {{key}}', () => {
    expect(placeholderToken('Team')).toBe('{{Team}}');
  });
});

describe('placeholder chips', () => {
  it('offers the supported placeholders, then custom fields that are not one of them', () => {
    expect(placeholderChips([])).toEqual([...STANDARD_PLACEHOLDERS]);
    expect(placeholderChips(['Team', 'role', 'Team', ' Region ', 'bad key', 'email', 'course'])).toEqual([
      ...STANDARD_PLACEHOLDERS,
      'Team',
      'Region',
    ]);
  });

  it('takes custom fields from the upload mapping and from the draft addresses', () => {
    const sel: RecipientSelection = {
      ...EMPTY_SELECTION,
      upload: {
        file: {} as File,
        mapping: {},
        removedRows: [],
        preview: {
          fileName: 'people.csv', totalRows: 0, validRows: 0, newRows: 0, existingRows: 0, invalidRows: 0,
          duplicateRows: 0, skippedRows: 0, columns: ['Email', 'Team', 'Role'], unmappedColumns: [],
          detectedColumns: { Email: 'email', Team: 'custom:Team', Role: 'custom:role' },
          hasEmailColumn: true, rows: [],
        },
      },
      draft: [{ email: 'ada@test.local', fields: { Region: 'EU' } }],
    };
    expect(customFieldKeys(sel).sort()).toEqual(['Region', 'Team', 'role']);
    expect(placeholderChips(customFieldKeys(sel)).slice(STANDARD_PLACEHOLDERS.length).sort()).toEqual(['Region', 'Team']);
  });
});

describe('subject and body validation (same rules as the backend)', () => {
  it('requires a subject on one line of at most 998 characters', () => {
    expect(SUBJECT_MAX_LENGTH).toBe(998);
    expect(subjectError('')).toBe('A subject is required, even for a draft');
    expect(subjectError('   ')).toBe('A subject is required, even for a draft');
    expect(subjectError('Hello {{FirstName}}')).toBeNull();
    expect(subjectError('Tab\there')).toBeNull();
    expect(subjectError('s'.repeat(998))).toBeNull();
    expect(subjectError('s'.repeat(999))).toBe('Use at most 998 characters');
    expect(subjectError('Hello\nBcc: someone@test.local')).toBe('The subject must be on one line');
    expect(subjectError('Hello\rWorld')).toBe('The subject must be on one line');
    expect(subjectError(`Bell ${String.fromCharCode(7)}`)).toBe('Remove the control character from the subject');
    // Trimmed as it is sent: a line break at the end is not part of the subject.
    expect(subjectError('Hello\n')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('allows a blank body (drafts), tabs and line breaks, and refuses other control characters', () => {
    expect(BODY_MAX_LENGTH).toBe(100_000);
    expect(bodyError('')).toBeNull();
    expect(bodyError('Line one\r\nLine two\n\tindented')).toBeNull();
    expect(bodyError('b'.repeat(100_000))).toBeNull();
    expect(bodyError('b'.repeat(100_001))).toContain('at most 100,000 characters');
    for (const code of [0x00, 0x07, 0x08, 0x0b, 0x0c, 0x0e, 0x1b, 0x1f, 0x7f, 0x85, 0x9f]) {
      expect(bodyError(`text ${String.fromCharCode(code)} more`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toContain('control character');
    }
    expect(bodyError('café \u00a0 😀 שלום')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('treats U+0000-U+001F and U+007F-U+009F as control characters', () => {
    expect(isControlChar(0x00)).toBe(true);
    expect(isControlChar(0x1f)).toBe(true);
    expect(isControlChar(0x20)).toBe(false);
    expect(isControlChar(0x7e)).toBe(false);
    expect(isControlChar(0x7f)).toBe(true);
    expect(isControlChar(0x9f)).toBe(true);
    expect(isControlChar(0xa0)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('template or the campaign’s own text', () => {
  const own = (body: string, templateId: number | null = null): ContentState => ({ templateId, source: 'own', body });
  const fromTemplate = (templateId: number): ContentState => ({ templateId, source: 'template', body: '' });

  it('opens a stored campaign with its own body, or with its template’s content', () => {
    expect(initialContent('Hi {{FirstName}}', 3)).toEqual(own('Hi {{FirstName}}', 3));
    expect(initialContent(null, 3)).toEqual(fromTemplate(3));
    expect(initialContent('   ', 3)).toEqual(fromTemplate(3));
    expect(initialContent(undefined, null)).toEqual(own(''));
  });

  it('saves the own body, and "" (clear) for the template’s content', () => {
    expect(customBodyToSave(own('Hello'))).toBe('Hello');
    expect(customBodyToSave(fromTemplate(3))).toBe('');
    expect(customBodyToSave(own('', 3))).toBe('');
  });

  it('"Customize for this campaign" copies the plain body, or the text of an HTML-only template', () => {
    expect(customizeFromTemplate(NEWSLETTER)).toEqual({ body: 'Hi {{FirstName}}', from: 'plain', formattingLost: true });
    expect(customizeFromTemplate({ plainBody: 'Plain only' })).toEqual({ body: 'Plain only', from: 'plain', formattingLost: false });
    expect(customizeFromTemplate(HTML_ONLY)).toEqual({
      body: 'Hello {{Name}}\n\nWe’re live & ready.\nSee you\n\n- One\n- Two',
      from: 'html',
      formattingLost: true,
    });
    expect(customizeFromTemplate({ htmlBody: ' ', plainBody: '' })).toEqual({ body: '', from: 'none', formattingLost: false });
    expect(customize(fromTemplate(3), NEWSLETTER)).toEqual(own('Hi {{FirstName}}', 3));
  });

  it('"Use the template’s content" clears the own body', () => {
    expect(switchToTemplateContent(own('My text', 3))).toEqual(fromTemplate(3));
    // Without a template there is nothing to go back to.
    expect(switchToTemplateContent(own('My text'))).toEqual(own('My text'));
  });

  it('choosing a template fills an empty subject, or one that came from the previous template, without asking', () => {
    expect(planTemplateChange({ subject: '', previous: null, next: NEWSLETTER, state: own('') })).toEqual({
      fillSubject: true, askSubject: false, askBody: false,
    });
    expect(
      planTemplateChange({ subject: 'Launch', previous: HTML_ONLY, next: NEWSLETTER, state: fromTemplate(1) }),
    ).toEqual({ fillSubject: true, askSubject: false, askBody: false });
  });

  it('asks before replacing a subject the user typed', () => {
    expect(planTemplateChange({ subject: 'My own subject', previous: null, next: NEWSLETTER, state: own('') })).toEqual({
      fillSubject: false, askSubject: true, askBody: false,
    });
    // Nothing to replace when the subject already is the template's.
    expect(planTemplateChange({ subject: 'October news', previous: null, next: NEWSLETTER, state: own('') }).askSubject).toBe(false);
  });

  it('asks before replacing the campaign’s own text, after customizing or writing it', () => {
    expect(planTemplateChange({ subject: '', previous: NEWSLETTER, next: HTML_ONLY, state: own('Customized', 2) }).askBody).toBe(true);
    expect(planTemplateChange({ subject: '', previous: null, next: NEWSLETTER, state: own('Written by me') }).askBody).toBe(true);
    expect(planTemplateChange({ subject: '', previous: null, next: NEWSLETTER, state: own('   ') }).askBody).toBe(false);
    expect(planTemplateChange({ subject: '', previous: NEWSLETTER, next: HTML_ONLY, state: fromTemplate(2) }).askBody).toBe(false);
    // "No template" never asks: the own text stays.
    expect(planTemplateChange({ subject: 'x', previous: NEWSLETTER, next: null, state: own('Mine', 2) })).toEqual({
      fillSubject: false, askSubject: false, askBody: false,
    });
  });

  it('applies the choice: the template’s content, or the own text kept', () => {
    expect(applyTemplateChange(own('Mine'), 4, false)).toEqual(fromTemplate(4));
    expect(applyTemplateChange(own('Mine'), 4, true)).toEqual(own('Mine', 4));
    expect(applyTemplateChange(own('  '), 4, true)).toEqual(fromTemplate(4));
    expect(applyTemplateChange(fromTemplate(4), null, true)).toEqual(own(''));
    expect(applyTemplateChange(own('Mine', 4), null, false)).toEqual(own('Mine'));
  });

  it('applies the server’s content rule: an own body, or a usable template', () => {
    expect(hasEmailContent('Hello', null)).toBe(true);
    expect(hasEmailContent('  ', NEWSLETTER)).toBe(true);
    expect(hasEmailContent(null, { htmlBody: ' ', plainBody: '' })).toBe(false);
    expect(hasEmailContent(null, { ...NEWSLETTER, deleted: true })).toBe(false);
    expect(hasEmailContent('Mine', { deleted: true })).toBe(true);
    expect(hasEmailContent(undefined, undefined)).toBe(false);

    expect(contentReady(fromTemplate(3), NEWSLETTER)).toBe(true);
    expect(contentReady(fromTemplate(3), { htmlBody: '', plainBody: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(contentReady(own(''), NEWSLETTER)).toBe(false); // no template chosen
    expect(contentReady(own('', 3), NEWSLETTER)).toBe(true); // blank own text: the template is sent
    expect(contentReady(own('Hi'), null)).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('htmlToText', () => {
  it('keeps the text and the placeholders and drops markup, scripts, styles and comments', () => {
    expect(
      htmlToText(
        '<html><head><title>x</title><style>p{color:red}</style></head><body><!-- note --><p>Hi {{FirstName}},</p>' +
          '<script>alert(1)</script><p>Visit <a href="https://x.test/?a=1&amp;b=2">our site</a>.</p></body></html>',
      ),
    ).toBe('Hi {{FirstName}},\n\nVisit our site.');
  });

  it('decodes entities once', () => {
    expect(htmlToText('<p>&lt;b&gt; &amp;amp; &#39;q&#39; &#x263A; &nbsp;x</p>')).toBe("<b> &amp; 'q' ☺ x");
  });
});

describe('sampleFor (the preview recipient)', () => {
  it('uses a saved contact’s stored data, otherwise the address’s own values', () => {
    const contact: CombinedRecipient = {
      email: 'ada@test.local', sources: ['manual'], origin: 'manual', name: 'Typed name',
      contact: {
        id: 7, email: 'ada@test.local', name: 'Ada Lovelace', firstName: 'Ada', company: 'Acme',
        customFields: { Team: 'Platform' }, status: 'ACTIVE', createdAt: '', updatedAt: '',
      },
    };
    expect(sampleFor(contact)).toMatchObject({ email: 'ada@test.local', name: 'Ada Lovelace', fields: { Team: 'Platform' } });
    expect(sampleFor({ email: 'new@test.local', sources: ['manual'], origin: 'manual', company: 'Beta' }))
      .toMatchObject({ email: 'new@test.local', company: 'Beta', fields: {} });
  });
});
````
