````tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import {
  ArrowLeft, Users, CheckCircle2, XCircle, SkipForward, Gauge, Clock, RefreshCw, Mail,
  Send, AlertTriangle, Loader2, Pencil, Trash2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { RadialBarChart, RadialBar, ResponsiveContainer, PolarAngleAxis } from 'recharts';
import { campaignsApi } from '../api/campaigns';
import type { Campaign, CampaignAnalytics, CampaignStatus } from '../types';
import { Card, StatusBadge, LoadingState, Button, Modal } from '../components/ui';
import { CampaignFormModal } from '../components/CampaignFormModal';
import { DeleteCampaignModal } from '../components/DeleteCampaignModal';
import { useAuthStore } from '../store/authStore';
import {
  campaignOnlyCount, deleteBlockers, joinBlockers, launchBlockers, selectedRecipientCount,
} from '../lib/campaignChecks';
import { apiErrorMessage, apiErrorStatus, isForbidden } from '../lib/errors';
import { canManage, noPermissionMessage } from '../lib/roles';

/** Retry failed loads, except a 404: a deleted or unknown campaign won't come back. */
const retryUnlessNotFound = (failureCount: number, error: unknown) =>
  apiErrorStatus(error) !== 404 && failureCount < 3;

/** Statuses during which the backend is actively processing — poll for updates. */
const ACTIVE_STATUSES: CampaignStatus[] = ['QUEUED', 'RUNNING'];
/** Statuses from which a campaign can be launched. */
const LAUNCHABLE: CampaignStatus[] = ['DRAFT', 'SCHEDULED'];

/**
 * Formats emails-per-minute throughput for display.
 * Below 1/min we show two decimals (e.g. 0.66) so slow sends aren't rounded up
 * to a misleading "1"; at/above 1/min we show a whole number.
 */
function formatThroughput(value: number): string {
  if (value <= 0) return '0';
  if (value < 1) return value.toFixed(2);
  if (value < 10) return value.toFixed(1);
  return Math.round(value).toString();
}

function MetricTile({
  icon: Icon, label, value, tone,
}: {
  icon: React.ElementType;
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  tone: string;
}) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className={`flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${tone}`}>
          <Icon className="h-5 w-5" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">{label}</p>
          <p className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-900">{value}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

export default function CampaignDetailPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const campaignId = Number(id);
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  // Only admins and campaign managers may edit or launch (roles also survive a page reload).
  const canSend = useAuthStore((s) => canManage(s.roles));
  const [confirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editOpen, setEditOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleteOpen, setDeleteOpen] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const { data: campaign, isLoading, error: loadError } = useQuery<Campaign>({
    queryKey: ['campaign', campaignId],
    queryFn: () => campaignsApi.getById(campaignId),
    retry: retryUnlessNotFound,
    // Poll while the campaign is being processed so progress updates live.
    refetchInterval: (query) => {
      const c = query.state.data as Campaign | undefined;
      return c && ACTIVE_STATUSES.includes(c.status) ? 3000 : false;
    },
  });

  const isActive = campaign ? ACTIVE_STATUSES.includes(campaign.status) : false;

  const { data: analytics } = useQuery<CampaignAnalytics>({
    queryKey: ['campaign-analytics', campaignId],
    queryFn: () => campaignsApi.getAnalytics(campaignId),
    retry: retryUnlessNotFound,
    // Keep analytics in step with the campaign poll.
    refetchInterval: isActive ? 3000 : false,
  });

  const launchMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => campaignsApi.launch(campaignId),
    onSuccess: () => {
      // Same toast id for success and failure: repeated clicks never stack notifications.
      toast.success('Campaign launched. Sending in progress.', { id: `campaign-action-${campaignId}` });
      setConfirmOpen(false);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['campaign', campaignId] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['campaign-analytics', campaignId] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['campaigns'] });
    },
    onError: (e: unknown) => {
      toast.error(
        isForbidden(e) ? noPermissionMessage('launch campaigns') : apiErrorMessage(e, 'Failed to launch campaign'),
        { id: `campaign-action-${campaignId}` },
      );
    },
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <LoadingState label="Loading campaign…" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!campaign) {
    // A deleted (or unknown) campaign answers 404.
    const notFound = apiErrorStatus(loadError) === 404;
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <Link
          to="/campaigns"
          className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 transition hover:text-slate-700"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> Back to campaigns
        </Link>
        <Card>
          <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{notFound ? 'Campaign not found' : 'Could not load the campaign'}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
            {notFound
              ? "It doesn't exist or it was deleted."
              : apiErrorMessage(loadError, 'Please try again in a moment.')}
          </p>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const processed = campaign.sentCount + campaign.failedCount + campaign.skippedCount;
  const progress = campaign.totalRecipients > 0 ? (processed / campaign.totalRecipients) * 100 : 0;
  const successRate = analytics?.successRate ?? campaign.successRate ?? 0;
  const radialData = [{ name: 'Success', value: Math.round(successRate), fill: '#2563eb' }];
  const isDraft = campaign.status === 'DRAFT';
  const blockers = launchBlockers(campaign);
  const deleteReasons = deleteBlockers(campaign);
  const selectedCount = selectedRecipientCount(campaign);
  const onlyCount = campaignOnlyCount(campaign);
  const groupCount = campaign.recipientGroupIds?.length ?? 0;
  // The campaign's own body wins over its template when it has one.
  const contentLabel = campaign.customBody?.trim()
    ? 'Written for this campaign'
    : campaign.templateName
    ? `Template: ${campaign.templateName}`
    : 'None yet';

  return (
    <div className="page">
      {/* Back link */}
      <Link
        to="/campaigns"
        className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 transition hover:text-slate-700"
      >
        <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> Back to campaigns
      </Link>

      {/* Header */}
      <div className="mb-6 flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <h1 className="truncate text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">{campaign.name}</h1>
            <StatusBadge status={campaign.status} />
            {isActive && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-brand-600">
                <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> Live
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">{campaign.subject}</p>
        </div>

        {/* Actions. Email content, subject, sender email and recipients are required to launch;
            the button is disabled with one inline, actionable hint instead of letting
            the backend reject the launch with an error toast. Delete is offered in every
            status and disabled, with the reason, while the campaign is sending. */}
        {canSend && (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {isDraft && (
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setEditOpen(true)} disabled={launchMutation.isPending}>
                  <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Edit draft
                </Button>
              )}
              {LAUNCHABLE.includes(campaign.status) && (
                <Button
                  onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(true)}
                  disabled={launchMutation.isPending || blockers.length > 0}
                >
                  <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Launch campaign
                </Button>
              )}
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                className="text-red-600 hover:text-red-700"
                onClick={() => setDeleteOpen(true)}
                disabled={launchMutation.isPending || deleteReasons.length > 0}
                title={deleteReasons[0]}
              >
                <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                Delete
              </Button>
            </div>
            {LAUNCHABLE.includes(campaign.status) && blockers.length > 0 && (
              <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-amber-600">
                <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Before launching, {joinBlockers(blockers)}{isDraft ? ' (Edit draft)' : ''}.
              </p>
            )}
            {deleteReasons.length > 0 && (
              <p className="max-w-sm text-right text-xs text-slate-500">{deleteReasons[0]}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* What the draft will send: shown before launch, when the counters are still 0. */}
      {isDraft && (
        <Card className="mb-6">
          <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm sm:grid-cols-4">
            <div>
              <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">Content</dt>
              <dd className="font-medium text-slate-800">{contentLabel}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">Recipients selected</dt>
              <dd className="font-medium tabular-nums text-slate-800">
                {selectedCount.toLocaleString()}
                {groupCount > 0 && <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-500"> + {groupCount} group{groupCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>}
                {onlyCount > 0 && (
                  <span className="block text-xs font-normal text-slate-500" title="Stored with this campaign, not saved as contacts">
                    incl. {onlyCount.toLocaleString()} campaign-only
                  </span>
                )}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">Sender</dt>
              <dd className="truncate font-medium text-slate-800">
                {campaign.senderEmail ? `${campaign.senderName ? `${campaign.senderName} ` : ''}<${campaign.senderEmail}>` : 'Not set'}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">Reply-to</dt>
              <dd className="truncate font-medium text-slate-800">{campaign.replyTo || 'Not set'}</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Edit a draft (template, recipients, details) */}
      {isDraft && (
        <CampaignFormModal
          open={editOpen}
          campaign={campaign}
          onClose={() => setEditOpen(false)}
          onSaved={(saved) => {
            queryClient.setQueryData(['campaign', campaignId], saved);
            queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['campaign', campaignId] });
            queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['campaigns'] });
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Delete confirmation; afterwards the campaign is gone, so go back to the list */}
      <DeleteCampaignModal
        campaign={canSend && deleteOpen ? campaign : null}
        onClose={() => setDeleteOpen(false)}
        onDeleted={() => navigate('/campaigns', { replace: true })}
      />

      {/* Pre-send confirmation */}
      <Modal
        open={confirmOpen}
        onClose={() => !launchMutation.isPending && setConfirmOpen(false)}
        title="Launch this campaign?"
        description="This starts sending emails to every attached recipient. This cannot be undone."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(false)}
              disabled={launchMutation.isPending}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={() => launchMutation.mutate()} loading={launchMutation.isPending}>
              {launchMutation.isPending ? 'Launching…' : 'Yes, send now'}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3">
            <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-amber-500" />
            <p className="text-sm text-amber-800">
              You are about to send <b>{campaign.name}</b> to its recipients. Make sure the
              subject, content and recipient list are correct.
            </p>
          </div>
          <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-sm">
            <div className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2">
              <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">Recipients selected</dt>
              <dd className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-900">
                {selectedCount.toLocaleString()}
                {groupCount > 0 && <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-500"> + {groupCount} group{groupCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>}
                {onlyCount > 0 && (
                  <span className="block text-xs font-normal text-slate-500">incl. {onlyCount.toLocaleString()} campaign-only</span>
                )}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2">
              <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">Subject</dt>
              <dd className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">{campaign.subject}</dd>
            </div>
            <div className="col-span-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2">
              <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">Content</dt>
              <dd className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">{contentLabel}</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Unsubscribed, bounced or deleted contacts are skipped, and so are unsubscribed addresses. A campaign-only
            address that has since become a saved contact is sent to that contact. The final number of emails is shown
            once the campaign starts.
          </p>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Progress */}
      {campaign.totalRecipients > 0 && (
        <Card className="mb-6">
          <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
            <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">Processing progress</span>
            <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-900">{progress.toFixed(1)}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="h-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-100">
            <div
              className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-brand-500 to-accent-500 transition-all duration-700"
              style={{ width: `${Math.min(progress, 100)}%` }}
            />
          </div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-400">
            {processed.toLocaleString()} of {campaign.totalRecipients.toLocaleString()} recipients processed
          </p>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Metric tiles */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <MetricTile icon={Users} label="Total Recipients" value={campaign.totalRecipients.toLocaleString()} tone="bg-brand-50 text-brand-600" />
        <MetricTile icon={CheckCircle2} label="Sent" value={campaign.sentCount.toLocaleString()} tone="bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600" />
        <MetricTile icon={XCircle} label="Failed" value={campaign.failedCount.toLocaleString()} tone="bg-red-50 text-red-600" />
        <MetricTile icon={SkipForward} label="Skipped" value={campaign.skippedCount.toLocaleString()} tone="bg-amber-50 text-amber-600" />
      </div>

      {/* Analytics */}
      <div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {/* Success rate radial */}
        <Card className="flex flex-col items-center">
          <h3 className="section-title mb-2 self-start">Success Rate</h3>
          <div className="relative">
            <ResponsiveContainer width={180} height={180}>
              <RadialBarChart
                innerRadius="72%"
                outerRadius="100%"
                data={radialData}
                startAngle={90}
                endAngle={-270}
              >
                <PolarAngleAxis type="number" domain={[0, 100]} tick={false} />
                <RadialBar dataKey="value" cornerRadius={10} background={{ fill: '#eef2f7' }} />
              </RadialBarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
              <span className="text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900">{successRate.toFixed(0)}%</span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">sent</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card>

        {/* Throughput */}
        <Card>
          <h3 className="section-title mb-4">Throughput</h3>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-accent-50 text-accent-600">
              <Gauge className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-3xl font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-900">
                {formatThroughput(analytics?.throughputPerMinute ?? 0)}
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">emails / minute</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          {analytics?.durationSeconds != null && (
            <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4 text-sm text-slate-500">
              <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" />
              Duration: {Math.floor(analytics.durationSeconds / 60)}m {analytics.durationSeconds % 60}s
            </div>
          )}
        </Card>

        {/* Breakdown */}
        <Card>
          <h3 className="section-title mb-4">Breakdown</h3>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {[
              { icon: RefreshCw, label: 'Retried', value: analytics?.retried ?? campaign.retryCount, color: 'text-amber-500' },
              { icon: Mail, label: 'Bounced', value: analytics?.bounced ?? campaign.bouncedCount, color: 'text-orange-500' },
              { icon: SkipForward, label: 'Skipped', value: analytics?.skipped ?? campaign.skippedCount, color: 'text-slate-400' },
            ].map(({ icon: Icon, label, value, color }) => (
              <div key={label} className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-600">
                  <Icon className={`h-4 w-4 ${color}`} />
                  {label}
                </span>
                <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-900">{value.toLocaleString()}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/pages/CampaignsPage.tsx

````tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Plus, Play, Pause, X, Eye, Search, Send, AlertTriangle, Lock, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { campaignsApi } from '../api/campaigns';
import type { Campaign } from '../types';
import { PageHeader, Card, StatusBadge, EmptyState, Button, LoadingState, Modal } from '../components/ui';
import { CampaignFormModal } from '../components/CampaignFormModal';
import { DeleteCampaignModal } from '../components/DeleteCampaignModal';
import { useAuthStore } from '../store/authStore';
import {
  campaignOnlyCount, deleteBlockers, joinBlockers, launchBlockers, selectedRecipientCount,
} from '../lib/campaignChecks';
import { apiErrorMessage, isForbidden } from '../lib/errors';
import { canManage, noPermissionMessage } from '../lib/roles';

/** Error text for a campaign action; a 403 gets a permission message instead of the raw error. */
function actionError(e: unknown, action: string, fallback: string): string {
  return isForbidden(e) ? noPermissionMessage(action) : apiErrorMessage(e, fallback);
}

export default function CampaignsPage() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  // VIEWER is read-only (the backend allows it GET requests only): no create or send actions.
  const canWrite = useAuthStore((s) => canManage(s.roles));
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [confirmTarget, setConfirmTarget] = useState<Campaign | null>(null);
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<Campaign | null>(null);

  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['campaigns', search],
    queryFn: () => campaignsApi.list({ search: search || undefined, size: 50 }),
  });

  const invalidate = () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['campaigns'] });

  // Toast ids make a repeated error replace the previous toast instead of stacking.
  const launchMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: number) => campaignsApi.launch(id),
    onSuccess: (_c, id) => {
      toast.success('Campaign launched. Sending has started.', { id: `campaign-action-${id}` });
      setConfirmTarget(null);
      invalidate();
    },
    onError: (e, id) =>
      toast.error(actionError(e, 'launch campaigns', 'Could not launch the campaign'), { id: `campaign-action-${id}` }),
  });
  const resumeMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: number) => campaignsApi.resume(id),
    onSuccess: (_c, id) => { toast.success('Campaign resumed', { id: `campaign-action-${id}` }); invalidate(); },
    onError: (e, id) =>
      toast.error(actionError(e, 'resume campaigns', 'Could not resume the campaign'), { id: `campaign-action-${id}` }),
  });
  const pauseMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: number) => campaignsApi.pause(id),
    onSuccess: (_c, id) => { toast.success('Campaign paused', { id: `campaign-action-${id}` }); invalidate(); },
    onError: (e, id) =>
      toast.error(actionError(e, 'pause campaigns', 'Could not pause the campaign'), { id: `campaign-action-${id}` }),
  });
  const cancelMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: number) => campaignsApi.cancel(id),
    onSuccess: (_c, id) => { toast.success('Campaign cancelled', { id: `campaign-action-${id}` }); invalidate(); },
    onError: (e, id) =>
      toast.error(actionError(e, 'cancel campaigns', 'Could not cancel the campaign'), { id: `campaign-action-${id}` }),
  });

  // Pre-launch validation mirrors the backend (email content, subject, sender, recipients).
  // A blocked launch shows ONE actionable message and never calls the API.
  const handleLaunch = (c: Campaign) => {
    if (!canWrite) return;
    if (launchMutation.isPending) return; // guard against double-launch
    const blockers = launchBlockers(c);
    if (blockers.length > 0) {
      toast.error(`Before launching, ${joinBlockers(blockers)}. Open the campaign and choose "Edit draft".`, {
        id: `campaign-action-${c.id}`,
      });
      return;
    }
    setConfirmTarget(c);
  };

  const campaigns = data?.content ?? [];
  const busy =
    launchMutation.isPending || resumeMutation.isPending || pauseMutation.isPending || cancelMutation.isPending;

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <PageHeader
        title="Campaigns"
        description={`${data?.totalElements ?? 0} campaign${(data?.totalElements ?? 0) === 1 ? '' : 's'} total`}
        actions={
          canWrite ? (
            <Button onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}>
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> New Campaign
            </Button>
          ) : undefined
        }
      />

      {!canWrite && (
        <p className="mb-5 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
          <Lock className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-slate-400" />
          You have read-only access. Admins and campaign managers can create, launch, pause, resume, cancel and
          delete campaigns.
        </p>
      )}

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="relative mb-5 max-w-sm">
        <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
        <input
          className="input pl-10"
          placeholder="Search campaigns…"
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          aria-label="Search campaigns"
        />
      </div>

      <Card padded={false}>
        {isLoading ? (
          <LoadingState label="Loading campaigns…" />
        ) : campaigns.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={Send}
            title={search ? 'No campaigns match your search' : 'No campaigns yet'}
            description={
              search
                ? 'Try a different search term.'
                : canWrite
                ? 'Create your first email campaign to start reaching your audience.'
                : 'Admins and campaign managers can create campaigns.'
            }
            action={!search && canWrite && <Button onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}><Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> New Campaign</Button>}
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-left">
                  <th className="px-6 py-3.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Campaign</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Status</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Recipients</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Sent</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Success</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-3.5 text-right text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {campaigns.map((c: Campaign) => {
                  const blockers = c.status === 'DRAFT' ? launchBlockers(c) : [];
                  const deleteReasons = deleteBlockers(c);
                  // Cancelling a draft or scheduled campaign means it won't be sent; otherwise it stops sending.
                  const cancelLabel = c.status === 'DRAFT' || c.status === 'SCHEDULED' ? 'Cancel campaign' : 'Stop sending';
                  return (
                    <tr key={c.id} className="group transition hover:bg-slate-50">
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        <Link to={`/campaigns/${c.id}`} className="block">
                          <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-brand-700">{c.name}</p>
                          <p className="max-w-xs truncate text-xs text-slate-500">{c.subject}</p>
                        </Link>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-4"><StatusBadge status={c.status} /></td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-4 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-700">
                        {c.status === 'DRAFT' ? (
                          <span
                            title={
                              'Selected for this draft' +
                              (campaignOnlyCount(c) > 0 ? `, including ${campaignOnlyCount(c).toLocaleString()} campaign-only` : '') +
                              '. The final count is set at launch.'
                            }
                          >
                            {selectedRecipientCount(c).toLocaleString()}
                            <span className="ml-1 text-xs text-slate-400">selected</span>
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          c.totalRecipients.toLocaleString()
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-4 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-700">
                        {c.sentCount.toLocaleString()}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-4 text-right">
                        <span
                          className={
                            'font-semibold tabular-nums ' +
                            (c.successRate >= 90 ? 'text-emerald-600' : c.successRate > 0 ? 'text-amber-600' : 'text-slate-400')
                          }
                        >
                          {c.successRate.toFixed(1)}%
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                          <Link
                            to={`/campaigns/${c.id}`}
                            className="btn-icon text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-700"
                            aria-label="View campaign"
                            title="View"
                          >
                            <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                          </Link>
                          {canWrite && c.status === 'DRAFT' && (
                            <button
                              className="btn-icon text-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
                              onClick={() => handleLaunch(c)}
                              disabled={busy || blockers.length > 0}
                              aria-label="Launch campaign"
                              title={blockers.length > 0 ? `Before launching, ${joinBlockers(blockers)}` : 'Launch'}
                            >
                              <Play className="h-4 w-4" />
                            </button>
                          )}
                          {canWrite && c.status === 'PAUSED' && (
                            <button
                              className="btn-icon text-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-50 disabled:opacity-50"
                              onClick={() => resumeMutation.mutate(c.id)}
                              disabled={busy}
                              aria-label="Resume campaign"
                              title="Resume"
                            >
                              <Play className="h-4 w-4" />
                            </button>
                          )}
                          {canWrite && c.status === 'RUNNING' && (
                            <button
                              className="btn-icon text-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-50 disabled:opacity-50"
                              onClick={() => pauseMutation.mutate(c.id)}
                              disabled={busy}
                              aria-label="Pause campaign"
                              title="Pause"
                            >
                              <Pause className="h-4 w-4" />
                            </button>
                          )}
                          {canWrite && ['DRAFT', 'SCHEDULED', 'QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED'].includes(c.status) && (
                            <button
                              className="btn-icon text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 disabled:opacity-50"
                              onClick={() => cancelMutation.mutate(c.id)}
                              disabled={busy}
                              aria-label={cancelLabel}
                              title={
                                cancelLabel === 'Stop sending'
                                  ? 'Stop sending: cancels the campaign; it stays in this list'
                                  : "Cancel campaign: it won't be sent; it stays in this list"
                              }
                            >
                              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                            </button>
                          )}
                          {canWrite && (
                            <button
                              className="btn-icon text-slate-500 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-600 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:bg-transparent disabled:hover:text-slate-500"
                              onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(c)}
                              disabled={busy || deleteReasons.length > 0}
                              aria-label={
                                deleteReasons.length > 0 ? `Delete campaign (not possible now: ${deleteReasons[0]})` : 'Delete campaign'
                              }
                              title={deleteReasons[0] ?? 'Delete: removes the campaign from this list'}
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* Launch confirmation (same safeguard as the campaign detail page) */}
      <Modal
        open={canWrite && !!confirmTarget}
        onClose={() => !launchMutation.isPending && setConfirmTarget(null)}
        title="Launch this campaign?"
        description="Emails start sending to the selected recipients. This cannot be undone."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setConfirmTarget(null)} disabled={launchMutation.isPending}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={() => confirmTarget && launchMutation.mutate(confirmTarget.id)}
              loading={launchMutation.isPending}
            >
              {launchMutation.isPending ? 'Launching…' : 'Yes, send now'}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {confirmTarget && (
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-amber-800">
            <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-amber-500" />
            <p>
              <b>{confirmTarget.name}</b> will be sent to {selectedRecipientCount(confirmTarget).toLocaleString()} selected
              recipient{selectedRecipientCount(confirmTarget) === 1 ? '' : 's'}
              {campaignOnlyCount(confirmTarget) > 0
                ? ` (including ${campaignOnlyCount(confirmTarget).toLocaleString()} campaign-only address${campaignOnlyCount(confirmTarget) === 1 ? '' : 'es'})`
                : ''}
              {(confirmTarget.recipientGroupIds?.length ?? 0) > 0 ? ' plus the members of its recipient groups' : ''}.
              Unsubscribed or inactive contacts and unsubscribed addresses are skipped.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>

      {/* Delete confirmation; on success the lists, dashboard and analytics are refreshed */}
      <DeleteCampaignModal campaign={canWrite ? deleteTarget : null} onClose={() => setDeleteTarget(null)} />

      {/* Create campaign modal */}
      <CampaignFormModal
        open={canWrite && createOpen}
        onClose={() => setCreateOpen(false)}
        onSaved={() => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['campaigns'] })}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx

````tsx
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Send, Activity, CheckCircle2, TrendingUp, Mail, XCircle, Users, ArrowRight, Inbox,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  AreaChart, Area, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip,
  PieChart, Pie, Cell, ResponsiveContainer,
} from 'recharts';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { campaignsApi } from '../api/campaigns';
import type { DashboardSummary, Campaign } from '../types';
import { StatCard, Card, StatusBadge, EmptyState } from '../components/ui';

const PIE_COLORS = ['#2563eb', '#ef4444'];

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const { data: summary, isLoading: summaryLoading } = useQuery<DashboardSummary>({
    queryKey: ['dashboard-summary'],
    queryFn: () => apiClient.get('/api/analytics/dashboard').then((r) => r.data),
  });

  const { data: volume } = useQuery<{ date: string; count: number }[]>({
    queryKey: ['daily-volume'],
    queryFn: () => apiClient.get('/api/analytics/volume/daily?days=14').then((r) => r.data),
  });

  const { data: campaignsPage, isLoading: campaignsLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['campaigns', 'dashboard-recent'],
    queryFn: () => campaignsApi.list({ size: 5, sort: 'createdAt', dir: 'desc' }),
  });

  const recentCampaigns = campaignsPage?.content ?? [];
  const totalEmails = (summary?.totalEmailsSent ?? 0) + (summary?.totalEmailsFailed ?? 0);
  const hasDeliveryData = totalEmails > 0;

  const pieData = [
    { name: 'Sent', value: summary?.totalEmailsSent ?? 0 },
    { name: 'Failed', value: summary?.totalEmailsFailed ?? 0 },
  ];

  const hasVolume = (volume?.length ?? 0) > 0 && (volume?.some((v) => v.count > 0) ?? false);

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">Dashboard</h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
          Overview of your email campaign performance.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* ── KPI cards (real data) ───────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <StatCard
          icon={Send}
          label="Total Campaigns"
          value={summary?.totalCampaigns ?? 0}
          tone="brand"
          loading={summaryLoading}
          sub={summary ? `${summary.activeCampaigns} active` : undefined}
        />
        <StatCard
          icon={Mail}
          label="Emails Sent"
          value={summary?.totalEmailsSent?.toLocaleString() ?? 0}
          tone="violet"
          loading={summaryLoading}
        />
        <StatCard
          icon={CheckCircle2}
          label="Delivery Rate"
          value={summary ? `${summary.overallSuccessRate.toFixed(1)}%` : '0%'}
          tone="emerald"
          loading={summaryLoading}
          sub="Confirmed by SMTP"
        />
        <StatCard
          icon={Users}
          label="Total Recipients"
          value={summary?.totalRecipients?.toLocaleString() ?? 0}
          tone="sky"
          loading={summaryLoading}
        />
      </div>

      {/* ── Secondary metrics ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
        <StatCard
          icon={Activity}
          label="Active Campaigns"
          value={summary?.activeCampaigns ?? 0}
          tone="amber"
          loading={summaryLoading}
        />
        <StatCard
          icon={XCircle}
          label="Failed Emails"
          value={summary?.totalEmailsFailed?.toLocaleString() ?? 0}
          tone="red"
          loading={summaryLoading}
        />
        <StatCard
          icon={TrendingUp}
          label="Total Emails Processed"
          value={totalEmails.toLocaleString()}
          tone="brand"
          loading={summaryLoading}
        />
      </div>

      {/* ── Charts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {/* Volume */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-2" padded>
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <h2 className="section-title">Daily Email Volume</h2>
            <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-400">Last 14 days</span>
          </div>
          {hasVolume ? (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={260}>
              <AreaChart data={volume ?? []} margin={{ left: -16, right: 8, top: 4 }}>
                <defs>
                  <linearGradient id="volGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                    <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity={0.25} />
                    <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity={0} />
                  </linearGradient>
                </defs>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#eef2f7" vertical={false} />
                <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={{ fill: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 11 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={{ stroke: '#e2e8f0' }} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fill: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 11 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} allowDecimals={false} />
                <Tooltip
                  contentStyle={{ background: '#fff', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: 12, boxShadow: '0 4px 12px -2px rgba(16,24,40,0.08)', fontSize: 12 }}
                  labelStyle={{ color: '#475569', fontWeight: 600 }}
                />
                <Area type="monotone" dataKey="count" name="Emails" stroke="#2563eb" strokeWidth={2.5} fill="url(#volGrad)" />
              </AreaChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          ) : (
            <EmptyState
              icon={Inbox}
              title="No email activity yet"
              description="Once you launch a campaign, daily email volume will appear here."
            />
          )}
        </Card>

        {/* Delivery distribution */}
        <Card padded>
          <h2 className="section-title mb-4">Delivery Distribution</h2>
          {hasDeliveryData ? (
            <>
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={200}>
                <PieChart>
                  <Pie data={pieData} cx="50%" cy="50%" innerRadius={58} outerRadius={85} paddingAngle={3} dataKey="value" strokeWidth={0}>
                    {pieData.map((_, i) => (
                      <Cell key={i} fill={PIE_COLORS[i % PIE_COLORS.length]} />
                    ))}
                  </Pie>
                  <Tooltip
                    contentStyle={{ background: '#fff', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 12 }}
                  />
                </PieChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
              <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                {pieData.map((d, i) => (
                  <div key={d.name} className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-600">
                      <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: PIE_COLORS[i] }} />
                      {d.name}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{d.value.toLocaleString()}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <EmptyState
              icon={Mail}
              title="No deliveries yet"
              description="Delivery stats will show once emails are sent."
            />
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* ── Recent campaigns ────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Card className="mt-6" padded={false}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-4">
          <h2 className="section-title">Recent Campaigns</h2>
          <Link to="/campaigns" className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-medium text-brand-600 hover:text-brand-700">
            View all <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Link>
        </div>

        {campaignsLoading ? (
          <div className="space-y-3 p-6">
            {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => <div key={i} className="h-12 skeleton" />)}
          </div>
        ) : recentCampaigns.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={Send}
            title="No campaigns yet"
            description="Create your first campaign to start reaching your audience."
            action={<Link to="/campaigns" className="btn-primary">Go to Campaigns</Link>}
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
            {recentCampaigns.map((c: Campaign) => (
              <Link
                key={c.id}
                to={`/campaigns/${c.id}`}
                className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 px-6 py-4 transition hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="truncate font-medium text-slate-900">{c.name}</p>
                  <p className="truncate text-sm text-slate-500">{c.subject}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-6">
                  <div className="hidden text-right sm:block">
                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                      {c.sentCount.toLocaleString()}
                      <span className="font-normal text-slate-400"> / {c.totalRecipients.toLocaleString()}</span>
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">sent</p>
                  </div>
                  <StatusBadge status={c.status} />
                </div>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx

````tsx
import { useState, FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuthStore } from '../store/authStore';
import {
  Mail, Lock, AlertCircle, Eye, EyeOff,
  Zap, Users, BarChart3, CheckCircle2, Send,
} from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '../components/ui';
import { apiErrorMessage, apiErrorStatus } from '../lib/errors';

/**
 * Seeded demo accounts. Shown only in local development, or when the build sets
 * VITE_SHOW_DEMO_ACCOUNTS=true; a public deployment disables these accounts.
 */
const SHOW_DEMO = import.meta.env.DEV || import.meta.env.VITE_SHOW_DEMO_ACCOUNTS === 'true';

const DEMO_ACCOUNTS = [
  { label: 'Admin', email: 'admin@mailflow.local', password: 'Admin@123' },
  { label: 'Manager', email: 'manager@mailflow.local', password: 'Manager@123' },
];

const FEATURES = [
  { icon: Zap, text: 'Campaign Automation' },
  { icon: Users, text: 'Smart Audience Management' },
  { icon: BarChart3, text: 'Real-time Analytics' },
];

function validateEmail(value: string): boolean {
  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
}

export default function LoginPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const login = useAuthStore((s) => s.login);

  const [email, setEmail] = useState(SHOW_DEMO ? DEMO_ACCOUNTS[0].email : '');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState(SHOW_DEMO ? DEMO_ACCOUNTS[0].password : '');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [remember, setRemember] = useState(true);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<{ email?: string; password?: string }>({});

  const handleSubmit = async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');

    // ── Client-side validation ──────────────────────────────────────────
    const errors: { email?: string; password?: string } = {};
    if (!email.trim()) errors.email = 'Email is required';
    else if (!validateEmail(email)) errors.email = 'Enter a valid email address';
    if (!password) errors.password = 'Password is required';
    setFieldErrors(errors);
    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) return;

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Preserve the EXISTING authentication implementation.
      await login(email, password);
      toast.success('Welcome back!');
      navigate('/dashboard');
    } catch (err) {
      const status = apiErrorStatus(err);
      const code = (err as { response?: { data?: { error?: string } } }).response?.data?.error;
      if (status === undefined) {
        setError('Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.');
      } else if (status === 401 && code !== 'ACCOUNT_DISABLED') {
        setError('Invalid email or password. Please try again.');
      } else {
        // A disabled account, or another problem: the server's message says which.
        setError(apiErrorMessage(err, 'Sign-in failed. Please try again.'));
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fillDemo = (demo: { email: string; password: string }) => {
    setEmail(demo.email);
    setPassword(demo.password);
    setFieldErrors({});
    setError('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen bg-white">
      {/* ── LEFT: branding / marketing (desktop only) ─────────────────────── */}
      <div className="relative hidden w-1/2 overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-700 via-brand-600 to-accent-600 lg:flex lg:flex-col">
        {/* Decorative abstract shapes */}
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden" aria-hidden>
          <div className="absolute -left-24 -top-24 h-80 w-80 rounded-full bg-white/10 blur-2xl" />
          <div className="absolute right-0 top-1/3 h-96 w-96 rounded-full bg-accent-400/20 blur-3xl" />
          <div className="absolute -bottom-32 left-1/4 h-80 w-80 rounded-full bg-brand-400/20 blur-3xl" />
          {/* subtle grid */}
          <div
            className="absolute inset-0 opacity-[0.07]"
            style={{
              backgroundImage:
                'linear-gradient(to right, white 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, white 1px, transparent 1px)',
              backgroundSize: '48px 48px',
            }}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="relative z-10 flex h-full flex-col justify-between p-12 xl:p-16">
          {/* Logo */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-white/15 ring-1 ring-white/20 backdrop-blur">
              <Send className="h-5 w-5 text-white" />
            </div>
            <span className="text-xl font-bold text-white">MailFlow</span>
          </div>

          {/* Headline + features */}
          <div className="max-w-md">
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold leading-tight text-white xl:text-[2.75rem]">
              Turn every campaign into meaningful conversations.
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-5 text-lg leading-relaxed text-brand-50/90">
              Create, automate, manage and analyze your email campaigns from one powerful platform.
            </p>

            {/* Abstract automation visual */}
            <div className="mt-10 flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="animate-float flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-white/15 ring-1 ring-white/25 backdrop-blur">
                <Mail className="h-5 w-5 text-white" />
              </div>
              <div className="h-px flex-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/40 to-white/5" />
              <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-white/10 ring-1 ring-white/20 backdrop-blur">
                <Zap className="h-4 w-4 text-white" />
              </div>
              <div className="h-px flex-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/40 to-white/5" />
              <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-white/15 ring-1 ring-white/25 backdrop-blur">
                <Users className="h-5 w-5 text-white" />
              </div>
            </div>

            <ul className="mt-10 space-y-3">
              {FEATURES.map(({ icon: Icon, text }) => (
                <li key={text} className="flex items-center gap-3 text-brand-50">
                  <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/15 ring-1 ring-white/20">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-white" />
                  </span>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium">
                    <Icon className="h-4 w-4 text-brand-100" />
                    {text}
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>

          <p className="text-sm text-brand-100/70">
            © {new Date().getFullYear()} MailFlow — Email Campaign Automation Platform
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── RIGHT: login card ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-center px-4 py-10 sm:px-6 lg:w-1/2">
        <div className="w-full max-w-md animate-fade-in">
          {/* Mobile logo (hidden on desktop since branding panel covers it) */}
          <div className="mb-8 flex items-center gap-3 lg:hidden">
            <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-600 to-accent-600">
              <Send className="h-5 w-5 text-white" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">MailFlow</span>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Email Campaign Automation Platform</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mb-7">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">Welcome back</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">Sign in to your MailFlow account</p>
          </div>

          {/* Auth error */}
          {error && (
            <div
              role="alert"
              className="mb-5 flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700"
            >
              <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{error}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate className="space-y-5">
            {/* Email */}
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="email" className="label">Email address</label>
              <div className="relative">
                <Mail className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
                <input
                  id="email"
                  name="email"
                  type="email"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setEmail(e.target.value);
                    if (fieldErrors.email) setFieldErrors((p) => ({ ...p, email: undefined }));
                  }}
                  className={`input pl-10 ${fieldErrors.email ? 'border-red-400 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500/10' : ''}`}
                  placeholder="you@company.com"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.email}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.email ? 'email-error' : undefined}
                />
              </div>
              {fieldErrors.email && (
                <p id="email-error" className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-red-600">{fieldErrors.email}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Password */}
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label htmlFor="password" className="label">Password</label>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="mb-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-brand-600 hover:text-brand-700 hover:underline"
                  onClick={() => toast('Please contact your administrator to reset your password.', { icon: '🔑' })}
                >
                  Forgot password?
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="relative">
                <Lock className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
                <input
                  id="password"
                  name="password"
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  autoComplete="current-password"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setPassword(e.target.value);
                    if (fieldErrors.password) setFieldErrors((p) => ({ ...p, password: undefined }));
                  }}
                  className={`input pl-10 pr-11 ${fieldErrors.password ? 'border-red-400 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500/10' : ''}`}
                  placeholder="Enter your password"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.password}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.password ? 'password-error' : undefined}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword((v) => !v)}
                  className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 flex h-7 w-7 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-slate-400 transition hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-500"
                  aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
                >
                  {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>
              {fieldErrors.password && (
                <p id="password-error" className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-red-600">{fieldErrors.password}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Remember me */}
            <div className="flex items-center">
              <label className="flex cursor-pointer select-none items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={remember}
                  onChange={(e) => setRemember(e.target.checked)}
                  className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-brand-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500/40"
                />
                Remember me
              </label>
            </div>

            <Button type="submit" loading={loading} className="w-full" size="md">
              {loading ? 'Signing in…' : 'Sign in'}
            </Button>
          </form>

          <p className="mt-6 text-center text-sm text-slate-600">
            New to MailFlow?{' '}
            <Link to="/signup" className="font-semibold text-brand-600 hover:text-brand-700 hover:underline">
              Create your company workspace
            </Link>
          </p>

          {/* Demo credentials (local development only) */}
          {SHOW_DEMO && (
          <div className="mt-7 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4">
            <p className="mb-2.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">
              Demo credentials
            </p>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {DEMO_ACCOUNTS.map((demo) => (
                <button
                  key={demo.email}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => fillDemo(demo)}
                  className="group flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-left transition hover:border-brand-300 hover:bg-brand-50/50"
                >
                  <span>
                    <span className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">{demo.label}</span>
                    <span className="block text-xs text-slate-500">{demo.email}</span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium text-brand-600 opacity-0 transition group-hover:opacity-100">
                    Use →
                  </span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````
