## frontend/src/pages/RecipientsPage.tsx

````tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Upload, Search, Users, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import type { Recipient, PageResponse } from '../types';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { PageHeader, Card, StatusBadge, EmptyState, LoadingState, Button } from '../components/ui';

export default function RecipientsPage() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [importing, setImporting] = useState(false);

  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<PageResponse<Recipient>>({
    queryKey: ['recipients', search, page],
    queryFn: () =>
      apiClient
        .get('/api/recipients', { params: { search: search || undefined, page, size: 25 } })
        .then((r) => r.data),
  });

  const handleCsvImport = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('file', file);
    setImporting(true);

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post('/api/recipients/import/csv', fd, {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
      });
      const result = res.data;
      toast.success(
        `Import complete: ${result.imported} imported, ${result.skippedDuplicates} duplicates, ${result.invalidRows} invalid`
      );
      await qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['recipients'] });
    } catch {
      toast.error('CSV import failed. Check the file format.');
    } finally {
      setImporting(false);
      e.target.value = '';
    }
  };

  const recipients = data?.content ?? [];

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <PageHeader
        title="Recipients"
        description={`${data?.totalElements?.toLocaleString() ?? 0} total recipient${(data?.totalElements ?? 0) === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}
        actions={
          <label
            className={
              'btn-secondary cursor-pointer ' +
              (importing ? 'pointer-events-none opacity-60' : '')
            }
          >
            {importing ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Upload className="h-4 w-4" />}
            {importing ? 'Importing…' : 'Import CSV'}
            <input
              type="file"
              accept=".csv"
              className="hidden"
              disabled={importing}
              onChange={handleCsvImport}
            />
          </label>
        }
      />

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="relative mb-5 max-w-sm">
        <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
        <input
          className="input pl-10"
          placeholder="Search by email or name…"
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setSearch(e.target.value);
            setPage(0);
          }}
          aria-label="Search recipients"
        />
      </div>

      <Card padded={false}>
        {isLoading ? (
          <LoadingState label="Loading recipients…" />
        ) : recipients.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={Users}
            title={search ? 'No recipients match your search' : 'No recipients yet'}
            description={
              search
                ? 'Try a different search term.'
                : 'Import a CSV file to add recipients to your audience.'
            }
            action={
              !search && (
                <label className="btn-primary cursor-pointer">
                  <Upload className="h-4 w-4" /> Import CSV
                  <input type="file" accept=".csv" className="hidden" onChange={handleCsvImport} />
                </label>
              )
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-left">
                  <th className="px-6 py-3.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Email</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Name</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Course</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Company</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-3.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Status</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {recipients.map((r: Recipient) => (
                  <tr key={r.id} className="transition hover:bg-slate-50">
                    <td className="px-6 py-3.5 font-medium text-slate-900">{r.email}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-slate-600">{r.name ?? '—'}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-slate-500">{r.course ?? '—'}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-slate-500">{r.company ?? '—'}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-3.5"><StatusBadge status={r.status} /></td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>

            {data && data.totalPages > 1 && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-200 px-6 py-3.5">
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Page <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">{data.page + 1}</span> of {data.totalPages}
                </p>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={data.first} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)}>
                    Previous
                  </Button>
                  <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={data.last} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}>
                    Next
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/pages/SignUpPage.tsx

````tsx
import { useState, FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AlertCircle, Building2, Lock, Mail, Send, User } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { useAuthStore } from '../store/authStore';
import { Button } from '../components/ui';
import { apiErrorMessage, apiErrorStatus } from '../lib/errors';

interface Fields {
  companyName: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
}

type FieldErrors = Partial<Record<keyof Fields, string>>;

function validate(f: Fields): FieldErrors {
  const errors: FieldErrors = {};
  if (!f.companyName.trim()) errors.companyName = 'Company name is required';
  if (!f.firstName.trim()) errors.firstName = 'First name is required';
  if (!f.lastName.trim()) errors.lastName = 'Last name is required';
  if (!f.email.trim()) errors.email = 'Email is required';
  else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(f.email.trim())) errors.email = 'Enter a valid email address';
  if (f.password.length < 8) errors.password = 'Use at least 8 characters';
  return errors;
}

/**
 * Self sign-up. Creates a new, separate company workspace with the person as its
 * Admin; they can then add teammates on the Team page. Nobody joins an existing
 * company by signing up.
 */
export default function SignUpPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const signUp = useAuthStore((s) => s.signUp);
  const [fields, setFields] = useState<Fields>({
    companyName: '', firstName: '', lastName: '', email: '', password: '',
  });
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<FieldErrors>({});
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const set = (name: keyof Fields) => (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setFields((f) => ({ ...f, [name]: e.target.value }));
    if (fieldErrors[name]) setFieldErrors((p) => ({ ...p, [name]: undefined }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    const errors = validate(fields);
    setFieldErrors(errors);
    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) return;

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await signUp({
        companyName: fields.companyName.trim(),
        firstName: fields.firstName.trim(),
        lastName: fields.lastName.trim(),
        email: fields.email.trim(),
        password: fields.password,
      });
      toast.success(`Welcome to MailFlow, ${fields.firstName.trim()}!`);
      navigate('/dashboard');
    } catch (err) {
      setError(apiErrorStatus(err) === undefined
        ? 'Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.'
        : apiErrorMessage(err, 'Sign-up failed. Please try again.'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const input = (name: keyof Fields, label: string, opts: {
    type?: string; placeholder?: string; autoComplete?: string; icon: typeof Mail;
  }) => {
    const Icon = opts.icon;
    const err = fieldErrors[name];
    return (
      <div>
        <label htmlFor={name} className="label">{label}</label>
        <div className="relative">
          <Icon className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
          <input
            id={name}
            name={name}
            type={opts.type ?? 'text'}
            autoComplete={opts.autoComplete}
            value={fields[name]}
            onChange={set(name)}
            placeholder={opts.placeholder}
            className={`input pl-10 ${err ? 'border-red-400 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500/10' : ''}`}
            aria-invalid={!!err}
            aria-describedby={err ? `${name}-error` : undefined}
          />
        </div>
        {err && <p id={`${name}-error`} className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-red-600">{err}</p>}
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 px-4 py-10">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md animate-fade-in rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-8 shadow-card">
        <div className="mb-6 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-600 to-accent-600">
            <Send className="h-5 w-5 text-white" />
          </div>
          <span className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">MailFlow</span>
        </div>

        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">Create your company workspace</h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
          You'll be the admin. Your contacts, templates and campaigns are private to your company.
        </p>

        {error && (
          <div role="alert" className="mt-5 flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">
            <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate className="mt-6 space-y-4">
          {input('companyName', 'Company name', { icon: Building2, placeholder: 'Acme Ltd', autoComplete: 'organization' })}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {input('firstName', 'First name', { icon: User, autoComplete: 'given-name' })}
            {input('lastName', 'Last name', { icon: User, autoComplete: 'family-name' })}
          </div>
          {input('email', 'Work email', { icon: Mail, type: 'email', placeholder: 'you@company.com', autoComplete: 'email' })}
          {input('password', 'Password', { icon: Lock, type: 'password', placeholder: 'At least 8 characters', autoComplete: 'new-password' })}
          <Button type="submit" loading={loading} className="w-full" size="md">
            {loading ? 'Creating workspace…' : 'Create workspace'}
          </Button>
        </form>

        <p className="mt-6 text-center text-sm text-slate-600">
          Already have an account?{' '}
          <Link to="/login" className="font-semibold text-brand-600 hover:text-brand-700 hover:underline">Sign in</Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/pages/TeamPage.tsx

````tsx
import { useState, FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { UserPlus } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { PageHeader, Card, LoadingState, Button, Modal } from '../components/ui';
import { teamApi, type NewTeamMember } from '../api/team';
import { useAuthStore } from '../store/authStore';
import { apiErrorMessage } from '../lib/errors';
import type { TeamMember, TeamRole } from '../types';

const ROLE_LABELS: Record<TeamRole, string> = {
  ADMIN: 'Admin',
  CAMPAIGN_MANAGER: 'Campaign manager',
  VIEWER: 'Viewer',
};

const ROLE_HELP: Record<TeamRole, string> = {
  ADMIN: 'Everything, including managing the team',
  CAMPAIGN_MANAGER: 'Create and send campaigns, manage contacts and templates',
  VIEWER: 'Read-only: view campaigns and analytics',
};

const EMPTY: NewTeamMember = { email: '', firstName: '', lastName: '', password: '', role: 'CAMPAIGN_MANAGER' };

/** The Admin's company team: add people, change roles, disable accounts. Admin only (server-enforced). */
export default function TeamPage() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const me = useAuthStore((s) => s.user);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<NewTeamMember>(EMPTY);

  const query = useQuery({ queryKey: ['team'], queryFn: teamApi.list });

  const addMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: teamApi.add,
    onSuccess: (m) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['team'] });
      toast.success(`${m.firstName} added. Share their email and starting password with them.`);
      setAdding(false);
      setForm(EMPTY);
    },
    onError: (e) => toast.error(apiErrorMessage(e, 'Could not add this person.')),
  });

  const updateMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, change }: { id: number; change: { role?: TeamRole; enabled?: boolean } }) =>
      teamApi.update(id, change),
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['team'] }),
    onError: (e) => toast.error(apiErrorMessage(e, 'Could not update this person.')),
  });

  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (form.password.length < 8) {
      toast.error('The starting password needs at least 8 characters.');
      return;
    }
    addMutation.mutate({ ...form, email: form.email.trim(), firstName: form.firstName.trim(), lastName: form.lastName.trim() });
  };

  const field = (name: keyof NewTeamMember, label: string, type = 'text') => (
    <div>
      <label htmlFor={`team-${name}`} className="label">{label}</label>
      <input
        id={`team-${name}`}
        type={type}
        required
        className="input"
        value={form[name]}
        onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [name]: e.target.value }))}
        autoComplete={type === 'password' ? 'new-password' : 'off'}
      />
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <PageHeader
        title="Team"
        description={`People in ${me?.organizationName ?? 'your company'}. Only admins can see this page.`}
        actions={<Button onClick={() => setAdding(true)}><UserPlus className="h-4 w-4" /> Add person</Button>}
      />

      <Card padded={false}>
        {query.isLoading ? (
          <LoadingState label="Loading team…" />
        ) : query.isError ? (
          <p className="p-6 text-sm text-red-600">{apiErrorMessage(query.error, 'Could not load the team.')}</p>
        ) : (
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-left text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Name</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Email</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Role</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Status</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3" />
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {(query.data ?? []).map((m: TeamMember) => {
                const self = m.id === me?.id;
                return (
                  <tr key={m.id}>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-slate-900">
                      {m.firstName} {m.lastName} {self && <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">(you)</span>}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600">{m.email}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <select
                        className="input py-1.5"
                        value={m.role}
                        disabled={self || updateMutation.isPending}
                        title={self ? "You can't change your own role" : ROLE_HELP[m.role]}
                        aria-label={`Role of ${m.firstName} ${m.lastName}`}
                        onChange={(e) => updateMutation.mutate({ id: m.id, change: { role: e.target.value as TeamRole } })}
                      >
                        {(Object.keys(ROLE_LABELS) as TeamRole[]).map((r) => (
                          <option key={r} value={r}>{ROLE_LABELS[r]}</option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <span className={m.enabled ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-slate-400'}>
                        {m.enabled ? 'Active' : 'Disabled'}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                      {!self && (
                        <Button
                          variant={m.enabled ? 'ghost' : 'secondary'}
                          size="sm"
                          disabled={updateMutation.isPending}
                          onClick={() => updateMutation.mutate({ id: m.id, change: { enabled: !m.enabled } })}
                        >
                          {m.enabled ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </Card>

      <Modal
        open={adding}
        onClose={() => setAdding(false)}
        title="Add a person to your company"
        description="They sign in with this email and starting password. Share both with them."
      >
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {field('firstName', 'First name')}
            {field('lastName', 'Last name')}
          </div>
          {field('email', 'Email', 'email')}
          {field('password', 'Starting password (min. 8 characters)', 'password')}
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="team-role" className="label">Role</label>
            <select
              id="team-role"
              className="input"
              value={form.role}
              onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, role: e.target.value as TeamRole }))}
            >
              {(Object.keys(ROLE_LABELS) as TeamRole[]).map((r) => (
                <option key={r} value={r}>{ROLE_LABELS[r]} — {ROLE_HELP[r]}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
            <Button type="button" variant="secondary" onClick={() => setAdding(false)}>Cancel</Button>
            <Button type="submit" loading={addMutation.isPending}>Add person</Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/pages/TemplatesPage.tsx

````tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { keepPreviousData, useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import clsx from 'clsx';
import {
  AlertTriangle, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Eye, FileText, Lock, Mail, Pencil, Plus, RefreshCw, Trash2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { templatesApi } from '../api/templates';
import type { EmailTemplate } from '../types';
import { useAuthStore } from '../store/authStore';
import { PageHeader, Card, EmptyState, LoadingState, Button, Modal } from '../components/ui';
import { TemplateEditorModal } from '../components/TemplateEditorModal';
import { TemplatePreviewPanel } from '../components/TemplatePreviewPanel';
import { apiErrorMessage, apiErrorStatus, isForbidden } from '../lib/errors';
import { canManage, noPermissionMessage } from '../lib/roles';
import { DEFAULT_SAMPLE, type SampleData } from '../lib/templateSample';

const PAGE_SIZE = 24;

function formatDate(value?: string | null): string {
  return value ? format(new Date(value), 'MMM d, yyyy') : '—';
}

function hasBody(t: EmailTemplate): boolean {
  return !!t.htmlBody?.trim() || !!t.plainBody?.trim();
}

export default function TemplatesPage() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  // VIEWER is read-only: the backend allows it GET requests only (SecurityConfig), so
  // the write actions and the preview with sample data are not offered.
  const canWrite = useAuthStore((s) => canManage(s.roles));
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [viewing, setViewing] = useState<EmailTemplate | null>(null);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<{ template: EmailTemplate | null } | null>(null);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<EmailTemplate | null>(null);
  // Kept here so the sample values survive closing and reopening a preview.
  const [sample, setSample] = useState<SampleData>(DEFAULT_SAMPLE);

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['templates', 'list', page],
    queryFn: () => templatesApi.list({ page, size: PAGE_SIZE }),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
  });
  const data = query.data;
  const templates = data?.content ?? [];

  // Deleting the last template on a page leaves it empty: go back one page.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (data && !query.isPlaceholderData && data.content.length === 0 && page > 0) {
      setPage((p) => Math.max(0, p - 1));
    }
  }, [data, query.isPlaceholderData, page]);

  // The ['templates'] prefix covers this list and the campaign form's
  // ['templates', 'campaign-form']. The campaign form also caches single templates
  // (['template', id]) and rendered previews (['template-render', …]).
  const refreshTemplates = () => {
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['templates'] });
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['template'] });
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['template-render'] });
  };

  const deleteMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (t: EmailTemplate) => templatesApi.delete(t.id),
    onSuccess: (_res, t) => {
      toast.success(`Template "${t.name}" deleted`, { id: `template-delete-${t.id}` });
      setDeleting(null);
      refreshTemplates();
    },
    onError: (e: unknown, t) => {
      const id = `template-delete-${t.id}`;
      if (isForbidden(e)) {
        toast.error(noPermissionMessage('delete templates'), { id });
      } else if (apiErrorStatus(e) === 404) {
        toast.error(`Template "${t.name}" no longer exists. It may have been deleted already.`, { id });
        setDeleting(null);
        refreshTemplates();
      } else {
        toast.error(apiErrorMessage(e, 'Could not delete the template.'), { id });
      }
    },
  });

  const openCreate = () => setEditing({ template: null });
  const openEdit = (t: EmailTemplate) => {
    setViewing(null);
    setEditing({ template: t });
  };
  const askDelete = (t: EmailTemplate) => {
    setViewing(null);
    setDeleting(t);
  };

  const newButton = (
    <Button onClick={openCreate}>
      <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> New Template
    </Button>
  );

  const total = data?.totalElements ?? 0;
  const first = total === 0 ? 0 : page * PAGE_SIZE + 1;
  const last = Math.min(total, page * PAGE_SIZE + templates.length);

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <PageHeader
        title="Email Templates"
        description="Reusable email templates with personalization placeholders such as {{FirstName}}."
        actions={canWrite ? newButton : undefined}
      />

      {!canWrite && (
        <p className="mb-5 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
          <Lock className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-slate-400" />
          You have read-only access. Admins and campaign managers can create, edit and delete templates and
          preview them with sample data.
        </p>
      )}

      {query.isLoading ? (
        <Card padded={false}>
          <LoadingState label="Loading templates…" />
        </Card>
      ) : query.isError ? (
        <Card className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-12 text-center">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-7 w-7 text-amber-500" />
          <p className="max-w-md text-sm text-slate-700">
            {isForbidden(query.error)
              ? noPermissionMessage('view templates')
              : apiErrorMessage(query.error, 'Could not load the templates.')}
          </p>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => query.refetch()} loading={query.isFetching}>
            {!query.isFetching && <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />} Try again
          </Button>
        </Card>
      ) : templates.length === 0 ? (
        <Card padded={false}>
          <EmptyState
            icon={FileText}
            title="No templates yet"
            description={
              canWrite
                ? 'Create a reusable email template with placeholders like {{FirstName}} and {{Company}}.'
                : 'Admins and campaign managers can create templates.'
            }
            action={canWrite ? newButton : undefined}
          />
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className={clsx('grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3', query.isPlaceholderData && 'opacity-60')}>
            {templates.map((t) => (
              <Card key={t.id} hoverable className="flex flex-col">
                {/* Header */}
                <div className="mb-3 flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3 text-left"
                    onClick={() => setViewing(t)}
                    title="View template"
                  >
                    <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-brand-50 text-brand-600">
                      <Mail className="h-5 w-5" />
                    </div>
                    <h3 className="line-clamp-1 font-semibold text-slate-900 hover:text-brand-700">{t.name}</h3>
                  </button>
                  <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn-icon text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-600"
                      aria-label={`View template ${t.name}`}
                      title="View"
                      onClick={() => setViewing(t)}
                    >
                      <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </button>
                    {canWrite && (
                      <>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="btn-icon text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-600"
                          aria-label={`Edit template ${t.name}`}
                          title="Edit"
                          onClick={() => openEdit(t)}
                        >
                          <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="btn-icon text-slate-400 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-600"
                          aria-label={`Delete template ${t.name}`}
                          title="Delete"
                          onClick={() => askDelete(t)}
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </button>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Description */}
                <p className="mb-3 line-clamp-2 text-sm text-slate-500">
                  {t.description || 'No description provided.'}
                </p>

                {/* Subject preview */}
                <div className="mb-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2">
                  <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-400">Subject</p>
                  <p className="line-clamp-1 text-sm text-slate-700">{t.subject}</p>
                </div>

                {/* Variables */}
                {(t.variables ?? []).length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    {(t.variables ?? []).map((v) => (
                      <span
                        key={v}
                        className="rounded-md bg-accent-50 px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs text-accent-700"
                      >
                        {`{{${v}}}`}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {!hasBody(t) && (
                  <p className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-amber-700">
                    <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> This template has no body yet.
                  </p>
                )}

                {/* Footer */}
                <p className="mt-auto border-t border-slate-100 pt-3 text-xs text-slate-400">
                  Created {formatDate(t.createdAt)}
                  {t.updatedAt && t.updatedAt !== t.createdAt ? ` · Updated ${formatDate(t.updatedAt)}` : ''}
                </p>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>

          {(data?.totalPages ?? 0) > 1 && (
            <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-slate-500">
              <span>
                {first.toLocaleString()}–{last.toLocaleString()} of {total.toLocaleString()} templates
              </span>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(0, p - 1))}
                  disabled={page === 0 || query.isFetching}
                >
                  <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> Previous
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
                  disabled={!!data?.last || query.isFetching}
                >
                  Next <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {viewing && (
        <TemplateViewModal
          key={viewing.id}
          template={viewing}
          canWrite={canWrite}
          sample={sample}
          onSampleChange={setSample}
          onClose={() => setViewing(null)}
          onEdit={() => openEdit(viewing)}
          onDelete={() => askDelete(viewing)}
        />
      )}

      {editing && (
        <TemplateEditorModal
          key={editing.template?.id ?? 'new'}
          template={editing.template}
          sample={sample}
          onSampleChange={setSample}
          onClose={() => setEditing(null)}
          onMissing={refreshTemplates}
          onSaved={() => {
            // A new template is listed first (newest first), on the first page.
            if (!editing.template) setPage(0);
            refreshTemplates();
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Delete confirmation */}
      <Modal
        open={!!deleting}
        onClose={() => !deleteMutation.isPending && setDeleting(null)}
        title={`Delete template "${deleting?.name ?? ''}"?`}
        description="It disappears from the template list and can no longer be chosen for a campaign."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setDeleting(null)} disabled={deleteMutation.isPending}>
              Keep template
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="danger"
              onClick={() => deleting && deleteMutation.mutate(deleting)}
              loading={deleteMutation.isPending}
            >
              {deleteMutation.isPending ? 'Deleting…' : 'Delete template'}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <ul className="list-disc space-y-2 pl-5 text-sm text-slate-700">
          <li>
            <b>This is a soft delete.</b> The template is hidden, not erased from the database, but it can't be
            restored from MailFlow.
          </li>
          <li>
            <b>Campaign history is kept.</b> Campaigns that already used it keep their sent emails, delivery results
            and statistics.
          </li>
          <li>
            <b>Drafts that use it can't be launched</b> until you choose another template for them: open the
            campaign and choose Edit draft. A scheduled campaign that uses it won't start.
          </li>
          <li>Campaigns that are already sending keep using its content, and so does a paused campaign when it is resumed.</li>
        </ul>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

interface TemplateViewModalProps {
  template: EmailTemplate;
  canWrite: boolean;
  sample: SampleData;
  onSampleChange: (sample: SampleData) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
}

/** Shows a saved template as written; managers can also preview it with sample data. */
function TemplateViewModal({ template, canWrite, sample, onSampleChange, onClose, onEdit, onDelete }: TemplateViewModalProps) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'content' | 'preview'>('content');
  const variables = template.variables ?? [];
  const tabs: { key: 'content' | 'preview'; label: string }[] = canWrite
    ? [
        { key: 'content', label: 'Content' },
        { key: 'preview', label: 'Preview with sample data' },
      ]
    : [{ key: 'content', label: 'Content' }];

  return (
    <Modal
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      widthClass="max-w-4xl"
      title={template.name}
      description={template.description || undefined}
      footer={
        <>
          {canWrite && (
            <Button variant="ghost" className="mr-auto text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700" onClick={onDelete}>
              <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" /> Delete
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>Close</Button>
          {canWrite && (
            <Button onClick={onEdit}>
              <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" /> Edit
            </Button>
          )}
        </>
      }
    >
      {tabs.length > 1 && (
        <div className="mb-4 flex gap-1 border-b border-slate-200 text-sm font-medium" role="tablist">
          {tabs.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.key}
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={tab === t.key}
              onClick={() => setTab(t.key)}
              className={clsx(
                '-mb-px border-b-2 px-3 py-2',
                tab === t.key ? 'border-brand-600 text-brand-700' : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700',
              )}
            >
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'content' || !canWrite ? (
        <div className="space-y-4 text-sm">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Subject</p>
            <p className="font-medium text-slate-900">{template.subject}</p>
          </div>

          {variables.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 text-xs">
              <span className="text-slate-500">Placeholders:</span>
              {variables.map((v) => (
                <code key={v} className="rounded bg-accent-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-accent-700">{`{{${v}}}`}</code>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <p className="mb-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">HTML body, as written (placeholders not filled)</p>
            {template.htmlBody?.trim() ? (
              <>
                {/* sandbox="" blocks scripts, forms, popups and same-origin access in the template's HTML. */}
                <iframe
                  title={`HTML body of ${template.name}`}
                  sandbox=""
                  srcDoc={template.htmlBody}
                  className="h-72 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white"
                />
                <details className="mt-2">
                  <summary className="cursor-pointer text-xs font-medium text-brand-600">Show HTML source</summary>
                  <pre className="mt-1 max-h-64 overflow-auto whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-3 font-mono text-xs text-slate-700">
                    {template.htmlBody}
                  </pre>
                </details>
              </>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-slate-400">No HTML body.</p>
            )}
          </div>

          <div>
            <p className="mb-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Plain-text body</p>
            {template.plainBody?.trim() ? (
              <pre className="max-h-64 overflow-auto whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-3 text-xs text-slate-700">
                {template.plainBody}
              </pre>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-slate-400">No plain-text body.</p>
            )}
          </div>

          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            Created {formatDate(template.createdAt)} · Last updated {formatDate(template.updatedAt)}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <TemplatePreviewPanel
          sample={sample}
          onSampleChange={onSampleChange}
          render={(recipient) => templatesApi.render(template.id, { recipient })}
          contentKey={`saved:${template.id}:${template.updatedAt}`}
          placeholders={variables}
          blockedReason={hasBody(template) ? null : 'This template has no body to preview. Edit it to add one.'}
        />
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}
````

## frontend/src/store/authStore.ts

````tsx
import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { UserInfo } from '../types';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';

export interface SignUpInput {
  companyName: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
}

interface AuthState {
  user: UserInfo | null;
  /**
   * Role names without the "ROLE_" prefix, e.g. ["CAMPAIGN_MANAGER"]. Set at login and
   * restored from the stored token after a page reload.
   * The server checks the roles on every request; the UI only uses them to decide
   * which actions to offer.
   */
  roles: string[];
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
  /** Creates a new company workspace with the person as its Admin, and signs them in. */
  signUp: (input: SignUpInput) => Promise<void>;
  logout: () => void;
  initFromStorage: () => void;
}

/** Decodes a JWT payload (base64url). Not verified here: the server verifies every request. */
function decodeTokenPayload(token: string): { exp?: number; roles?: unknown } {
  const part = (token.split('.')[1] ?? '').replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
  return JSON.parse(atob(part));
}

/** The token's "roles" claim holds authorities such as "ROLE_CAMPAIGN_MANAGER". */
function rolesFromToken(payload: { roles?: unknown }): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(payload.roles)) return [];
  return payload.roles
    .filter((r): r is string => typeof r === 'string')
    .map((r) => r.replace(/^ROLE_/, ''));
}

/** Profile shown in the UI (name, company). Not a credential: the token is what the server checks. */
function storedUser(): UserInfo | null {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('user');
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as UserInfo) : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function clearSession() {
  localStorage.removeItem('accessToken');
  localStorage.removeItem('user');
}

export const useAuthStore = create<AuthState>((set) => {
  const startSession = (data: { accessToken: string; user: UserInfo }) => {
    localStorage.setItem('accessToken', data.accessToken);
    localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(data.user));
    set({ user: data.user, roles: data.user?.roles ?? [], isAuthenticated: true });
  };

  return {
    user: null,
    roles: [],
    isAuthenticated: false,

    login: async (email, password) => {
      const res = await apiClient.post('/api/auth/login', { email, password });
      startSession(res.data);
    },

    signUp: async (input) => {
      const res = await apiClient.post('/api/auth/register', input);
      startSession(res.data);
    },

    logout: () => {
      clearSession();
      set({ user: null, roles: [], isAuthenticated: false });
      window.location.href = '/login';
    },

    initFromStorage: () => {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('accessToken');
      if (!token) return;
      try {
        const payload = decodeTokenPayload(token);
        if (payload.exp !== undefined && payload.exp * 1000 > Date.now()) {
          set({ isAuthenticated: true, roles: rolesFromToken(payload), user: storedUser() });
        } else {
          clearSession();
        }
      } catch {
        clearSession();
      }
    },
  };
});
````

## frontend/src/types/index.ts

````tsx
// ── Auth ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface UserInfo {
  id: number;
  email: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  roles: string[];
  /** The user's company workspace. */
  organizationId?: number;
  organizationName?: string;
}

/** A person in the signed-in Admin's company (Team page). */
export type TeamRole = 'ADMIN' | 'CAMPAIGN_MANAGER' | 'VIEWER';

export interface TeamMember {
  id: number;
  email: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  role: TeamRole;
  enabled: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface AuthResponse {
  accessToken: string;
  refreshToken: string;
  tokenType: string;
  expiresIn: number;
  user: UserInfo;
}

// ── Campaign ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export type CampaignStatus =
  | 'DRAFT' | 'SCHEDULED' | 'QUEUED' | 'RUNNING'
  | 'PAUSED' | 'COMPLETED' | 'FAILED' | 'CANCELLED';

export interface Campaign {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  subject: string;
  templateId?: number;
  templateName?: string;
  senderName?: string;
  senderEmail?: string;
  replyTo?: string;
  status: CampaignStatus;
  scheduledAt?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  startedAt?: string;
  completedAt?: string;
  totalRecipients: number;
  sentCount: number;
  failedCount: number;
  skippedCount: number;
  bouncedCount: number;
  retryCount: number;
  successRate: number;
  batchJobId?: string;
  /** Recipient groups targeted by the campaign (set via the API; not editable in the UI). */
  recipientGroupIds?: number[];
  /** Saved contacts selected for the campaign. */
  recipientIds?: number[];
  /** Number of campaign-only addresses (present in every response). */
  targetAddressCount?: number;
  /**
   * Campaign-only addresses: emailed by this campaign without being saved as contacts.
   * Only single-campaign responses (get, create, update) include them; the list omits them.
   */
  targetAddresses?: TargetAddress[];
  /**
   * The campaign's own plain-text email body, sent instead of the template's bodies.
   * Only single-campaign responses include it, and only when the campaign has one.
   */
  customBody?: string | null;
  /**
   * Whether the campaign has email content to send (its own body, or a non-deleted
   * template with a body). Present in every response, including the list.
   */
  hasContent?: boolean;
}

/** An address used by one campaign only. It is stored with the campaign, not as a contact. */
export interface TargetAddress {
  email: string;
  name?: string | null;
  firstName?: string | null;
  lastName?: string | null;
  company?: string | null;
  /** Extra personalisation values, e.g. { Team: "Platform" } for {{Team}}. */
  fields?: Record<string, string>;
}

// ── Recipient ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export type RecipientStatus = 'ACTIVE' | 'UNSUBSCRIBED' | 'BOUNCED' | 'INVALID';

export interface Recipient {
  id: number;
  email: string;
  name?: string;
  firstName?: string;
  lastName?: string;
  company?: string;
  course?: string;
  customFields: Record<string, string>;
  status: RecipientStatus;
  importSource?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

// ── Template ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface EmailTemplate {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  subject: string;
  htmlBody?: string;
  plainBody?: string;
  variables: string[];
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

// ── Analytics ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface CampaignAnalytics {
  campaignId: number;
  campaignName: string;
  total: number;
  sent: number;
  failed: number;
  skipped: number;
  bounced: number;
  retried: number;
  successRate: number;
  throughputPerMinute: number;
  durationSeconds?: number;
}

export interface DashboardSummary {
  totalCampaigns: number;
  activeCampaigns: number;
  totalEmailsSent: number;
  totalEmailsFailed: number;
  overallSuccessRate: number;
  totalRecipients: number;
}

// ── Page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface PageResponse<T> {
  content: T[];
  page: number;
  size: number;
  totalElements: number;
  totalPages: number;
  first: boolean;
  last: boolean;
}
````

````tsx
/// <reference types="vite/client" />
````
